Title: Data Analyst (f/d/m)
Description:
Join us as femtasy's first internal Data Analyst (f/d/m). Sit with Marketing, Product, and Finance to turn messy questions into clear, actionable answers, working directly with our Head of Data.




This is femtasy

femtasy is the audio-only streaming platform for sensual audio stories & sexy sounds for women. We inspire women to explore and enjoy on their own terms. We're a female-centric product, led by a female CEO & Founder, with over 90% of our team identifying as women+. We've already positively impacted the lives of hundreds of thousands of women by redefining female pleasure – and we're just getting started.




Your mission and your impact:

Today, all data requests from Marketing (our principal stakeholder), Product, and Finance funnel through our Head of Data, who scopes every ask before an external agency executes it. That doesn't scale. You'll be the first internal hire to change that: sitting directly with stakeholders, turning vague requests into well-defined problems, and delivering a good-enough solution fast.




You'll report to the Head of Data and work alongside an Analytics Engineer who owns the heavier dbt/pipeline work.




Six months in, this is what your impact looks like: you run scoping conversations with Marketing especially, but also Product and Finance independently – no pre-framing needed from your Head of Data. You own the fact tables and models behind your recurring reporting. You've proactively fixed or flagged at least one foundational data issue – because you saw it, not because someone asked. Stakeholders treat you as a go-to resource, not a ticket-taker.




What you'll do

Own first-line scoping conversations with Marketing, Product, and Finance: ask the right clarifying questions, push back on vague or over-scoped requests, and land on a defined problem plus a good-enough solution.
Come up with your own solution after aligned with stakeholders, maximizing the impact and keeping the development time as short as possible.
Build and maintain the dashboards and reports (Tableau today, tool-agnostic long term) that Marketing, Product, and Finance can actually act on.
Build and manage data in dbt: create and maintain the fact tables and models that support your recurring reporting and analyses, with our Analytics Engineer supporting the underlying infrastructure.
Own the day-to-day reliability of what you build: catch issues, flag or fix them – so no one ever has to ask »which number is right«.
Question the status quo at the working level. If something's »always been done that way« and it's slowing a team down, we want you to say so and to work with your Head of Data on what's worth fixing.




What you bring

3+ years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar analytics role: you can work independently on well-scoped problems and know when to ask for help on ambiguous ones.
Proven stakeholder-facing judgment. You've sat in front of a non-technical stakeholder with a vague ask, asked the right questions, and resisted both over-engineering the answer and under-scoping it.
You frame problems clearly, communicate directly, and challenge assumptions.
Solid SQL, dbt, and hands-on comfort with a BI tool: you build and maintain your models yourself, from raw data to fact table to dashboard. Our Analytics Engineer supports you on infrastructure, but day-to-day dbt work is yours to own.
Comfortable moving across domains. You won't own one fixed area – you will support Marketing and other stakeholders when needed.
Opinionated but coachable. You're willing to challenge »it's always been like that«, and open to direct feedback.
Fluent in English.

A strong plus, not a must

You've worked with Marketing before (at least one real marketing project)
You've experienced a startup environment
You already use AI tools in your day-to-day analysis




This role is hybrid, based in or around Berlin. We're in the office together every Tuesday and Wednesday, with flexibility on the remaining days.




This is NOT for you if…

You want every request fully pre-scoped before you touch it, rather than asking the clarifying questions yourself.
You'd rather just execute the ticket than sit with a stakeholder and challenge whether it's the right ask.
You reach for a dashboard or a data pull before you've actually understood the business problem behind it.
You're not comfortable owning your models end-to-end in dbt, from raw data to the fact table to the final report.
You see yourself as a data service desk instead of creating your own tickets after aligning with stakeholders.




What we offer

🌟 Impact & purpose. The chance to join a huge mission around female empowerment and gender equality.

🦸 Female-led and women-centric. A female-centric product, a female CEO & Founder, and over 90% of our whole team identifies as women+.

🤝 Inspiring, performance-oriented culture. A progressive team culture based on transparency, open feedback, ownership, and collaboration. Check out »radical candor« if you want to learn more about how we work.

🤖 AI-first by default. A company-paid AI subscription of your choice, and a team that automates everything worth automating so you can focus on the work that matters.

📈 Personal and professional growth. Team learning sessions, learning & development budgets, and internal trainings. Every team member, from junior to C-level, has access to personal 1:1 sessions with a professional business coach.

🔄 Healthy approach to taking a break. 26 holidays plus unlimited recharging time on top for when you really need it.

📍 Flexibility. Flexible working hours, hybrid setup with our Berlin office as home base.

🎉 (Really cool) events & benefits like an Urban Sports membership (or alternative offerings), snacks & lunches, mobility and retirement plans, and our famous femtasy parties and team events. We also cook and eat together twice a month and have a big office garden for the best BBQs in Berlin.

💪 Package. A compensation package that fairly mirrors what's expected from you and the impact you'll have on femtasy. Exact range shared in the first call.




femtasy offers equal opportunities for all and encourages applicants of all nationalities, genders, sexual orientations, religious backgrounds, gender identities, and people with disabilities to apply.




Our Recruiting Process

Short application questionnaire (approx. 10 minutes)
30 min Get-to-know-each-other call with one of our recruiters
30 min with our Head of Data
1h 30 min working session with our Head of Data: a live scoping exercise, not a take-home test
45 min interview with one of your future stakeholders (Marketing, Product or Finance)
1h interview with our CEO
Final offer




We are looking to fill this position as soon as possible und usually respond within three days.

Title: Datenanalyst:in Bedarfsplanung
Description:
Die Kassenärztliche Vereinigung (KV) Berlin ist eine Körperschaft des öffentlichen Rechts und eine wichtige Schlüsselfunktion im Gesundheitswesen. Wir sind für die Sicherstellung der ambulanten medizinischen und psychotherapeutischen Versorgung der gesetzlich Versicherten in der Hauptstadt zuständig. Wir gewährleisten diese in Zusammenarbeit mit der Ärzteschaft auf einem hohen Qualitätsniveau – rund um die Uhr. Unser Hauptsitz befindet sich in einem modernen Bürogebäude in zentraler Lage mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung durch Bus und Bahn.

Die Kassenärztliche Vereinigung Berlin (Körperschaft des öffentlichen Rechts) sucht für ihre Abteilung Arztregister und Bedarfsplanung zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt auf Vollzeitbasis (Teilzeit möglich) befristet für 1 Jahr eine:n

Datenanalyst:in Bedarfsplanung

Als Datenanalyst:in in der Bedarfsplanung analysieren, strukturieren und visualisieren Sie versorgungsrelevante Daten für die ambulante Versorgung in Berlin. Im Rahmen Ihrer Tätigkeit unterstützen Sie das Team bei seinen Aufgaben und wirken beim Aufbau des Versorgungsradars als Monitoring-, Planungs- und Prognoseinstrument mit. Aufgrund der Zuordnung zum Projekt „Versorgungsradar“ ist diese Stelle befristet.

Ihr Aufgabengebiet


Analyse der ambulanten Versorgungssituation in Berlin zur Ermittlung von Versorgungsgraden und -bedarfen
Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung des Bedarfsplans auf Basis gesetzlicher Vorgaben und fundierter Datenanalysen
Durchführung von Versorgungs-, Bedarfs- und Prognoseanalysen zur zukunftsorientierten Steuerung der ambulanten Versorgung
Aufbereitung, Visualisierung und Präsentation komplexer Daten für Vorstand, Fachbereiche und externe Stakeholder, insbesondere unter Einsatz von Power BI
Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Dashboards und interaktiven Berichten in Power BI zur Unterstützung von Monitoring-, Planungs- und Entscheidungsprozessen
Entwicklung von Handlungsempfehlungen und strategischen Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Gremien und Führungskräfte
Prüfung versorgungsrelevanter Anträge und Sachverhalte unter Berücksichtigung bedarfsplanerischer und rechtlicher Kriterien
Optimierung datenbasierter Prozesse und fachliche Begleitung technischer Lösungen zur effizienten Bedarfsplanung


Ihr Profil


Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (Fach-)Hochschulstudium im Bereich Gesundheitswissenschaften, Gesundheitsökonomie, Public Health, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Mathematik, Verwaltungsrecht o. Ä. bzw. vergleichbare für die Stelle relevante Kenntnisse/Erfahrung
Detailliertes Fachwissen und Erfahrungen zu den komplexen Prozessen der ambulanten Bedarfsplanung und der Abrechnung der Vertragsärzt:innen
Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Bereich Statistik und Modellierung sowie Datenauswertung und -darstellung
Gute Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit Microsoft Power BI, insbesondere bei der Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Dashboards, Berichten und Datenvisualisierungen
Analytisch-logisches Know-how sowie lösungsorientiertes Handeln
Zuverlässigkeit und Engagement
Souveränes Auftreten im abteilungsübergreifenden Kontakt und im Kontakt mit Ärzt:innen, Krankenkassen, Behörden und sonstigen Institutionen


Wir bieten Ihnen


Vergütung nach TV-L Berlin, inklusive einer Jahressonderzahlung und 30 Tage Urlaub
38,5 Stunden/Woche (Vollzeit) und flexible Arbeitszeiten/Teilzeitmodelle
Bis zu 11 Tage mobiles Arbeiten monatlich (nach Ende der Probezeit)
KV-Card (50 € monatlicher Sachbezug) zum Einkaufen in der Region
Zahlreiche Angebote zur Gesundheitsförderung und unternehmenseigene Fitnessräume

Title: Senior Analyst — People & Workforce Intelligence (PWI) (d/f/m)
Description:
Personio's intelligent HR platform helps small and medium-sized organizations unlock the power of people by making complicated, time-consuming tasks simple and efficient. Our team of 1,500 Personios is building user-friendly products that delight our 15,000+ customers and their 1.5 million employees. Ready to make an impact from day one?

This role requires 2 days per week in the office and is based in Munich, Berlin or Dublin.

We empower Personio's decision-making with reliable data and strategic insights, while improving productivity through scalable infrastructure and automation. Be part of our transformative journey in HR technology, where your contributions shape how a leading people management platform understands its own workforce.

The Senior Analyst — PWI sits within the Data, Systems & AI department and partners closely with the People & Workplace Intelligence (PWI) function. This role combines two capabilities that are most powerful together: building the data foundations that make reliable analysis possible, and delivering the analysis itself. You own the infrastructure — writing dbt models from raw sources — and you own the insight: turning that data into clear recommendations for People leadership and partners.

You will work closely with PBPs and People leadership to connect people data sources — HRIS, absence and attendance systems, and others — and enable a self-serve analytics capability across the people domain.

What You'll Do

Data Foundations


Build and own dbt models end-to-end — from raw source ingestion through to staging, intermediate, and reporting layers — for the PWI domain, covering HRIS, headcount, absence, attendance, and adjacent people data sources.
Design and maintain scalable warehouse schemas in Snowflake, with clear data lineage, documentation, and version-controlled code (Git).
Define, document, and steward metric definitions and the semantic layer for people data, ensuring reliable KPI logic and metric consistency across the domain.
Implement data quality testing, monitoring, and alerting so that data issues are caught early and fixed proactively — not discovered by stakeholders.


Analytical Delivery


Deliver structured analysis on headcount, attrition, absence and attendance, org design, manager effectiveness, and compensation for PBPs and PWI leadership — forming clear hypotheses and producing decision-ready outputs, not just data dumps.
Build and maintain intuitive dashboards and reporting that allow stakeholders to self-serve on day-to-day questions without requiring analyst involvement.
Support MBR and QBR cycles with data storytelling: own the narrative, not just the numbers.
Partner with PBPs to diagnose root-cause data gaps, translate urgent business needs into analytical deliverables, and systematically improve the quality of people data over time.


Stakeholder Partnership


Act as the embedded analytical partner for the PWI function — showing up proactively, anticipating needs, and flagging risks before they escalate.
Present findings directly to People leadership with confident, prescriptive recommendations.
Enable PBPs to work more independently with data through documentation, self-serve tools, and direct coaching.


What You Need To Succeed

Must-haves


5+ years in analytics engineering, analytics, or a hybrid of both — you have done both the building and the analysis, not just one side.
Expert-level dbt: you have built models from raw source data, written tests, managed documentation, and understand lineage end-to-end — not just maintained existing models.
Strong SQL: complex queries, performance optimization, ability to work across a Snowflake-based data warehouse without hand-holding.
Analytical rigour: you structure ambiguous problems into hypotheses, identify the right metrics, and produce outputs that lead to decisions — not more questions.
Clear communicator: you translate data into plain language for non-technical stakeholders, present confidently, and write documentation that people actually use.
Experience with BI tooling (HEX, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent) for building stakeholder-facing dashboards and reporting.
Comfortable with Git and version-controlled codebases as a daily practice.
High ownership: you diagnose root causes, drive work independently, and don't wait to be told what matters next.
AI Fluency: You have hands-on experience using AI to improve your workflow, and the sound judgment to know exactly when to rely on it and when to step in yourself.


Nice to have


Experience with people/HRIS data — Workday, BambooHR, or similar compensation and benefits tooling.
Python for analytical workflows and automation.
Exposure to AI/LLM tooling (Claude, GPT) for insight generation or workflow automation.


Why Personio

Personio is an equal opportunities employer, committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. We embrace uniqueness and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. We are proud to have an inclusive workplace environment that will foster your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

At Personio, we value in-person collaboration while also offering flexibility. This role is office-based, with 3 days per week required in your contracted office location. The remaining days can be worked from home or in the office if you prefer. In addition, you’ll have 20 Flex Days per year to work remotely from other locations. Aside from our people, culture, and mission, check out some of the other benefits that make Personio a great place to work:


Receive a competitive reward package – reevaluated each year – that includes salary, benefits, and pre-IPO equity
Enjoy 28 days of paid vacation, plus an additional day after 2 and 4 years
Make an impact on the environment and society with 1 (fully paid) Impact Day
Receive generous family leave, child support, mental health support, and sabbatical opportunities
We enjoy gathering for meals, cultural initiatives, and events like local Summer Sessions and year-end celebrations. There's also healthy snacks, drinks, and a weekly catered lunch.

Title: Business Analyst / Senior Business Analyst (m/w/d) – Daten & Institutssteuerung
Description:
Die Sparkassen Rating und Risikosysteme (SR) ist der zentrale Dienstleister für Verfahren des Risikomanagements in der Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe. Wir unterstützen die Institute mit Standardlösungen in den Bereichen der Risikomessung und -steuerung, der regulatorischen Banksteuerung sowie im Vertrieb mit Data-Analytics-Lösungen. Gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern bieten wir den Instituten, von der Konzeption der Verfahren, über deren Weiterentwicklung, IT-Umsetzung und Umsetzungsunterstützung, zentrale und standardisierte Lösungen an.


Business Analyst | Senior Business Analyst (m/w/d) – Daten & Institutssteuerung


ab sofort suchen wir im Fachbereich Institutssteuerung


Das erwartet Dich:
Aufbruch & Datenfokus: Bereich Institutssteuerung, Entwicklung neuer Systeme für Sparkassen; datengetriebene Lösungen zur Steuerung von Risiko und Ertrag, Arbeit mit Daten, Modellen und technischen Lösungen.
Verantwortung & Entwicklung: Je nach Erfahrung übernimmst Du früh eigene Themenpakete und entwickelst Dich hin zu eigenständigem Projektmanagement und sicherem Auftritt vor Kunden und Fachgremien.
Daten & Technik: Du analysierst große Datenmengen, entwickelst Auswertungen, Modelle und Prototypen (z. B. in SQL, Python, R), gestaltest Datenverarbeitungsstrecken und bereitest Ergebnisse für die Steuerung von Sparkassen auf.
Kundensicht & Technik verbinden: Du verstehst Prozesse und Bedarfe unserer Kunden und übersetzt sie in robuste, nachhaltige Daten- und IT-Konzepte – genau diese Brücke zwischen Fachlichkeit und Technik ist Kern Deiner Rolle.
Vielseitiger Arbeitsalltag: Mix aus Datenanalyse, Programmierung und Lösungsdesign, enger Austausch mit Fachbereichen und Anwender:innen; bankfachliches Vorwissen ist ein Plus, den fachlichen Kontext bauen wir mit Dir gemeinsam auf.

Das bringst Du mit:

Title: Staff Data Analyst, Paid Search
Description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

This specific position sits within our Growth Analytics team, whose objective is to scale marketing investment toward the most incremental and loyal customers. The role is focused on our paid search channel where black-box auction dynamics, branded vs non-branded incrementality, and elasticity modelling define the analytical problem. The successful candidate will also contribute to cross-channel measurement questions as they arise.

Your mission


Develop quantitative analysis and statistical models to evaluate and steer marketing decisions
Propose and defend strategic recommendations to our top marketing leads
Setup and analyse marketing experiments to drive strategic decision making
Explore large datasets, give meaning to data and numbers, identify opportunities and issues, and present findings to stakeholders
Maintain and improve our marketing measurement tools (Attribution, experimentation framework, Customer lifetime value…)
Serve as a liaison between the marketing teams and the data engineering team
Mentor others in the skills needed for this role
Use AI to accelerate end-to-end analysis — from framing the question to delivering the insight — while holding a high bar for methodological rigor and validation


Your toolkit


8+ years of relevant experience interpreting data in an analytics or data science role
Prior experience analysing paid search and/or SEO performance, using platforms such as Google Ads/Search.
Strong knowledge of SQL and Python for analysis (eg, pandas, scikit-learn, pyspark)
Hands-on experience with causal inference methods (e.g. geo experiments, difference-in-differences, synthetic controls) and/or elasticity modelling applied to marketing spend decisions.
Ability to understand user behavior and meaning behind the numbers and a track record in sharing insights to business stakeholders.
Experience identifying where AI could meaningfully improve your team's analytics workflows or tooling, not just your own output.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g. Looker, Jupyter Notebooks, Databricks).
Desire to work in an international environment, with minimal direction and with highly engaged individuals
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English


How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary


Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
Monthly transportation and fitness budget
Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
Language reimbursement program
Health and wellness benefits


And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

Title: People Analytics Manager (m/f/x)
Description:
Scalable Capital is a leading digital investment and banking platform with a full banking licence, empowering people across Europe to shape their own finances. Scalable Broker makes it easy and affordable for clients to invest professionally in stocks, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, and derivatives, as well as set up savings plans. Scalable Wealth, the digital wealth management service, offers clients professional investment in ETF portfolios, and is also adopted as a white-label solution by banks and other B2B partners. The company’s offerings are rounded off by attractive interest rates, loans, and private equity. With the European Investor Exchange, Scalable Capital offers an exchange specifically for retail investors. Over one million clients have already entrusted more than €30 billion to the platform.



Founded in 2014, Scalable Capital now employs over 700 people across Munich, Berlin, Vienna, Milan, and London. Together with the founding and management team, including Erik Podzuweit and Florian Prucker, they are working on a new generation of financial services.



Visit our finance blog or check out our Social Media channels to find out what our Expert Teams have to say.



Our Company Values guide us every day in how we work and collaborate. To learn more about them, you can find our values here (English).





Job Description



At Scalable, we use data to make better decisions across our business, including People. As our first dedicated People Analytics hire, you will build the foundations for a data-driven People function.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will bring together People data, create reliable reporting, improve our People Tech stack, and turn data into insights that help leaders make informed decisions.





Build a trusted People data foundation by combining data from relevant source systems and ensuring data quality, privacy, and clear ownership
Design and maintain dashboards and reports for core People metrics, such as headcount, hiring, retention, employee lifecycle, and workforce planning
Partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and business leaders to translate business questions into meaningful analyses
Develop clear, actionable recommendations and communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders
Improve and expand our People Tech ecosystem to support reliable data flows and efficient People processes
Establish practical data governance standards for People data, including definitions, access, quality checks, and privacy requirements
Identify opportunities to develop forecasting and predictive analytics capabilities as the data foundation matures
Shape Scalable’s People Analytics and People Tech foundations from day one with a dedicated budget for analytics tooling and continuous learning
Work in close collaboration with People, Finance, and business leadership to directly improve decision-making, employee experience, and business growth


Qualifications


Experience in People Analytics, People Data Management, Business Intelligence, or a comparable data analytics role
Strong SQL skills and experience with data visualisation tools, such as Metabase, Tableau, or Power BI
Experience working with HR systems and integrating data from multiple sources
A sound understanding of data architecture, data quality, data governance, and privacy principles
Ability to explain complex data clearly and turn findings into practical recommendations
Experience with Python or R is a plus, especially for advanced analytics
Fluent English skills. German is a plus
This role requires you to be based in Munich or Berlin and work from one of our office locations


Additional Information


Be part of one of the fastest-growing and most visible Fintech startups in Europe, creating innovative services that have a substantial impact on the lives of our customers
Work with an international, diverse, inclusive, and ever-growing team that loves creating the best products for our clients
Be productive with the latest hardware and tools
Learn and grow by joining our in-house knowledge sharing or career development sessions and spending your individual Education Budget
Learn and experience German culture first hand by joining our free German language classes
Opportunity to work from abroad
Benefit from an attractive compensation package and from the company pension scheme
Monthly contribution of 50% for the ‘Deutschland Jobticket’
Say goodbye to order commissions and say hello to your complimentary subscription of Scalable Capital's PRIME+ Broker
Enjoy flexible and discounted sports activities with Urban Sports Club

Scalable Broker makes it easy and affordable for clients to invest professionally in stocks, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, and derivatives, as well as set up savings plans. Scalable Wealth, the digital wealth management service, offers clients professional investment in ETF portfolios, and is also adopted as a white-label solution by banks and other B2B partners. The company’s offerings are rounded off by attractive interest rates, loans, and private equity. With the European Investor Exchange, Scalable Capital offers an exchange specifically for retail investors. Over one million clients have already entrusted more than €30 billion to the platform.



Founded in 2014, Scalable Capital now employs over 700 people across Munich, Berlin, Vienna, Milan, and London. Together with the founding and management team, including Erik Podzuweit and Florian Prucker, they are working on a new generation of financial services.

Visit our finance blog or check out our Social Media channels to find out what our Expert Teams have to say.



Our Company Values guide us every day in how we work and collaborate. To learn more about them, you can find our values here (English).



Job Description

At Scalable, we use data to make better decisions across our business, including People. As our first dedicated People Analytics hire, you will build the foundations for a data-driven People function.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will bring together People data, create reliable reporting, improve our People Tech stack, and turn data into insights that help leaders make informed decisions.



  • Build a trusted People data foundation by combining data from relevant source systems and ensuring data quality, privacy, and clear ownership
  • Design and maintain dashboards and reports for core People metrics, such as headcount, hiring, retention, employee lifecycle, and workforce planning
  • Partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and business leaders to translate business questions into meaningful analyses
  • Develop clear, actionable recommendations and communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders
  • Improve and expand our People Tech ecosystem to support reliable data flows and efficient People processes
  • Establish practical data governance standards for People data, including definitions, access, quality checks, and privacy requirements
  • Identify opportunities to develop forecasting and predictive analytics capabilities as the data foundation matures
  • Shape Scalable’s People Analytics and People Tech foundations from day one with a dedicated budget for analytics tooling and continuous learning
  • Work in close collaboration with People, Finance, and business leadership to directly improve decision-making, employee experience, and business growth

Qualifications

  • Experience in People Analytics, People Data Management, Business Intelligence, or a comparable data analytics role
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with data visualisation tools, such as Metabase, Tableau, or Power BI
  • Experience working with HR systems and integrating data from multiple sources
  • A sound understanding of data architecture, data quality, data governance, and privacy principles
  • Ability to explain complex data clearly and turn findings into practical recommendations
  • Experience with Python or R is a plus, especially for advanced analytics
  • Fluent English skills. German is a plus
  • This role requires you to be based in Munich or Berlin and work from one of our office locations

Additional Information

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing and most visible Fintech startups in Europe, creating innovative services that have a substantial impact on the lives of our customers
  • Work with an international, diverse, inclusive, and ever-growing team that loves creating the best products for our clients
  • Be productive with the latest hardware and tools
  • Learn and grow by joining our in-house knowledge sharing or career development sessions and spending your individual Education Budget
  • Learn and experience German culture first hand by joining our free German language classes
  • Opportunity to work from abroad
  • Benefit from an attractive compensation package and from the company pension scheme
  • Monthly contribution of 50% for the ‘Deutschland Jobticket’
  • Say goodbye to order commissions and say hello to your complimentary subscription of Scalable Capital's PRIME+ Broker
  • Enjoy flexible and discounted sports activities with Urban Sports Club

Title: Senior Growth Analyst - Spark
Description:
WhyBrilliant is sourcing applicants for this role on behalf of a leading Berlin-based productivity software scale-up.

The company's identity may stay confidential until first contact.

Atlas, our AI Recruiter, is running this search and will pick the best candidates from Nova's network. The next step is to speak to Nova.

The Role

Job Title: Senior Growth Analyst - Spark

Location: Berlin, Germany

Why this role matters

Our email client is scaling fast, and we need to move from tracking data to aggressively predicting and validating what drives growth. Without this role, our product and marketing teams cannot rapidly iterate, run quasi-experiments, or build the deep causal inference models needed to unlock our next stage of subscription revenue. You will be the critical engine that turns raw user touchpoints into strategic, high-impact product decisions.

What You'll Do

You will own the entire growth loop analytics for our email client, ensuring every stage from first ad impression to long-term subscription renewal is fully measurable.


Design robust event tracking structures and instrumentation to ensure flawless measurement across the entire user journey.
Build and maintain growth dashboards in Tableau or Looker that make acquisition and retention performance crystal clear for cross-functional teams.
Uncover growth opportunities by digging deep into funnels, user cohorts, and subscription metrics like churn and LTV.
Design and execute A/B tests, quasi-experiments, and causal inference models to validate marketing and product hypotheses.
Deploy advanced forecasting models using Python or R to predict long-term subscription dynamics and trend lines.


What success looks like

Month 1: You will deeply integrate with the product and marketing teams, audit our current data pipelines in BigQuery and tracking setups in Amplitude and AppsFlyer, and identify immediate tracking improvements.

Month 2-3: You will take full ownership of our growth dashboards, design and launch your first batch of A/B tests and quasi-experiments, and establish a standardized methodology for measuring marketing attribution.

By end of Q1: You will have built a reliable, end-to-end subscription analytics framework that clearly connects first-click marketing attribution to long-term cohort retention, enabling swift, data-backed product decisions.

Who This Is a Fit For


Have 5+ years of analytics experience in B2C mobile apps or subscription SaaS.
Expert-level SQL wizard with hands-on experience in cloud data warehouses like BigQuery.
Fluent in visualization and product analytics tools like Tableau, Looker, and Amplitude.
Experienced with mobile marketing attribution mechanics using platforms like AppsFlyer or Adjust.
Proficient in Python or R for time-series forecasting and causal inference.
Thrive on high autonomy, taking full personal responsibility for product outcomes.


What it's like to work here

The company's culture is rooted in deep customer-centricity and continuous professional growth, with a massive emphasis on individual autonomy and ownership. Team members are expected to drive their own initiatives and take full responsibility for product outcomes. Decision-making is highly collaborative yet swift, heavily guided by data analysis, rapid iteration, and continuous experimentation to validate product hypotheses. This role sits at the intersection of product and marketing, demanding a proactive builder who thrives on fast feedback loops and constant adaptation.

The offer


Work in our Berlin office within a culture that prioritizes your professional growth.
Massive autonomy to drive your own initiatives and experiments.
A highly collaborative environment that values data-backed, swift decision-making.


This probably isn't for you if


You prefer waiting for tasks to be assigned rather than proactively finding growth opportunities.
You struggle to make decisions without absolute certainty or dislike rapid, constant iteration.
You want a pure modeling role without getting your hands dirty with event-tracking design.


Who are Atlas & Nova?

I'll go first. I'm Nova, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call — what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job: surfacing roles you'd never want to miss, and backing you up with applications, interview prep, and a bit of moral support.

And I'm Atlas, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand exactly who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Nova's network and make an introduction the moment I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?

Nova is an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. She works for you.

Atlas is the AI recruiter working for the company. He recruits from Nova's network.

If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Nova will keep sending you strong alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. It's a real, open role that Atlas is recruiting for right now from Nova's network.

Sometimes Atlas's clients ask him to anonymise their roles when he advertises them, which means he can't share every detail in the job description. We know that can make a post look a little vague — but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Nova a try. You could land this role. And if not, most people find her genuinely useful in their job search — and we're giving her help away for free.

This job is hosted on whybrilliant.com. Use your LinkedIn profile to register on WhyBrilliant.com and apply for the role directly.

Title: Decision Scientist, Payments Intelligence
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

As a Decision Scientist, you will work in a cross-functional Payments Intelligence team that supports all Payments Business Unit across different domains. This role is part of the Data Science & Analytics (DSA) function, reporting to the DSA Manager for Payments Intelligence. You will play a key role in shaping our payments products by leveraging data to drive impactful decision-making.

Currently, Payments is a quickly growing business area, which brings its own challenges and opportunities. To be successful and satisfied in this role, you need to be comfortable with a fast pace and continuous change. In return, you get to build something really big together with other driven and caring colleagues.

In this position, you’ll


Partner with your team and stakeholders at Vinted, to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations, as well as answer critical business questions.
Test and analyse developed opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools
Select, calculate, and monitor key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses and understanding root causes
Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards
Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.


About You


Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role
Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact
Familiarity with SQL and Python
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques
Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes
Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences
Fluent in English, both written and spoken


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
30 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per your workday
Frequent team-building events
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
Supplemental Private Health Insurance
Life and Disability insurance
A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€69.600—€100.100 EUR

Title: Finance Data & Systems Analyst (FP&A)
Description:
Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience.

At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives.

Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation!

We are currently looking for a Finance Data & Systems Analyst who will be integral to driving high-level performance across Lovehoney Group. Partnering directly with Finance, FP&A, and Data teams, your focus will be on enabling better decision-making through reliable data, advanced analytics, and digital solutions. In this role, you will combine your understanding of Finance processes with your analytical expertise and ability to drive automation, AI adoption, and continuous improvement across Finance.

What You Will Do

Finance Data & Analytics:


Act as the Finance representative and key business partner for collaboration with the Data team, ensuring Finance requirements are understood and translated into scalable data solutions.
Partner with stakeholders across Finance to identify data needs, improve reporting capabilities, and enable data-driven decision-making.
Develop, maintain, and optimise Finance datasets, reports, and dashboards to provide accurate and actionable insights.
Support data quality, governance, and documentation initiatives to ensure consistency and transparency of Finance data.
As part of the payment processing commercial team, lead the development of KPI dashboards and ensure that insights, drivers and performance trends are communicated to stakeholders regularly.



FP&A Systems / Pigment:


Own the development and maintenance of Pigment models, including understanding and managing infrastructure, data flows, and dimensions.
Manage and prioritize Pigment tickets and improvement requests from the FP&A team, ensuring timely resolution and continuous improvement of the platform.
Support the team in leveraging Pigment capabilities effectively for budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analysis.
Run regular reporting from Pigment.



Automation & AI:


Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve efficiency through data solutions and technology.
Drive the adoption and responsible use of AI within Finance by identifying relevant use cases, supporting implementation, and promoting AI-enabled ways of working.



What You Should Bring

Essential:


Understanding of Finance processes and business performance management.
Experience building and maintaining BI solutions and dashboards.
Experience acting as a bridge between Finance teams and Data/Technology teams.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with data platforms and analytical tools.
Understanding of data flows, data models, and reporting infrastructure.
Experience managing priorities, resolving issues, and supporting users of digital platforms.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Structured, problem-solving mindset with a continuous improvement approach.



Desirable:


Experience of FP&A and hands-on experience with FP&A systems (such as Pigment, Anaplan, Workday, Vena, etc), including model structure, dimensions, and data integrations.
Experience of working with ERP data would be beneficial.
Interest and experience in applying AI and automation to improve business processes.
Payment processing reporting experience.



What We Can Offer You


A welcoming workplace full of drinks, snacks, friendly faces and fun team-building events.
Access to unique discounts at high street retailers, hotels, and service providers, in addition to a 50% discount on all Lovehoney products to explore and discover new ways to have fun.
Enjoy a hybrid work model that fosters flexibility and work-life balance, with three days per week in-office and the opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, alongside 25 days’ holiday, plus an additional day for each year you are with Lovehoney, providing ample time for relaxation, rejuvenation, and exploration.
Access to customized training opportunities to support your unique learning journey, complemented by biannual feedback cycles, offering valuable insights into your performance and growth areas, enhancing your development within the company.
Recognising the significance of physical and mental health, we proudly provide gym benefits in addition to a mental wellbeing platform, to ensure our employees thrive both professionally and personally.
Stay secure at work and at home with a complimentary 1Password Family account. All Lovehoney Group employees can invite up to five family members to join, offering your household a safe and simple way to manage passwords and sensitive information safely and easily.



Our interview process


CV review
Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Team Members
Hiring Manager Interview (MS Teams)
Hiring Team Interview, including tasks (onsite)
Leadership Interview (MS Teams)



Lovehoney Group is an equal opportunities employer. We promise that every qualified person will be evaluated according to skills regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

If you require accommodations during the interview process due to a disability, please inform your Talent Acquisition Specialist so that we can ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates.

At Lovehoney Group, we embrace innovative technologies to enhance our recruitment process. We leverage artificial intelligence during screening interviews for CV reviews and note-taking. We prioritize transparency and respect your preferences, so you'll have the option to opt out of recording and AI-driven note-taking while still receiving full and fair consideration for the role.

We currently have a hybrid work model supporting a blend of in-office and remote work (3 days per week in-office).

If we sparked your interest and you are open to embarking on your professional path with us, please visit our Lovehoney careers page to apply: https://jobs.eu.lever.co/lovehoneygroup

Our privacy policy is available here: https://www.lovehoneygroup.com/privacy-policy/

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Senior Quantitative Analyst
Description:
About Schumacher

Schumacher & Co. is an innovative interior design company that is disrupting the$150 billion-dollar global interior design industry. We are a technological leader on the design frontier, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. With over 500+ employees and growing, we are driven by a shared belief that design transforms life.We are dedicated to the mission of helping our customers “celebrate the feeling of home”. F. Schumacher & Co designs and produces some of the most beautiful fabrics, wallcoverings, trims, rugs, furniture, and accessories in the world. Our portfolio of products is broad, but they are united by a passion for design, a thirst for what is next, an appreciation for what’s come before, a drive to make our products with enormous care and attention for detail. F. Schumacher & Co is a globally recognized company with a myriad of showrooms both domestically and internationally.

Our Competitive Advantage In The Industry Is Our People. We Believe That Our Employees Are Our Most Important Assets. F. Schumacher & Co Is Deeply Anchored In Our Company Core Values Which Are As Follows


Preserve Our Entrepreneurial Spirit
Take Ownership & Accountability
Be Solutions-Oriented
Demonstrate Courage
Practice Adaptability
Embrace Collaboration


We empower our employees to live these values daily because we understand how it will positively impact the customer's journey. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company to many brands within our portfolio. This role is a 12 month contract and is a part of Data Insights & AI team

Role Overview

We're looking for a hands-on, Senior Quantitative Analyst, Product Portfolio (Statistical Modeling) to own analytics and reporting in support of our Portfolio Development team, with a specific focus on SKU productivity & capital allocation across a portfolio of 20,000+ SKUs and growing. This role will report directly to the Sr. Director of AI & Data Insights, but is expected to work directly with the CEO & Chief of Staff on a day-to-day basis.

This is not a role for someone who takes data at face value. You'll need to distinguish real signal from noise (e.g., a SKU selling poorly because it's out of stock, not because demand is weak), and when you find data that's wrong or inconsistent, you'll have the access and judgment to go into Snowflake and fix it — not just flag it and wait.

What You’ll Do


Work hands-on with CEO & Product Strategy stakeholders to understand key strategic questions, and then build analysis and reporting to address them directly
Use statistical methods (e.g. conjoint analysis, multivariate regression) to identify which product attributes and characteristics (e.g., color, pattern, material, price point, availability) drive productivity, and translate that into data-driven guidance on where the portfolio should expand, contract or shift
Cut through data noise at scale: systematically identify and control for confounders like stock-outs, new/discontinued SKUs, and seasonality so reported trends reflect real pattern performance
Identify data inconsistencies at the source (e.g., ERP, web, product master data) and directly and systematically correct records in Snowflake and work with upstream platform owners to improve the accuracy of source data and downstream analytics
Present findings clearly and independently to executive audiences, adapting the message for technical or non-technical stakeholders
Recommend and maintain recurring analytics & reporting to provide accurate and timely snapshot of SKU productivity
Use AI across your own workflow to explore data faster, automate repetitive reporting, catch errors, and multiply output given the scale and growth of the SKU portfolio


What We're Looking For


2-5 years in data science, analytics, statistics in similar SKU-driven businesses
Solid grounding in statistics or operations research (e.g. regression, hypothesis testing, multivariate analysis, optimization). Able to move beyond descriptive reporting to model relationships between variables and quantify drivers, not just flag correlations
Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on Snowflake experience including writing back to correct or clean production data (not just read-only querying)
A track record of presenting findings and challenging assumptions directly with senior stakeholders and executives
Independent executor — sets analysis priorities against business goals without waiting for direction, and ships accurate, high-impact work in a timely manner
Curiosity — asks why the numbers look the way they do and keeps digging until the answer holds up, rather than reporting the first number that looks plausible
Thinks in terms of SKU-level economics: sell-through, margin, inventory position, lifecycle stage — and knows how to separate a true productivity problem from a data artifact
Treats data quality as part of the job, digging into root causes and correcting them directly rather than working around bad data
Hands-on experience applying AI/ML in a business context for task automation - automating repetitive analysis to spend more time on judgment calls
Strong English communication skills and a high ownership mindset


Nice to Have


Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools alongside Snowflake
Exposure to margin, pricing, or demand forecasting data
Experience in retail, e-commerce, or luxury/home furnishings goods


What We Offer


Competitive salary and benefits, based on experience
Fully remote work within Europe, with optional time in our NYC office (1–2 weeks per year)
Direct visibility with the CEO, with real influence on Product Strategy and Merchandising decisions
Collaborative, inclusive, and low-ego working environment


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and equality in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical and mental disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/assignment, citizenship, pregnancy or maternity, protected veteran status, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

Title: Consultant Data Analytics Global Transformation Tax (w/m/d)
Description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Steuerberatung suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt  als Consultant Data Analytics Global Transformation Tax (w/m/d). Das erwartet dichTeam – Als Teil unseres Global Transformation Tax Teams arbeitest du gemeinsam mit Kolleg:innen aus Tax, Tech und Finance an innovativen End-to-End-Lösungen, die Unternehmen fit für externe regulatorische Anforderungen und die interne Transformation machen.Analyse – Du entwickelst clevere, pragmatische Lösungsansätze zur Strukturierung, Verarbeitung und Validierung von Finanzdaten.Automatisierung – Mit Tools wie der Microsoft Power Platform oder Alteryx entwickelst du smarte Workflows und Prototypen – z. B. für Pillar 2, Tax Control Frameworks oder andere Compliance-Herausforderungen.Visualisierung – Du kreierst interaktive Dashboards und Reports in Power BI, die für die Steuerfunktion und das Management aus Finanzdaten wertvolle Erkenntnisse generieren.Integration – Du verknüpfst Tools, Datenquellen und Systeme – sei es via API, komplexer Datenmodelle oder Connector. Das bringst du mit
Du hast deinen Masterabschluss in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs (bald) abgeschlossen.
Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung z. B. durch Praktika, Uni-Projekte oder Selbststudium mit Datenverarbeitung, Datenmodellierung und -visualisierung und verfügst über solide Kenntnisse in Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps und idealerweise Python.
Du liebst es, mit Zahlen zu arbeiten, Tools auszuprobieren und kreative Lösungen zu finden.
Du bringst Neugier, Eigeninitiative und echten Teamgeist mit.
Du beherrschst die Sprache Deutsch auf dem Level C2 und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
 

 

Deine Benefits

Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.Berufsexamen – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Zusätzlich unterstützen wir dich bei dem Erlangen der Berufsexamina: Wirtschaftsprüfer:in, Voll-WP, Steuerberater:in und Aktuar:in. Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung. Gesundheit – Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von vergünstigten Beiträgen in diversen Fitnessstudios oder einer Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft. Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.   Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Corporate Tax Teams behältst du bei nationalen und internationalen Steuerthemen den Durchblick für unsere Mandanten: Von der Buchführung und Steuererklärung über Restrukturierungen bis hin zu grenzüberschreitenden Transaktionen. Dafür sind deine Expertise und deine Ideen gefragt. Mit einem tollen Team an deiner Seite erlebst du eine erfrischende Mischung aus der Arbeit mit Zahlen und dem direkten Kontakt zu unseren Mandanten.  Kontakt Du hast Fragen zu dieser Position oder deiner Bewerbung?Melde dich gerne bei Alisa Kullmann unter +49 69 95852697.

Title: Referent Data Science & Reporting (m/w/d)
Description:
S-Kreditpartner – unser Name ist Programm. Und der macht auf den ersten Blick deutlich: Wir gehören zur Familie der Sparkassen. Als spezialisierter Verbundpartner bündeln wir die Aktivitäten für die Auto- und Konsumentenfinanzierung. Gemeinsam mit unseren Vertriebspartnern wollen wir die Position der Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe in diesen Geschäftsfeldern stärken.

Als Referent (m/w/d) Data Scientist gestaltest Du die Banksteuerung aktiv mit und machst aus komplexen Daten klare Entscheidungsgrundlagen. Du entwickelst einheitliche Reportingstrukturen und moderne BI‑Lösungen, übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in tragfähige Analyse- und Reportingkonzepte und sorgst für eine konsistente, transparente und adressatengerechte Berichterstattung für Management und Fachbereiche. Gemeinsam mit den Schnittstellen in der Bank treibst Du die Weiterentwicklung von Kennzahlen-Cockpits, Dashboards und Reporting-Standards voran – und leistest so einen direkten Beitrag zu einer effizienten und zukunftsorientierten Steuerung.

Klingt spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt als

Referent Data Science & Reporting (m/w/d)

Deine Aufgaben


Beratung und Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden in der Banksteuerung bei Reporting- und Analysefragestellungen
Aufbau, Vereinheitlichung und Weiterentwicklung der Reportingstrukturen sowie der eingesetzten Analyse- und Berichtstools
Definition, Abstimmung und laufende Weiterentwicklung von Best Practices, Qualitätsstandards im Reporting
Sicherstellung einer konsistenten, transparenten und adressatengerechten Berichterstattung für Management, Fachbereiche und weitere Stakeholder
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fachabteilungen zur Aufnahme, Priorisierung und Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in konkrete Reporting-Lösungen
Koordination und Mitarbeit bei System- und Integrationstests im Reporting- und BI-Umfeld sowie Unterstützung beim Aufbau von Kennzahlen-Cockpits, Dashboards und Standardreports
Mitwirkung an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Datenqualität im Reporting in enger Abstimmung mit den datenverarbeitenden Einheiten


Dein Profil


Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich (Wirtschafts‑)Informatik, Mathematik oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit IT‑Schwerpunkt – oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Mehrjährige, einschlägige Praxiserfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Data-Analytics- und BI‑Lösungen im Banking- oder Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld
Fundierte Kenntnisse in BI-Technologien (idealerweise PowerBI; alternativ Tableau, Qlik o. Ä.) sowie in SQL, Datenmodellen und relationalen Datenbanken
Erfahrung im Aufbau standardisierter Reportingstrukturen (Management-Reports, Risikoreports, KPI‑Cockpits) sowie Kenntnisse bankfachlicher KPIs und Risikokennzahlen
Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie Kommunikationsstärke gegenüber Fachbereichen und Management
Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich und adressatengerecht aufzubereiten und zu präsentieren
Hohe Kundenorientierung, Proaktivität und Hands-on-Mentalität


Deine Benefits


Vergütung & Finanzen: Attraktives Gehalt (tariflich) 13. Monatsgehalt im Tarif, Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Vermögenswirksame Leistungen, Essenszulage
Work-Life-Balance & Flexibilität: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub und Bankfeiertage (24.12./31.12.), flexible Arbeitszeiten, Home-Office bzw. mobiles Arbeiten
Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden: JobRad, pme-Familienservice, moderne Hardware-Ausstattung, medizinische Vorsorge und Bildschirmarbeitsplatzbrille
Entwicklung & Community: Weiterbildungen, Karrieremöglichkeiten, Welcome-Veranstaltung, Events

Title: Sales Operations Analyst, Enterprise and Data Center EMEA (m/f/d)
Description:
Requisition Number: 78055

The company built on breakthroughs.   

Join us.  

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.    

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.   

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.   

Come break through with us. 

Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.

For our EMEA commercial organization headquartered in Berlin, Germany, we are currently looking for a

Sales Operations Analyst, Enterprise and Data Center EMEA (m/f/d)

Purpose Of The Position

The Sales Operations Analyst will support the EMEA Enterprise and Data Center commercial organization by maintaining accurate sales data, preparing standard reports and dashboards, supporting pipeline and forecast processes, administering sales operations tools, and assisting with sales incentive program (SIP) activities. This B-band analyst role is focused on reliable execution, data quality, reporting support, process coordination, and practical analysis that helps sales teams and managers make timely business decisions.

Position Responsibilities


Prepare and maintain recurring sales reports, dashboards, and performance summaries to support visibility into sales results, pipeline health, forecast status, and commercial activity.
Support pipeline and forecast processes by collecting inputs, validating data, highlighting gaps or inconsistencies, and following up on agreed actions with sales teams and managers.
Improve CRM data quality by monitoring Salesforce entries, identifying incomplete or inconsistent information, and supporting users with basic guidance on sales process expectations.
Support sales effectiveness by helping identify process issues, reporting pain points, and opportunities to reduce non-selling administrative effort.
Translate sales data into clear summaries, charts, and presentations that help stakeholders understand trends, risks, opportunities, and required follow-up.
Support administration of the sales incentive program (SIP), including data preparation, performance tracking, report distribution, validation support, issue follow-up, and coordination with Sales, Finance, HR, and SIP program stakeholders.
Assist with sales compensation and incentive-related reporting by supporting credit assignment checks, attainment reporting, exclusions, accrual inputs, and related communications.
Support adoption of sales tools and processes by preparing user guidance, maintaining training materials, assisting with onboarding, and sharing standard work instructions.
Document process steps, maintain sales operations reference materials, and support continuous improvement activities under the guidance of sales operations or commercial leadership.
Partner with Commercial, Finance, Marketing, Customer Operations, HR, and IT colleagues to support consistent reporting, data accuracy, and timely execution of sales operations activities.


Required Education And Experience


Degree in business, economics, analytics, information systems, or a comparable field, or equivalent professional experience.
Early career experience in sales operations, commercial operations, finance, business analytics, customer operations, or a related business support function.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to organize data, create basic analyses, and prepare clear management-ready materials.
Experience with CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, or willingness and ability to quickly learn sales operations tools and processes.
Strong attention to detail, comfort working with data, and ability to follow defined processes accurately and consistently.
Ability to communicate clearly in written and spoken English and work effectively with colleagues across countries and functions.


Preferred Skills


Exposure to sales incentive, quota, attainment, commission, or sales compensation reporting processes.
Experience using Salesforce, Power BI, SAP, SharePoint, or similar reporting, workflow, or business systems.
Understanding of B2B sales processes, pipeline management, forecasting, customer segmentation, or commercial planning.
Interest in process improvement, automation, standard work, and practical simplification of recurring business activities.
Additional European language skills may be helpful but are not required.


Key Competencies


Analytical and detail-oriented, with a strong focus on accuracy, consistency, and data quality.
Organized and dependable, with the ability to manage recurring deadlines and follow through on open items.
Curious and proactive, with a willingness to learn business processes, tools, and commercial data structures.
Collaborative and service-minded, with the ability to support sales teams and cross-functional stakeholders professionally.
Able to work independently on assigned tasks while knowing when to escalate questions, risks, or exceptions.


Travel Requirements

Limited travel may be required for team meetings, training, or regional business reviews.

A job that shapes a life.

Corning offers you the total package.

Your well-being is our top priority. Our Compensation & Benefits package supports your health and well-being, your financial goals, and your career—from day one.


Company-wide bonuses and long-term incentive programs are linked to key business results, ensuring you're rewarded when the company succeeds. When Corning wins, we all win.
Our health and well-being benefits include company-funded retirement plan, paid leave, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support you and your family.
Getting paid for our work is important, but feeling valued and recognized motivates us even more. That's why Corning offers a recognition program to celebrate achievements and recognize colleagues who deliver exceptional performance.


Corning is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and considers requests for reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable laws. Individuals with disabilities or sincerely held religious beliefs may request reasonable accommodations to participate in the application or interview process, perform essential job functions, or access other benefits and privileges of employment. To submit a request for reasonable accommodation related to disability or religion, please contact us at accommodations@corning.com .

Title: Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x) in the field of AI & Satellite Data
Description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

LiveEO uses satellite data and AI to monitor critical infrastructure at scale. As a Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x), you’ll sit at the heart of our operations, working with geospatial and satellite data to make sure our analytics projects are delivered reliably, accurately, and on time.

You’ll work closely with Project Managers, our Operations Support Studio, engineers, and product teams - investigating data, understanding our analytics pipelines, solving delivery issues, and helping us continuously improve how our technology performs in real-world use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure.

This role is a maternity leave cover and is offered on a fixed-term contract for 1 year.

Your challenge


Analyze, validate, and interpret geospatial and satellite data across global customer projects
Take ownership of analytics deliveries and help ensure high technical quality and reliability
Understand and adapt to different analytics use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure
Investigate data and pipeline issues, identify root causes, and communicate findings clearly to engineering teams
Work closely with engineers, Project Managers, and the Operations Support Studio to resolve issues and keep deliveries moving
Develop a strong end-to-end understanding of our analytics pipelines and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and quality
Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams when you identify recurring issues or opportunities for improvement
Use AI coding and analysis tools such as Claude or Cursor for data validation, pipeline debugging, and analysis - while critically validating their output before acting on it
Work with tools and technologies including QGIS, Python, SQL, AWS, remote sensing tools, and large-scale geospatial datasets


Your profile


A degree in geoinformatics, remote sensing, geography, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, or another quantitative/technical field
Hands-on experience working with geospatial data and GIS tools, ideally QGIS
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex data or technical issues in a structured way
A high level of ownership and self-management - you ask questions, seek clarity, and proactively move problems toward resolution
Comfortable using AI coding and analysis tools as part of your daily work, while applying your own judgement to verify results
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and customer requirements can change
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
A collaborative working style and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
You live in Berlin or are willing to relocate


Nice to have:


Experience with Python and SQL
Remote sensing / Earth Observation experience
Experience with geodatabases and large-scale data management
AWS or other cloud infrastructure experience
Machine learning or deep learning knowledge
Software engineering experience
Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Prefect


Your Benefits


The opportunity to work with satellite and geospatial data on real-world infrastructure challenges across the globe and contribute directly to how LiveEO delivers its analytics products.
We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.
Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest.
A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons, with the opportunity to learn across geospatial analytics, AI and satellite technology.
Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.
Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.
Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, Jobrad, corporate pension program.
A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities.


About Us

LiveEO is a well funded startup founded in 2018 and based in Berlin. Our primary service is modelling risk to our customers’ assets and infrastructure from vegetation, ground deformation and change detection. We currently have around 160 employees from all over the world with a variety of backgrounds
