Title: Senior Business Analyst, Content Analytics
Description:
Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As a Senior Business Analyst within the Content Analytics team at Audible, you'll serve as an analytical leader and trusted thought partner for our senior Content leadership team, as well as the primary analytics conduit for European Content teams. You'll be responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving the analytical frameworks and reporting processes that deliver critical KPIs and business insights across our organization.

Working in complex and often ambiguous problem spaces, you'll transform multi-source data into clear, actionable recommendations that drive long-term strategy. Your deep expertise in the Content business — spanning audiobooks, physical books, and/or other digital media — will allow you to proactively anticipate leadership questions and surface insights before they're asked. As a content data SME, you'll help drive data quality standards within your domain while making insights readily accessible through efficient, scalable, self-service solutions.

About You

You are an analytical leader who balances technical expertise with deep business acumen, particularly within the world of content. You excel at working cross-functionally, translating complex business challenges into robust analytical frameworks and long-term solutions. You're naturally curious, with a talent for looking beyond immediate data requests to identify the underlying strategic questions driving our Content business forward.

You thrive in ambiguous situations, delivering independently with strong judgment while continuously raising the bar on data processes and analytical best practices. Your communication skills are exceptional — you distill complex analyses into compelling, influential narratives for both technical and executive audiences. You build strong, trust-based relationships with stakeholders that position your insights to meaningfully influence business strategy and decision-making across the organization.

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will...


Proactively identify complex or ambiguous business problems and serve as a thought partner to senior Content leadership — anticipating questions, designing long-term analytics solutions, and developing analyses and visualizations that address emerging business needs before they're raised
Design and own end-to-end reporting processes that track KPIs, support business reviews, and enable self-serve data access — ensuring speed, reliability, and scalability; break down high-level metrics into constituent components and leading indicators that generate actionable insights and recommendations for MBR/QBR/HBR cycles
Develop concise, impactful narratives and visualizations — including MBR/QBR documents and 6-pagers — that communicate complex trends, root cause analyses, and strategic recommendations to executive audiences; automate the identification of key dimensions driving metric variance to enable faster, more consistent analysis
Apply deep content domain expertise — spanning production, distribution, and audience engagement — alongside awareness of micro and macro industry trends in books and digital media, to ensure analytics solutions are grounded in real business context
Serve as the analytics conduit for European Content teams, facilitating analyses and surfacing insights that connect regional performance to Global team strategy
Partner cross-functionally with data scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers, product managers, and business leaders to align analytical solutions with strategic objectives; own the effective communication of metrics and analyses across your organization, and identify when to bring in technical partners to unlock new insights
Drive operational excellence and data governance by improving, streamlining, and/or eliminating excess processes; work with data owners to onboard new sources, guarantee data fidelity, and ensure consistency in metric definitions, documentation standards, and data quality
Mentor and develop peers within your organization, modeling analytical best practices in design, delivery, and long-term scalability; develop clear documentation that enables both technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand and replicate reporting methodologies


About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications


Knowledge of advanced skills in Excel as well as any data visualization tools like Tableau or similar BI tools (familiarity with Tableau preferred)
Experience in a data driven/analytical role
Experience delivering complex, end-to-end analytics solutions independently in ambiguous spaces, with track record of generating recommendations that influenced organizational strategy
Content-related experience, ideally with audiobooks, physical books, and/or other digital media
Experience building relationships and running projects across multiple functions with diverse stakeholder groups


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting executive reporting and business reviews, including ownership of MBR/QBR narratives or equivalent documents
Demonstrated ability to drive operational excellence through process improvement, automation, or streamlining of data and business processes
Understanding of data governance principles and practices, including metric definition standardization and data quality management
Experience partnering with Business Intelligence Engineers or Data Scientists to apply advanced analytics techniques and unlock new data sources
Ability to work a flexible schedule that occasionally accommodates US time zone meeting requirements
Experience working with or supporting European markets or cross-regional teams

We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Strategische Beratung von Market Access, HE&OR- und RWE-Abteilungen von führenden Pharmaunternehmen und Emerging Biotechs

Title: [GLOBAL/INT] [MARKETING] Principal Marketing Analyst (all genders)
Description:
About the role: What's in the Box

As Principal Marketing Analyst (all genders) you will serve as the primary strategic architect for the Global Reactivations function, moving beyond tactical execution to own the technical roadmap and measurement frameworks that drive high-level business strategy. You will bridge the gap between complex data ecosystems and executive decision-making, acting as a force who scales the impact of the entire analytics domain. Your expertise in CRM Analytics, combined with a knack for storytelling through data, will directly influence the ability to reduce churn impact and optimize our channels along with marketing spend.

What you’ll do: The Recipe


Partner with Marketing and Growth leadership to define KPI trees and measurement frameworks that align global reactivation efforts with long-term business goals.
Architect advanced analytics solutions using BigQuery, GA4, and behavioral datasets to uncover deep insights into churn patterns and lifecycle optimization.
Design and analyze rigorous A/B tests and incremental lift studies to ensure global marketing strategies are rooted in statistical truth and clear ROI.
Lead the integration of AI and automation tools to build scalable, self-service reporting assets that democratize data access across the organization.
Develop automated reporting and dashboards that democratize data access and enable self-service analytics.
Advocate for technical excellence by standardizing data schemas and mentoring junior analysts in SQL/Python best practices and peer review.
Translate complex statistical concepts into persuasive, executive-level narratives that influence strategic decision-making and global budget allocations.
Work with wider teams to analyse and provide recommendations based on customer lifecycle data.


What you’ll bring: The Ingredients


7+ years of experience in Customer/Marketing Analytics, including customer retention metrics, A/B testing, and analytics in fast-paced B2C or subscription-based businesses.
Advanced SQL & BigQuery expertise, including complex query writing, optimization, data modeling, and analysis of large-scale datasets.
Strong Python and Excel skills for data analysis, automation, and reporting (e.g., pandas, numpy, advanced formulas, pivot tables, dashboards) and ideally familarity with AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.
Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Google Data Studio, with experience presenting clear, actionable insights
Solid statistical and analytical capabilities, including regression, clustering, time series analysis, and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into structured, results-driven recommendations.
Collaborative, business-focused mindset and enthusiasm for solving customer engagement and retention challenges through data.
Ability to independently scope, prioritize, and deliver impactful solutions while balancing analytical rigor with speed.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to executives, defend data-driven recommendations, mentor and support others.


Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.


Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
Exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!


Are you the missing ingredient?

If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

Title: Senior Consultant Data Analytics & Business Insights (m/w/d)
Description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Du willst im Bereich Strategy, Risk & Transactions – Advisory – Mergers & Acquisitions Kunden entlang des gesamten M&A-Deal-Zyklus begleiten – von Strategie und Due Diligence über Finanzierungs- und Technologiefragen bis hin zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und Integration von Transaktionen? Unser Team unterstützt Mandanten beim Kauf, Verkauf oder Zusammenschluss von Unternehmen - strategisch, finanziell und rechtlich. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Senior Consultant Data Analytics & Business Insights (m/w/d).

Standorte: Berlin, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt (Main), Hamburg und München.

Dein Impact:

Als Senior Consultant Data Analytics & Business Insights (m/w/d) berätst du Mandanten bei komplexen M&A-Transaktionen – und kombinierst dabei Finance-Expertise mit Data Analytics, um nachhaltige Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen.


Data Analytics: Mit Hilfe modernster Analytics-Methoden bereitest du große Datenmengen effizient auf, erkennst Muster und prüfst Hypothesen datenbasiert – unterstützt durch unsere etablierten Best Practices.
Datenmuster: Du identifizierst Datenmuster, um aufgestellte Hypothesen zu prüfen, und verknüpfst entscheidungsrelevante Daten und Informationen.
Visualisierung: Interaktive Dashboards konzipierst du mit Business-Intelligence-Tools, sodass komplexe Finanzinformationen für Stakeholder verständlich dargestellt werden.
Stakeholder-Kommunikation: In deinen Projekten generierst du gemeinsam mit Data-Science-Experten wertschaffende Einblicke und kommunizierst datenbasierte Entscheidungsvorlagen an ausgewählte Stakeholder.
Dokumentation & Weiterbildung: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Investor Documents wie Data Books und Due-Diligence-Berichten und entwickelst dein Wissen zu neuen Technologien und Methoden kontinuierlich weiter.


Dein Skillset:


Sehr guter Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Finance, Accounting oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang sowie fundiertes betriebswirtschaftliches Fachwissen
Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich M&A oder Corporate Finance, idealerweise auch Carve-out- oder komplexe Deal-Erfahrungen
Fundiertes Wissen in Accounting, Financial Modeling und Unternehmensbewertung
Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen wie R, Python, SQL sowie Erfahrung mit Business-Intelligence-Tools wie Power BI oder Qlik Sense
Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift, Kommunikationsstärke und Präsentationssicherheit


Deine Chance:


Best-in-class Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University sowie im Rahmen individueller Qualifikationsangebote und Trainings
Umfassende Entwicklungschancen durch strukturierte Karriereplanung, Inclusive Leadership, Entsendungsprogramme, projektbasierte Job-Rotation sowie Förderung sozialen Engagements und Corporate Volunteering
Vereinbarkeit von Beruf & Familie dank Mobile Working & Teilzeit, Sabbaticals und Familienservice, z. B. zur Unterstützung für pflegende Angehörige, Elternzeit-Beratung und vielem mehr
Gesundheit & Fitness im Fokus durch regelmäßige Gesundheitstage, Kooperationen mit Fitness-Anbietern und die Unterstützung von Sport- und Teamevents
Attraktive Arbeitgeberleistungen inklusive Bike- und Pkw-Leasing, Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung sowie flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen wie z. B. Vertrauensarbeitszeit und EU Remote Working
Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur - u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

Unser Recruiting-Team freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (CV sowie Abitur-, Hochschul- und Arbeitszeugnisse) über unser Online-Formular. Ein Anschreiben und ein Bewerbungsfoto sind bei uns nicht erforderlich.

Description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Munich, Germany; Berlin, Germany; Frankfurt am Main, Germany; Hamburg, Germany.Minimum qualifications:


Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in media analytics, advertising sales, digital media and marketing, consulting, or financial analysis.


Preferred qualifications:


Experience in translating data into business recommendations, creating and delivering appealing insights-based presentations or business cases with clear recommendations and aligned with customers objectives.
Experience in data analyses and visualization (Google Sheets and Slides), scripting (Google SQL), Dashboard development (Looker Studio), and leverage AI for analytics.
Advertising experience from either the advertiser, agency or other media owner side.
Ability to work closely with multiple stakeholder and cross-functional teams and influence key stakeholders (internally and externally) across all levels.

Title: Controller (d/m/w) mit Data‑Science‑ und Automatisierungs‑Expertise
Description:
Du hast eine Leidenschaft für Zahlen, betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und datenbasierte Lösungen? Du verbindest fundiertes betriebswirtschaftliches Know-how mit fortgeschrittenen Data-Science-Kompetenzen und möchtest moderne Technologien wie RPA und KI gezielt im Controlling einsetzen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams in Kirchheim bei München oder Berlin als Controller mit Data-Science- und Automatisierungs-Expertise (d/m/w).

Was gibt es zu tun?


Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von KPI-Dashboards und Ad-hoc-Reports
Analyse von Soll-Ist-Abweichungen sowie Ableitung und Nachverfolgung geeigneter Maßnahmen
Erstellung von Szenario-Analysen als Grundlage für Investitions- und Unternehmensentscheidungen
Mitwirkung an Preis- und Rabattmodellen sowie an der Entwicklung datenbasierter Preisstrategien
Anwendung statistischer Methoden und Machine-Learning-Modelle zur Prognose von Umsatz-, Kosten- und Preisentwicklungen
Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Predictive-Analytics-Lösungen, beispielsweise für Preisoptimierung oder Kunden-Churn
Aufbereitung und Analyse von Daten einschließlich Feature Engineering und Modellvalidierung
Konzeption und Umsetzung von RPA-Lösungen, beispielsweise mit Power Automate, zur Automatisierung wiederkehrender Controlling-Aufgaben
Entwicklung und Einsatz KI-gestützter Tools zur Unterstützung von Controlling- und Geschäftsprozessen
Sicherstellung der Datenqualität und -konsistenz zwischen ERP-System, Data Warehouse und Analyse-Tools
Identifikation von Automatisierungspotenzialen sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung bestehender Prozesse
Definition und Pflege von Datenstandards und Reporting-Richtlinien


Das bringst du mit


Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
Idealerweise erste Berufserfahrung im Controlling oder Finanzwesen
Praktische Erfahrung in Data Science, insbesondere mit Python oder R, SQL und statistischen Methoden
Kenntnisse im Umgang mit RPA-Tools und Interesse an der Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen
Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Machine-Learning-Modellen oder KI-basierten Automatisierungslösungen
Erfahrung mit Power BI sowie idealerweise Kenntnisse in MS Business Central bzw. Dynamics
Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten und Analysen verständlich aufzubereiten und daraus relevante Business Insights abzuleiten
Freude daran, datenbasierte Handlungsempfehlungen zu entwickeln und Entscheidungsträger mit fundierten Analysen zu unterstützen
Selbstsicheres Auftreten und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im Austausch mit Fachabteilungen, IT und Management
Teamgeist, Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse


Bewirb dich bei uns - auch wenn du meinst, nicht alles erfüllen zu können, was hier steht. Gemeinsam entfalten wir nach und nach dein volles Potenzial!

Das bieten wir


Umfangreiche Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kollegen, ein tolles Team und Wertschätzung auf allen Ebenen
Spannende Perspektiven in einem Unternehmen mit stabilem Kerngeschäft und großem Wachstumspotential
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zu mobilem Arbeiten
Ein Unternehmen, das die Hunde der Mitarbeitenden willkommen heißt
Individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und unser Karriereprogramm „career sprint“ als Eintritt in die Fach- bzw. Führungslaufbahn
Gemeinsame Firmenevents, vergünstigte Nutzung von Sport- und Gesundheitseinrichtungen sowie Obst und Getränke

Description:
About Scrumconnect Consulting

Scrumconnect Consulting is a multi-award-winning digital consultancy, recognised for delivering impactful and innovative technology solutions across UK government departments. Our work has positively influenced the lives of over 40 million UK citizens.

We are passionate about user-centred design, agile delivery, and building digital services that make a real difference. Our teams work at the forefront of innovation, helping organisations transform and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions that truly matter.




Overview :




The Data Analyst will be responsible for analysing data, developing insightful dashboards, and providing data-driven insights to support informed decision-making.




Key Responsibilities & Skills

Report Design & Delivery

Advanced experience translating stakeholder requirements into intuitive, accessible dashboards and reports that enable self-service data exploration.
Strong experience with Microsoft Power BI, DAX and Excel to develop data models and create efficient, optimised and scalable reports and visualisations.
Ability to design dashboards that clearly communicate complex data and insights to a range of stakeholders.

Data Analysis & Synthesis

Strong experience integrating multiple data sources into a conformed data model for analysis.
Proficiency in SQL, Python, Power Query and M.
Experience in data cleansing, transformation and preparation for reporting and analysis.

Statistical Analysis & Techniques

Proven experience applying a broad range of statistical techniques to support data-driven decision-making.
Strong understanding of averages, standard deviation, correlation, regression and statistical significance testing.
Ability to interpret statistical results and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Technical Understanding of Dash boarding Products

Experience monitoring emerging technologies and assessing their potential application to dashboard and data visualisation products.
Ability to provide recommendations on tools and technologies that can improve reporting and data visualisation capabilities.

Key Skills: Power BI | DAX | Excel | SQL | Python | Power Query | M | Data Modelling | Data Visualisation | Statistical Analysis

At Scrumconnect Consulting, we believe that diversity drives innovation and better outcomes. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every individual is valued, respected, and supported.

As a Disability Confident Level 1 employer, we are committed to providing reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process and during employment to ensure equal opportunities for all.

Title: Audience Data Analyst
Description:
Salary: Up to £41,440 per annum based on skills and experience
Full time; 40 hours per week
Permanent position
Based in: Covent Garden, London.


The Royal Ballet and Opera, situated in our Covent Garden theatre has been at the heart of London and British cultural life for three centuries. We are home to two world-class Companies: The Royal Ballet and The Royal Opera.

The Royal Opera House describes the place we work, not who we are. The whole is always more than the sum of its parts – we may be a House, but three quarters of our audiences experience what we do outside this building. While our Covent Garden theatre is the nerve centre, the impact and influence of the organisation can be felt in every corner of the country, and around the world. Understanding our global audience (their behaviours, preferences and habits) is central to our mission to engage more people with our art forms through programming and commercial development, as well as reporting accurately to our funders and supporters.

We are seeking to recruit an Audience Data Analyst to join our Analytics and Insight Team as we enter a new and exciting season of ballet and opera programming. This role will focus on delivering high-quality data analysis, ensuring that we continue to develop a holistic and evolving image of RBO audiences and sales. The postholder will provide clear, actionable insights to stakeholders across the organisation, enabling them to make strategic, evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate will have an analytical mind, with the ability to operate independently to agreed deadlines, producing high quality and accurate work for a range of stakeholders at pace. They will be able to contribute to the output of a multi-functional and collaborative team, working with a range of specialists across UX and CX Research, Pricing, Ticketing and Marketing.

The Successful Candidate Will Be Able To Demonstrate


Strong practical data analysis skills, including SQL skills
Strong numeracy, analytical reasoning and attention to detail
The ability to understand the underlying questions of an analytics request and to translate stakeholder requests into clear, focused analysis briefs
Strong collaboration skills, with the confidence to work constructively with stakeholders, technical colleagues and subject matter experts
Clear experience of taking analytical work from an initial question through to accurate findings, clear conclusions and actionable insight.


An Understanding Of The Below Will Be Beneficial And Highly Regarded So Please Do Reflect These In Your Application If You Have


Experience with ticketing or CRM data
Experience working across multiple data sets
Experience with audience, visitor, member or customer data in a performing arts or visitor attraction environment
Experience using Python, R or another analytical programming language for data analysis or automation.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Growth
Description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

Your Mission

At Wise, we’ve got a clear mission — money without borders. Built by and for people who live global lives. As a FinTech company moving billions of GBP of customer money in over 70 countries, Wise needs bulletproof financials & insights into the growth of the company. We need timely, accurate and scalable financial data to make accurate business decisions inside the company.

Due to continued and rapid growth we’re on the hunt for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Growth and Strategic Finance Team in London. You’ll be part of the team that helps pilot the rocket ship.

What You’ll Be Doing


Your principal responsibility will be to generate insights that lead us to better decisions for the company and our customers
Curating datasets, surfacing metrics, some statistical modelling, and deeper dive analysis that we expect to influence the direction of the team and the company
Depending on the project you’re working on, you’ll doing the following:
Helping us understand what’s driving our growth at a company or regional level
Understand our customer segments and cohorts, and how they contribute to our growth
Tie our customer acquisition and activity to marketing or product initiatives, to measure the realised financial return of those initiatives

Who You Are


3 years experience in similar roles
Mathematical or quantitative background
Strong SQL skills
Familiarity with Python/R
Strong analytical ability
Decent understanding of stats and statistical modelling
Data visualisation and storytelling ability
Ability to self organise and manage stakeholders
Demonstration of impact/going above and beyond basic role requirements


Desirable


DBT
Data modelling in a warehouse context
Understanding of testing and experimental design
Legally authorised to work in the UK


Please note that Wise does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

Additional Information

Some Of Our Benefits

Base salary of £60,000 - £85,000

RSU's in a growing and public company

Private Medical Insurance + Life Insurance

️ Discounted gym memberships and cycle to work scheme

️ A paid 6-week sabbatical leave after four years

26 weeks maternity leave at full pay

An annual self-development budget

Pet friendly offices

‍♀️ Lots of fun group activities like yoga, running and boardgame nights

Find out more about our benefits in our London office.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

I’m working with a growing financial technology client in London who are looking to hire an early-career Data Analyst into a maturing data function.




This would be a great role for a talented Data Analyst with aspirations of growing into a Data Science position over time. The immediate need is analytical and commercially focused, but you’ll be learning from a technically strong Data Scientist who can provide hands-on coaching and development.




This is not a deep data science or machine learning role from day one. It is a business-facing analyst position, working closely with finance, operations, marketing, and senior leadership to turn data into clear commercial insight.




The role will suit someone bright, curious, and early in their career who wants proper coaching, genuine exposure, and the chance to learn how a financial services business works from the inside.




You’ll report into a highly capable Data Scientist who is stepping into management and will provide hands-on technical guidance, with regular exposure to the Finance Director and CEO. The structure is flat, the data engineering team is already well established, and the environment is set up for someone to learn quickly without being left to figure everything out alone.




What you’ll be doing:

Analysing commercial, finance, and operational data
Spotting trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement
Communicating insight clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Working with established data processes and tooling
Partnering closely with more senior people before running independently with ideas
Building your commercial understanding of a fast-moving fintech environment




What they’re looking for:

Strong SQL and some Python experience
Exposure to modern data tooling such as dbt or Airflow

2nd stage: Technical interview
Final stage: In-office meeting with the wider leadership and data team

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
VOY is a fast growing Healthtech scale-up, aiming to be the healthcare provider that millions of people trust as their partner to a long and healthy life. Our platform allows users to quickly and safely diagnose possible conditions, get treatment and support them afterwards to live a higher quality life. To do this we are building an all in one healthcare platform which brings together world leading medical expertise and technical excellence.

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help drive smarter, data-informed decisions across the organisation.

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact role where the insights you surface and the dashboards you build directly influence how our teams operate and how well we support our patients.

Who you are


You have strong SQL skills and can write queries confidently to extract, transform and analyse data
You're comfortable with data visualisation tools and understand how to design dashboards that are intuitive and actionable
You think carefully about data -what metrics mean, what the data is actually telling you, and how to communicate it clearly
You're curious and self-driven, comfortable exploring datasets to uncover insights and answer difficult questions
You're a natural communicator who can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
You collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership end-to-end
You're excited about working in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the idea that your work helps improve patient outcomes at scale


What you will do

Translate data into insight


Conduct ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions from stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Clinical and Programme teams
Identify trends, patterns and anomalies in operational and clinical data that impact service delivery and patient outcomes
Present findings in clear, compelling ways that drive decision-making across the organisation


Build and maintain dashboards & reports


Design and build dashboards in Looker that track key metrics across the business - from programme delivery KPIs to financial performance
Develop automated reports that keep stakeholders informed without requiring manual updates
Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant and easy to navigate for end users


Contribute to data quality & modelling


Write clear, optimised SQL to query and manipulate data reliably
Collaborate with the Data Engineering team on data modelling, dbt transformations and data governance
Identify and escalate data quality issues and help ensure consistency across systems
Help define and track metrics that matter, ensuring every KPI is well understood and correctly calculated


Partner across teams


Work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, Finance and Programme Delivery to understand their data needs
Communicate complex data concepts in a way that's accessible to non-technical stakeholders
Help drive adoption of data-driven thinking and self-serve analytics across the organisation


What we need from you


2-4 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or similar analytics role
Proficiency in SQL - you can write queries to explore, filter, join and aggregate data reliably
Experience with at least one BI/visualisation tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Familiarity with modern data stacks and tools (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, dbt are all helpful)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail
Excellent communication skills - able to explain complex findings clearly to diverse audiences
This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in the office


Experience you may have


A degree in a quantitative subject (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, etc.)
Experience in healthcare, public health or regulated industries
Exposure to Python or R for data analysis and statistical work
Experience working in fast-growing, high-impact environments
Familiarity with dbt or other data transformation frameworks


Please note that this is a hybrid role with a requirement of in office presence, 3 days per week

Healthcare is broken. We’re fixing it — and we need your help.

Back in 2019, we launched MANUAL to tackle men's health (starting with hair loss and sexual health). A few years later, we launched Voy with a focus on weight loss. But our ambition has always been bigger. Healthcare too often treats conditions in isolation, not people as a whole, and we're on a mission to prove there's a better way.

In 2025, we evolved from MANUAL into Voy, a brand built for the long game: supporting people through every stage of life, not just a single diagnosis. Today, we support over 1 million members across the UK, Germany and Brazil, delivering personalised care across weight loss, menopause, hair loss and TRT (with more categories on the way).

Ready to join us and change how healthcare feels for millions of people?

But we can’t do it alone, and that’s why we’re assembling a team of top performers to build with us.




Ready to be part of something big?




The Role

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our growing data team at Octopus Legacy. You’ll play a central role in helping teams across the business make smarter, faster, more informed decisions.




While you’ll sit within the data team, your day-to-day will involve working directly with stakeholders from across the organisation such as Growth, Product and Operations. You’ll turn messy real-world data into actionable insights, bring structure to ambiguity, and help the business better understand what drives performance.




This is a hands-on, high-impact role in a fast-moving environment. You’ll need to be comfortable navigating shifting priorities, championing a data culture, and bringing rigour to complexity.




We’re still early in our data journey - right now, the focus is on building the foundations: modelling key metrics, creating dashboards, and getting reliable data into the hands of the people who need it. As our data maturity grows, there’ll be opportunities to go deeper into analysis, experimentation, and more advanced analytics.




Key Responsibilities:

Act as a thought partner to teams across the business - helping them define problems, clarify questions, and uncover the metrics that matter
Translate stakeholder needs into end-to-end data solutions: from raw data to dbt models to dashboards in Metabase
Define and document clear, consistent metrics to support better decision-making across departments
Build intuitive, impactful dashboards that make data accessible and actionable for non-technical users
Deliver ad-hoc and project-based analysis to evaluate initiatives in growth, product, operations, and beyond
Collaborate with the data team to improve the reliability, clarity, and accessibility of our data models and pipelines
Operate with a high degree of autonomy - scoping projects, pushing for clarity, and challenging assumptions when needed
Contribute to a culture of curiosity and rigour, laying the groundwork for more advanced analytics and data science over time




Who Are You?

You have 2+ years of experience in a data analytics role, ideally in a startup or a company building out its data capability
You're proficient in SQL and have worked with BI tools (like Metabase, Looker, or Tableau) to build dashboards that help teams make better decisions
You have hands-on experience with dbt or similar tools, and a solid understanding of data modelling best practices
You’re comfortable working with messy or incomplete data, and know how to turn it into something clean, structured, and useful
You enjoy working with non-technical stakeholders - you ask thoughtful questions, clarify ambiguous requests, and help teams think through what they really need
You take ownership of your work, are comfortable scoping projects with limited direction, and aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions
You’re curious, pragmatic, and excited by the idea of shaping a modern data function from the ground up
Bonus: you have an interest in experimentation or data science, and are keen to grow into more advanced analytics over time




Skills and Knowledge




Must haves:

Strong curiosity and proactive mindset, with the ability to independently explore data, ask the right questions, identify opportunities, and drive projects forward without requiring constant guidance.
Experience in data analytics and the ability to extract actionable insights from complex datasets.
Proficiency with SQL, DBT, python is desirable.
Proven ability to work closely with business stakeholders and translate their needs into data-driven solutions.
Experience in developing reports and dashboards to monitor key metrics.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to present complex data in a way that is understandable and actionable for non-technical stakeholders across departments.
Proficiency with data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Metabase).




Nice to haves/we can work on these:

Basic programming skills in languages such as Python.
Understanding of statistical methods and their application to business problems.
Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment.




Bonus if you:

You have a basic understanding of Data Science concepts and are interested in learning more.
You have experience in training or educating non-technical teams on data literacy.




Our Mission

When people think about planning for death they think about wills, life insurance and funerals. We take these cold processes and turn them into something more human. Share more than money: leave voice notes, music, recipes. Shape a legacy that connects you while you're here. And after you're gone.




Founded by Sam after his mum died suddenly, we’re a group of people who work in death because we’ve been affected by it. We know the difference a good plan makes, and what it’s like when there isn’t one.




Death can come between us, leave mess, legal fees, frustration. But it can also make us stronger. We see a world where people talk openly about death, and work out the real meaning of legacy, one that connects to them. We’re here to make that world happen.




Benefits:

Octopus share incentive scheme.
Hybrid working (London Bridge).
Flexible holiday + extra day off for your Birthday.
Work from anywhere in the world for up to 4 weeks per year.
Vitality Health & Life Insurance.
Pension scheme.
Enhanced parental leave.
Free Will & LPAs + discounts on other Octopus services.
Cycle to Work Scheme and access to the Electric Vehicle (EV) Salary Sacrifice Scheme.
Octopus Giving: we match any charitable fundraising that you do up to £500.
Octopus Springboard: where we help our employees become fully-fledged entrepreneurs.
Dog friendly office.
Breakfast every day, snacks and wellness activities




We know that to be truly innovative, we need to have a diverse team around us. That is why Octopus Legacy is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Music is Universal

It’s the passionate and dedicated team at Universal Music who help make us the world’s leading music company. From A&R to finance, legal to digital, sales to marketing, Universal Music is the place to grow and develop your career within a truly commercial and innovative business that leads in everything it does.

Everyone is welcome to apply for our roles, and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment because of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief, age, marital status, background, pregnancy, or caring responsibilities. We also recognise the importance of diversity of thought within our teams and are fully committed to embracing the talents of people with autism, dyslexia, ADHD, and other forms of neurocognitive variation.

We will always seek to make appropriate adjustments to recruitment, workplaces, and work processes to be fully inclusive to people with different needs and working styles. If you need us to make any reasonable adjustments for you from application onwards, including alternatives to the online form or to disclose a neurocognitive condition, please email UniversalMusicCareers@umusic.com.

Are you interested in working for the music industry? Would you like to help turn data into insight that drives innovation and creative data-driven strategies across Universal Music?

Universal Music UK is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to become part of our UK central data, AI and technology team. The role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the start of a new chapter, where we are looking to grow & expand on the foundation of work we’ve already begun.

The role is perfect for a candidate that is passionate about music, data, AI and technology and has a thirst for acquiring, analysing and communicating knowledge through data. In a creative organisation such as ours, reducing a complex problem into something simple is key, so any experience managing stakeholders, shaping questions and translating data into clear insight would also be a strength.

Alongside this, you will be responsible for delivering analysis, reporting and measurement that helps solve real business problems across Universal Music UK. You will work with stakeholders to understand business needs, define the right questions and turn complex data into clear, actionable insight. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers and business teams, you will help improve how we measure performance, understand audiences and identify opportunities for our artists, labels and central teams. As we’re first and foremost a data, AI and technology team, you should be comfortable working with large datasets, technical teams and modern analytics tools.

As part of the central data, AI and technology team, you’ll have a chance to work across all divisions, including AMS, frontline labels, our catalogue division UMR, and all other central teams, as well as data and technology teams within the wider business. This includes helping shape insight, reporting and data products that support & supercharge the labels.

Key Responsibilities

Core responsibilities include:


Working directly with the Data & AI team to support artists & labels across the business.
Being a senior voice within the team and leading data strategy at a label level.
Supporting core strategic research with data & audience insight.
Researching & developing data driven solutions to solve current & future business problems.
Utilising partner data to pull out key metrics and feeding back to the label teams.
Advising on data related topics to help guide or inform business decisions.
Sourcing, cleaning and preparing data for modelling, product creation or visualisation.
Developing new data sets or features that become integral to how the business operates.


At the heart of this role is a desire to give us a competitive edge in connecting our artists with audiences across the globe. More will be explained at Interview. Rest assured, this is an exciting role as part of an innovative new initiative within the organisation.

Skills

Skills & Experience


Strong ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insight.
Creative and commercially minded approach to problem-solving.
Strong stakeholder engagement, management and communication skills.
Ability to lead analytical projects from idea through to delivery and adoption.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying large datasets accurately and efficiently.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform or AWS.
Experience building dashboards, reporting products and self-serve insight tools.
Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT processes and data quality.
Working knowledge of Python or another programming language for analysis.
Familiarity with Git, version control and modern analytics workflows.
Good understanding of AI, machine learning concepts and their practical application.
Ability to mentor others and raise the quality of analytical work across a team.
Knowledge of music repertoire is advantageous.


Experience


Minimum of 4 years’ experience in a data analyst, analytics or related role.
Background engaging stakeholders in a consultative or analytical capacity.
Experience leading analysis that informs business decisions and product development.
Experience working with engineering, data science or product teams to turn analysis into scalable tools, reporting or data products.


Education


Degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
A background in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Economics, Data Science or a similarly analytical discipline would be advantageous.


Just So You Know…

The company presents this job description as a guide to the major areas and duties for which the jobholder is accountable. However, the business operates in an environment that demands change and the jobholder's specific responsibilities and activities will vary and develop. Therefore, the job description should be seen as indicative and not as a permanent, definitive, and exhaustive statement.

Production of daily, weekly, and monthly reports for a range of stakeholders, with a view to learning to automate these over time

Provide feeds of data to other departments and systems to enable business processes

Strong experience working with data in Excel

Knowledge and experience with automated reporting platforms
Insurance industry experience would be considered an advantage

The role is perfect for a candidate that is passionate about music, data, AI and technology and has a thirst for acquiring, analysing and communicating knowledge through data. As we’re first and foremost a data, AI and technology team, you should be comfortable working with large datasets, technical teams and modern analytics tools.

Working directly with the Data & AI team to support artists & labels across the business.

Utilising partner data to pull out key metrics and feeding back to the label teams.
Advising on data related topics to help guide or inform business decisions.

Developing new data sets or features that become integral to how the business operates.

Skills

Strong ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insight.
Creative and commercially minded approach to problem-solving.
Strong stakeholder engagement, management and communication skills.
Ability to lead analytical projects from idea through to delivery and adoption.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying large datasets accurately and efficiently.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform or AWS.
Experience building dashboards, reporting products and self-serve insight tools.
Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT processes and data quality.
Working knowledge of Python or another programming language for analysis.
Familiarity with Git, version control and modern analytics workflows.
Good understanding of AI, machine learning concepts and their practical application.
Ability to mentor others and raise the quality of analytical work across a team.
Knowledge of music repertoire is advantageous.


Experience

Background engaging stakeholders in a consultative or analytical capacity.
Experience leading analysis that informs business decisions and product development.
Experience working with engineering, data science or product teams to turn analysis into scalable tools, reporting or data products.


Education


Degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
A background in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Economics, Data Science or a similarly analytical discipline would be advantageous.

You will be part of a collaborative global team, supporting a wide range of market-facing activities while helping to improve data infrastructure, performance, and innovation across the platform.



What you’ll be doing:



Partnering with traders and global markets teams to understand data needs and delivering practical solutions
Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, datasets, and analytical tools
Supporting quantitative research initiatives, including developing and applying analytical models
Identifying gaps in data infrastructure and driving improvements for reliability and scalability
Acting as the first point of contact for data and analytics issues, diagnosing and resolving problems
Collaborating with global stakeholders to support workflows across multiple regions
Enhancing data quality, governance, and accessibility across platforms
Translating complex technical outputs into clear insights for non-technical audiences

Strong Python experience including Pandas, NumPy or similar data analysis libraries
Advanced SQL skills with experience working across relational databases
Experience building data pipelines, working with cloud platforms, and integrating APIs
Solid understanding of data engineering principles and scalable data architecture
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage and collaborate with non-technical stakeholders
Proven problem-solving ability and experience working in a fast-paced environment

Life assurance
Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)

Description:
As Lockton’s continued investment in Data and MI the appetite for data is only increasing and is highly valued by senior management.As a result, we are looking to recruit the appropriate data individual to join the team.

First and foremost, the right candidate must fit in with Lockton’s culture. At Lockton we value the following principles:

Client first
Results and impact driven
Self-motivated
Continuous improvement

Partner with business stakeholders to gather, challenge, and translate reporting and analytics requirements.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
DATA ANALYST




ABOUT US

Every day, we push beyond expectations to help millions of people save money, at a time when it’s never mattered more. Through MoneySuperMarket, MoneySavingExpert, Quidco and our B2B partnerships we supply products to more than 24 million unique monthly visitors, helping UK households to save billions of pounds a year. Can you tell this is something we’re exceptionally proud of!

Creative, collaborative, ambitious – it’s hard work. But what makes it worth it? Leaving work knowing we’ve made a difference to our customers, users, and to each other.

Put our distinct brands together with our dedicated colleagues and you’ve got a workplace with lots of personality. We’re open-minded, diverse, and love our differences. Everyone plays a part, and comes together to work hard, go beyond, and make sure everyone feels they belong.




WHY JOIN THE TEAM?

Understanding data and using it to improve customer experience are critical pillars of MoneySuperMarket Group’s success, leading to an extensive investment in people and capabilities within our Group Data function.




The Data Analytics team plays an essential role in helping the business achieve its goals and are actively involved in identifying unique areas where data can add more value to our customers. We use machine learning, data-driven experimentation, and analytics techniques with a tech stack involving Google Cloud Platform (GCP), GitHub, DBT and Tableau to gain insight into user behaviour, and optimise marketing and user experience.




Far more than number crunchers, MoneySuperMarket data analysts influence the direction of the company through actionable data-driven insight. The data analyst will work with the rest of the team to identify opportunities for personalisation, monitor performance of experiments, develop and track KPIs, and automate manual processes.




WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

In this hands-on role, you will apply your communications, technical and problem-solving skills to:

Work pro-actively within the data analytics team to deliver high impact projects that will:
Empower people across the business to make data-driven decisions by building self-serve reports and recommendations.
Deliver actionable insights across MoneySuperMarket, MoneySavingExperts and QuidCo brands.




Build relationships with stakeholders and ensure your work is communicated across the business.
Present findings and recommendations tailored to the relevant audience.
Troubleshoot and optimise existing data sources.
Work together with Data Engineers to productionise valuable output from your projects to commonly used data tables.
Support and be supported by other data analysts, data scientists and data engineers through knowledge sharing and upskilling.
You will learn and grow your capabilities by working with the latest technology and services, in particular the Google Cloud Platform.
Working on a cross-functional team, you will learn and grow your capabilities in areas such as statistics, data storytelling, web, and mobile app technologies and machine learning.




WHAT WE LOOK FOR

Previous professional experience in Data Analytics.
Experience with BI reporting tools such as Tableau or powerBI.
Experience with app analytics tools such as Google Analytics.
A good working knowledge of SQL.
Experience with code development tools such as GitHub and DBT.
Experience in managing stakeholder work requests.
Comfortable manipulating and analysing complex, high-volume, high-dimensionality data from varying sources and formats.
Be detail oriented and adept in resolving bugs in SQL code and data cross checks.
Adept at data visualisation.
Be able to communicate complex quantitative analysis in a clear, precise, and actionable manner to senior management.




WHAT REWARDS ARE ON OFFER

Up to 27 holidays + bank holidays
Pension up to 6% employer contribution
Bonus scheme
Digital Doctor on demand
Work from anywhere scheme – 2 weeks per year
Financial coaching
Mental health platform access




HOW WE’LL INVEST IN YOU

We’re invested in your development. Expect mentorship, training, and opportunities to expand your skill set, including access to your own individual LinkedIn Learning license with access to over 16,000 courses.




At MONY Group, we believe in the strength of diversity and see inclusion as a strategic advantage. Our values guide us in creating a workplace where fairness and equity is a reality for all. We’re committed to minimising systemic bias and creating a level playing field for all candidates.




Contact us for reasonable accommodations in the application process, no need to disclose your disability or condition, just specify your needs. Unsure what to ask for? We can guide you through available accommodations.




We understand that job adverts only say so much and you’re likely to have a lot of questions. If you’d like to know more before applying such as more on hybrid working, salary, our parental leave policy etc, please just let us know, and we’ll be happy to help. You can contact the recruiter for this role, Kim at kim.richards@monygroup.com




We believe that success isn’t solely defined by ticking boxes on a skills checklist. We encourage your application, so we can discover your skills and experience that will help you succeed in this role.

Title: Senior Data Analyst-(Re)Insurance- SQL, Power BI, Azure technologies
Description:
Introduction

At Gallagher Re, we bring clarity to complexity by helping clients around the world make confident, data-driven decisions in a rapidly evolving risk landscape. Here, you’ll be part of a team that leverages world-class analytics and deep reinsurance expertise to deliver strategic advisory services and transactional excellence. Together, we transform advanced insights and market intelligence into strategies that protect businesses, drive performance, and shape the future of reinsurance. We’re a community of decision makers, future shapers, and trusted experts working side by side to deliver meaningful impact through innovative thinking and practical solutions. At Gallagher Re, your curiosity is welcomed, your growth is championed, and your work truly matters. This is a place where you'll have the freedom to explore new ideas, take ownership of your career, and collaborate with people who are as driven and inquisitive as you are.

Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst to join our growing data and analytics team. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with underwriting, operations, claims, and finance stakeholders to deliver actionable insights that support business performance and strategic decision-making.

The successful candidate will bring proven experience in the (Re)Insurance market, with hands-on experience working with Bordereaux and Delegated Authority data. You will play a key role in transforming complex data into meaningful analysis, improving data quality, and developing reporting solutions that drive operational efficiency and commercial outcomes. Previoous experience and knowldge of working with Data & Analytics in the insurannce industry is essential to be successful in this role.

We offer flexible/hybrid working and you will be expected in our London City office twice a week.

How You'll Make An Impact


Analyse and interpret large, complex datasets to provide business-critical insights and recommendations.
Work with Delegated Authority and Bordereaux data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualisations using Power BI.
Write and optimise complex SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyse data from multiple sources.
Support the development and enhancement of data models, reporting frameworks, and analytical solutions.
Collaborate with underwriting, actuarial, finance, and operational teams to understand business requirements and deliver data-driven solutions.
Work with cloud-based data platforms, including Azure Data Lake, to support modern data architecture and analytics capabilities.
Identify data quality issues and implement controls and improvements to enhance data integrity.
Provide subject matter expertise on (Re)Insurance data structures, reporting requirements, and market best practices.


About You


Proven experience as a Data Analyst or Senior Data Analyst within (Re)Insurance market is essential.
Extensive knowledge of Bordereaux and Delegated Authority business processes and datasets.
Advanced SQL skills with the ability to write, troubleshoot, and optimise complex queries.
Hands-on experience developing reports and dashboards using Power BI.
Experience working with Azure Data Lake and cloud-based data environments.
Fantastic analytical, problem-solving, and data visualisation skills.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Experience translating business requirements into meaningful analytical solutions.
Experience within the London Market insurance environment.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality, or master data management principles.
Exposure to Azure Synapse, Data Factory, or other Azure analytics services.
Understanding of underwriting, claims, exposure management, or reinsurance reporting processes.


Compensation And Benefits

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.


Competitive compensation
Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

Use the latest data science tools and techniques for data processing, analysis and visualisation of large, complex data sets
Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, plan deliverables, and track implementation with analysts, data engineers and developers
Incorporate advanced AI and algorithms where relevant
Lead implementation of ETL and processing pipelines, data derivation and analysis

Experience supervising junior analysts, data engineers and developers

Working knowledge of Python, JSON and DAX
Ability to deliver actionable insights clearly using visualisation tools such as Power BI
Strong numerical, data handling and analytical skills

Good organisational skills and strong attention to detail

Curiosity and willingness to learn new techniques, programming languages and software tools
Appreciation of the wider data science technology landscape including Databricks
Awareness of global trade, economics and statistics

Description:
Salary: Up to £41,440 per annum based on skills and experience

Full time; 40 hours per week

Permanent position

Based in: Covent Garden, London




To ensure a fair process, late applications will not be considered under any circumstances.




The Royal Ballet and Opera continues to lead the way in opera, ballet, music and dance both live on stage and through multiple digital platforms, from live streaming to worldwide cinema screenings. Our Covent Garden theatre has been at the heart of London and British cultural life for three centuries. We are home to two world-class Companies: The Royal Ballet and The Royal Opera.




The Royal Opera House describes the place we work, not who we are. The whole is always more than the sum of its parts – we may be a House, but three quarters of our audiences experience what we do outside this building. While our Covent Garden theatre is the nerve centre, the impact and influence of the organisation can be felt in every corner of the country, and around the world. Understanding our global audience (their behaviours, preferences and habits) is central to our mission to engage more people with our art forms through programming and commercial development, as well as reporting accurately to our funders and supporters.




We are seeking to recruit an Audience Data Analyst to join our Analytics and Insight Team as we enter a new and exciting season of ballet and opera programming. This role will focus on delivering high-quality data analysis, ensuring that we continue to develop a holistic and evolving image of RBO audiences and sales. The postholder will provide clear, actionable insights to stakeholders across the organisation, enabling them to make strategic, evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate will have an analytical mind, with the ability to operate independently to agreed deadlines, producing high quality and accurate work for a range of stakeholders at pace. They will be able to contribute to the output of a multi-functional and collaborative team, working with a range of specialists across UX and CX Research, Pricing, Ticketing and Marketing.




The Successful Candidate Will Be Able To Demonstrate

Strong practical data analysis skills, including SQL skills
Strong numeracy, analytical reasoning and attention to detail.
The ability to understand the underlying questions of an analytics request and to translate stakeholder requests into clear, focused analysis briefs.
Strong collaboration skills, with the confidence to work constructively with stakeholders, technical colleagues and subject matter experts
Clear experience of taking analytical work from an initial question through to accurate findings, clear conclusions and actionable insight.

Experience with ticketing or CRM data.
Experience working across multiple data sets.
Experience with audience, visitor, member or customer data in a performing arts or visitor attraction environment.
Experience using Python, R or another analytical programming language for data analysis or automation.

Commercial Data Analyst

£45,000 – £55,000 | London | Hybrid, 3 days a week on site




Fancy a Data Analyst role where you're actually in the room when the decisions get made?




We're working with a fast-growing luxury fashion and eCommerce group that's investing heavily in its next stage of growth. At the centre of the business is a membership-led digital platform with a growing customer base and a lot of rich behavioural data to dig into.




They're now building out the data, tech and commercial infrastructure to support that growth, and are looking for a Commercial Data Analyst to be one of the foundational people on that journey.

This isn't a dashboards-into-the-void kind of role. You'll be working directly with senior commercial leadership, using data to understand customer behaviour, spot trends, and answer the questions that are actually driving growth across the business.




What you'll be doing

You'll take ownership of analysis across customer, membership, trading and operational performance, including:

Using SQL to interrogate data across multiple systems and datasets
Turning broad commercial questions into clear, useful analysis
Spotting trends and opportunities worth digging into further
Building reporting and dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar
Presenting findings in a way that lands with commercial and senior stakeholders
Helping define and measure the KPIs that matter as the business scales
Working between Commercial and Technology as the business develops its central data warehouse
Supporting data quality, accuracy and reporting logic as that environment evolves




You won't be expected to architect or build the data warehouse, there's already technical ownership in place. Your job is making sure the data coming out of it is accurate, useful, and able to support real commercial decisions.




What we're looking for

Strong SQL skills and confidence working independently with data
Previous experience working with a data warehouse
Experience with BI/reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI or Looker
Strong reporting and trend-analysis experience
The ability to explain data clearly to non-technical and senior stakeholders
Commercial curiosity, and the confidence to look beyond the original question




Experience in eCommerce, consumer, subscription, membership, marketplace or app-led businesses would be particularly relevant but we're far more interested in how you think than whether you've used the exact same tech stack before.




Why consider it

This is a newly created role with genuine visibility and room to grow. You'll work closely with the senior leader responsible for Commercial Finance, Strategy and Growth, with regular exposure to the wider leadership team.




You'll also be joining at a point where the group is actively improving how it uses data, consolidating reporting, and building the foundations for its next phase of growth. For someone currently sat in a larger analytics team, this could be your chance to:




Take much broader ownership of your analysis
Work directly with senior decision-makers
See the commercial impact of the insights you produce
Help shape a developing data function
Build towards Senior, Manager and potentially broader Data & Analytics leadership as the business scales

Private medical cover

Further benefits currently being introduced

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At Adapty, we make it easy for mobile apps to manage in-app purchases and paywalls. We power 20K+ apps, process $3B+ in subscriptions every year, and have been growing fast for the last four years. Our mission is simple: make apps rich.

We are a team of 210+ passionate, product-driven people who love solving big challenges. Backed by top investors like 500 Startups and Surface Ventures, we are building one of mobile's fastest-growing SaaS companies and aiming for number one worldwide.

Why This Role Matters

Adapty's Revenue team is scaling across SDR, Account Executive, Customer Success, and Professional Services. The data that explains how it is doing sits in CRM, billing, invoices, product usage, and marketing tools – and none of it is connected.

This role owns that end to end: pull the data in, model it, and turn it into dashboards and answers. Roughly half the job is engineering – pipelines, dbt models, automation – and half is analysis for the people who run Revenue and Marketing. The backlog is already deep, so the impact starts in week one.

What You'll Do


Build and own the pipelines that bring CRM, billing, invoice, product usage, and marketing data together — Airflow, dbt, n8n, Python.
Model that data into clean, documented, tested layers other people can build on.
Build the dashboards Revenue actually runs on in Metabase: pipeline, quota attainment, new revenue, churn, contraction, expansion, NRR/GRR, customer health.
Connect marketing to revenue: channel and event ROI, CAC, LTV, payback, funnel conversion.
Own data quality: monitoring, tests, and alerts that catch problems before leadership does.
Explain why revenue moved — product, region, segment, channel, billing logic, customer behaviour — not just that it moved.
Build forecasting and risk models: revenue forecast, churn and contraction risk, NRR forecast.


About You


You have built ETL pipelines yourself and kept them running in production – Airflow, dbt, n8n or equivalents.
Excellent SQL (PostgreSQL, ClickHouse) and strong Python for automation and analysis.
You are comfortable in a BI tool, ideally Metabase, and you build dashboards people actually use.
You know SaaS revenue metrics well: MRR, ARR, NRR, GRR, churn, contraction, expansion, pipeline, quota attainment, cohorts.
You know marketing metrics too: CAC, LTV, payback, channel and event ROI, attribution, funnel conversion.
You understand how SDR, AE, and CS work and how that shows up in revenue.
High ownership: you take a vague business question, clarify it, build the thing, explain the result, and say what to do next.


Nice to have


HubSpot data and HubSpot reporting logic.
Subscription, billing, invoice, or usage-based revenue data.
Churn prediction, customer health scores, or forecasting models that shipped and got used.
Marketing attribution across paid, organic, and events.
BI migration, dashboard governance, and aligning metric definitions across teams.


What's in it for you


Strong product with industry-best metrics. Adapty is among the top 5% fastest-growing SaaS companies.
Exceptional compensation directly tied to your results.
Direct communication and ownership. No bureaucracy, no politics, just impact.
Flexible remote work. Join us from anywhere or work onsite in our Belgrade or London offices.
Professional support. Language learning, sports, health insurance, laptop coverage, and more.
