Title: Senior Data Analyst, Marketing
Description:
At SheMed, our mission is to revolutionise women’s health by providing accessible and personalised solutions tailored specifically for women. We are a startup consisting of enthusiastic people who are committed to empowering women with the knowledge and tools they need to take control of their health and well-being.

SheMed is an innovative and advanced weight loss programme that is groundbreaking in the world of women’s health. We have an unwavering dedication to quality care, and strive to create a supportive and compassionate community where every woman can thrive and achieve optimal health. In doing so, we believe SheMed will be a strong force in closing the women’s health gap.

We are seeking a highly analytical, commercially minded Senior Data Analyst, Marketing to become a key partner to the marketing team at SheMed.

This role will be embedded within marketing, helping the team make smarter, faster, data-led decisions across acquisition, retention, customer journeys, and campaign performance. You will drive the measurement of key growth channels, including Meta, Google, and influencer partnerships, and provide clear insight into what is working, what is not, and where we should focus next.

You will play a critical role in connecting marketing behaviour with wider business performance, including subscription metrics, customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, and retention.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with excellent commercial judgement and communication skills. You should be comfortable working with complex datasets, but equally confident translating your analysis into clear, non-technical narratives for senior leadership.




Please note: This is an office-based role, Monday to Friday, 9am – 6pm. We are based in Euston, London.




What You’ll Work On

Own marketing performance measurement across channels including Meta, Google, paid social, affiliates, and influencer partnerships.
Develop attribution frameworks to evaluate acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue performance.
Partner with marketing teams to optimise campaigns, audience targeting, creative performance, and budget allocation.
Analyse the end-to-end customer journey to identify drop-off points, behavioural trends, and growth opportunities.
Deliver insights to improve conversion, onboarding, CRM, lifecycle communications, retention, and customer value.
Own reporting and analysis for key subscription KPIs including CAC, LTV, payback period, churn, retention, conversion rate, subscription growth, and channel ROI.
Apply advanced analytics using SQL, Python, or R for cohort analysis, forecasting, predictive modelling, and Marketing Mix Modelling.
Build and maintain dashboards and self-serve reporting in Tableau to support data-driven decision-making.
Translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Use SQL and dbt to develop trusted, scalable data models and analytics infrastructure.
Collaborate with data, marketing, product, medical, finance, and leadership teams to align insights with business priorities.
Support analysis of customer engagement and health outcomes in partnership with clinical and product teams.
Proactively identify opportunities, challenge assumptions with evidence, and help teams move from data to decisions.




What We’re Looking For

3–5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, commercial analytics, or a similar data-focused role.
Experience working in a high-growth, fast-paced environment, ideally within D2C healthcare, subscription, consumer health, wellness, ecommerce, or a startup environment.
Strong experience analysing paid marketing performance across channels such as Meta, Google, paid search, paid social, influencer, affiliates, or CRM.
Experience owning and reporting on subscription or customer growth metrics, such as CAC, LTV, retention, churn, payback period, and cohort performance.
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets.
Experience using dbt for data transformation, modelling, testing, and documentation.
Strong Tableau experience, including building dashboards for senior stakeholders and non-technical users.
Experience using Python or R for advanced analysis, predictive modelling, forecasting, or statistical modelling.
Ability to translate complex datasets into clear, non-technical narratives that influence senior decision-making.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with Marketing Mix Modelling or incrementality testing (Desireable)
Experience with PostHog, Braze, or similar product analytics and CRM platforms (Desireable)
Experience working with clinical, health, patient, or outcomes data (Desireable)




What We Offer

A mission-driven team focused on closing the women’s health gap
Competitive Salary
25 days holiday
Breakfast and all day snacks
Monthly socials
Health care Cash Plan including physio, digital clinical appointments and wellbeing for you, your partner and children
£80 contribution to noise cancelling headphones
Life insurance cover of 4x salary
Pension contribution matched up to 5%
Cycle to work scheme




Please note that offers of employment are subject to receipt of satisfactory references and a enhanced DBS check.




WORKING AT SHEMED

Whether you work in one of our amazing offices, clinics or part of our remote clinician workforce, SheMed is highly collaborative and fun! You’ll have a chance to work in a fast-paced environment with experienced industry leaders. We have a learning environment where you can make an impact.




Who We Are

At SheMed our people aren’t just part of a team, they’re part of something bigger. We’re a vibrant community of creative thinkers and doers, forging the way for a new generation of healthcare. We’re only as good as our people. So, finding the best people is everything to us. We serve millions, but we choose our people one at a time…




DIVERSITY

We believe that difference inspires a better, healthier world. That’s why it’s at the heart of everything we do. From our people to our products, difference enriches every part of our business and creates a culture based on equality of opportunity, and in which all employees can progress their careers. We’re committed to creating an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, pregnancy status, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Title: Growth Data Analyst
Description:
Did you see one of our viral campaigns, like findmohamedawife.com? Or maybe you know one of the 800,000 couples who met through Muzz? Whatever brought you here, now’s the perfect time to join a team on its way to becoming the first billion-dollar Muslim app.




We're looking for a Growth Data Analyst to join our dynamic Data team and help us make better decisions about how we grow Muzz around the world.




You'll be the analytical partner to our Growth team, owning measurement across global marketing activity and turning data into insights that help us acquire, activate, retain and monetise more users.




This isn't a role where you'll simply build dashboards and wait for someone to ask for a report. You'll work closely with Growth, Product and Data teams to understand what's happening, figure out why and identify what we should do next.




If you enjoy solving complex problems, explaining data in simple terms and finding opportunities hidden in the numbers, we'd love to hear from you.




Day to day

Own measurement across Muzz's global marketing activities and assess how effectively our marketing investments drive growth.
Build and maintain dashboards that give Marketing teams visibility of their KPIs and enable self-service reporting.
Analyse marketing performance across channels, markets and campaigns to identify growth opportunities.
Work closely with regional Brand, Social Media and Events teams to turn data and insights into better marketing strategies.
Investigate new and emerging marketing channels and assess their potential to drive incremental growth.
Own and prioritise ad hoc analytical requests from Marketing Specialists across our global markets.
Turn complex analysis into clear recommendations that help teams make better, data-led decisions.
Present findings and insights to non-technical stakeholders in a simple and actionable way.
Train and support business users so they can get the most out of our BI tools and become more self-sufficient with data.
Work with Product Analysts and Product teams to identify opportunities to use product features and data to improve personalised marketing.
Analyse opportunities to improve activation, retention and monetisation through better marketing and product collaboration.
Partner with Data Engineers to improve data models and ensure they can support multiple analytical and business needs.
Explore new datasets, tools and analytical approaches that can help Muzz better understand its users and growth opportunities.
Continuously improve how Marketing measures performance, reports results and uses data to make decisions.




What we’re looking for

3+ years of experience in data analytics, growth analytics, marketing analytics or a related field.
Strong SQL skills, with experience writing efficient, scalable and maintainable queries.
Experience building and maintaining BI dashboards, data models, searches and views.
Strong understanding of marketing measurement and performance, including acquisition, campaign performance and growth metrics.
Experience working with data-focused marketing teams and translating marketing questions into meaningful analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex questions and turn findings into clear recommendations.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, particularly the ability to explain complex data and insights to non-technical audiences.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work closely with Marketing, Product, Data and regional teams around the world.
Highly organised and able to prioritise multiple requests while balancing urgent business needs with longer-term analytical projects.
A commercial and growth mindset, with a genuine interest in understanding how data can unlock new opportunities for the business.
Comfortable working independently and proactively identifying questions that the business should be asking, rather than only answering questions you're given.
Experience collaborating with Data Engineers to design and improve data models that can support multiple business needs.




Must-Haves

Strong SQL & data skills - You can confidently write, optimise and maintain SQL queries and work with data models to answer complex business questions.
Marketing & growth analytics - You understand how marketing works and can connect metrics, campaigns and channels to meaningful business outcomes.
Analytical storytelling - You can turn complex analysis into a clear story, communicate insights to non-technical audiences and make recommendations that people can act on.
Ownership & prioritisation - You're organised, proactive and comfortable managing multiple requests, prioritising competing needs and independently finding opportunities to improve how the business uses data.




Nice to have

Experience with Google BigQuery.
Experience with Mobile Measurement Platforms such as AppsFlyer or Adjust.
Experience with dbt.




Why join Muzz?

We’re a profitable Consumer Tech startup, backed by Y Combinator (S17) and based in London. Join our fast growing team and work on an amazing product that’s changing the world.

A great product - We’re the leading app in this space with over 10 million members worldwide and counting!
Level up quickly - Work with talented, generous people on the kinds of challenges you’ll be proud to share.
A diverse team - We have people from all walks of life all adding their unique perspective. Muslims and non-Muslims, cat lovers and dog lovers. Everyone is welcome!
Meaningful equity - We’re all working together to succeed and everyone on the team gets a slice of the pie.
A hackathon every quarter - We value curiosity and building something wacky (but useful!). Every quarter we organise into random teams and together we build, code, and prototype. Prizes and dinner complete the day!
International travel - We fly the whole team to somewhere amazing twice a year to connect and have fun.
Regular socials - Mini golf, hikes, super competitive Catan nights - we’ve done it all. Maybe you’ll be at the next social?
Generous Holiday / PTO - All full-time members get at least 33 days of holiday, regardless of where they live.




Interview Process

Step 1. Submit your CV
Step 2. An initial video call
Step 3. Complete a technical exercise
Step 4. Interview (in person or remote)
Step 5. Receive an offer!

Description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About The Role

We are seeking a technically strong Junior Data Analyst to support Marketing Analytics by transforming data into insights that improve campaign performance and enable data & AI driven decision-making. This is an early-career role ideal for candidates with strong analytical fundamentals and hands-on experience with SQL, Python, Claude Code, and modern data platforms such as Databricks.

You will work with large marketing datasets, develop reporting solutions, automate data workflows, implement AI agentic layers and partner with marketing business partners to deliver actionable insights.

What You’ll Do

Data Analysis & Insights


Analyze marketing performance data to identify trends, optimization opportunities, and key performance drivers.
Evaluate customer acquisition, engagement, and conversion metrics to support marketing strategy.
Design and implement an intelligent lead ingestion framework by automating the lead import process using AI-driven data parsing, validation, and enrichment techniques. This includes building scalable process automation pipelines and developing a user-friendly interface that enables seamless monitoring, control, and interaction with incoming lead data.
Translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations for stakeholders.
Support ad-hoc analysis and proactively identify opportunities for deeper insights.


Technical & Data Development


Write efficient SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze marketing and enterprise data.
Use Python for data cleaning, automation, and exploratory analysis.
Assist with building and maintaining curated datasets, data models, and data quality checks
Use Claude Code to design interfaces, agents & automation steps


Reporting & Collaboration


Develop and maintain dashboards and marketing performance reports using BI tools.
Automate recurring reporting processes to improve efficiency and scalability.
Partner with marketing, analytics, data science and data engineering teams to support reporting and data needs.
Document data definitions, logic, and reporting methodologies.


What You’ll Bring


Strong working knowledge of SQL, including joins, aggregations, and data transformations.
Basic to intermediate proficiency in Python with experience using data libraries (e.g., pandas, NumPy) through coursework, projects, or internships.
Exposure to Databricks, Apache Spark, or cloud-based data environments.
Experience working with real-world datasets and performing data validation and troubleshooting.
Strong curiosity and willingness to learn.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.
Ability to communicate technical findings to non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage multiple workflow priorities using Jira or similar project management tools and work independently.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Marketing Analytics, or related quantitative field.
Internship, academic project, or research experience involving data analysis is strongly preferred.


Nice to Have


Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar visualization tools
Familiarity with marketing analytics concepts or campaign performance metrics
Exposure to marketing platforms such as Google Analytics or Salesforce
Experience using version control tools (e.g., Git)
Understanding of ETL or data pipeline concepts


What We Offer


Hands-on experience working with large-scale marketing and customer datasets
Mentorship & development in SQL, Python, Databricks and modern analytics tools
Opportunities to influence marketing strategy through data insights
Exposure to cloud-based analytics and data engineering practices
A strong career development foundation in data analytics and marketing analytics
Access to cutting-edge AI-assisted development tools, including Claude Code, empowering you to accelerate analysis & prototype solutions rapidly


What You`ll Get


25 paid vacation days, plus 4 extra global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
Private medical, dental, and vision insurance with dependent enrolment
Life insurance with enhanced coverage and global 24/7 protection
Income protection after 26 weeks, covering a portion of salary
Defined contribution pension plan with employer match
Worldwide travel insurance for business and leisure, with option to enroll dependents
Employee Assistance Program with therapy, legal, and financial support, plus online GP services and wellbeing programs
Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Summary

AvePoint is seeking a highly analytical Data Analyst to support and scale our global partner business. In this role, you will analyze data across our partner ecosystem—including sales performance, customer usage, licensing, and marketing—to provide insights into how our partners drive revenue growth, customer adoption, and long-term retention. Your work will help leadership make decisions on where to invest, which partners to prioritize, and how to grow our channel business effectively.

Key Responsibilities


Partner Performance Analysis Analyze how partners contribute to revenue growth, pipeline creation, and customer expansion across regions, channels, and segments.
Partner Health & Engagement Insights Develop lifecycle metrics and scorecards to assess partner effectiveness based on engagement, product adoption, customer satisfaction, and training participation.
Revenue & Forecasting Support Support reporting on recurring revenue (ARR), renewals, and pipeline, helping leadership understand growth trends and risks within the partner ecosystem.
Customer & Partner Relationship Insights Analyze how customers move between direct sales and partners, and identify opportunities for expansion and retention through partner channels.
Partner Marketing Analytics Measure the impact of partner-driven campaigns and initiatives on new partner acquisition and existing partner growth.
Predictive & Strategic Analysis Build models to identify high-growth partners, at-risk partners, and opportunities to improve partner coverage or investment.
Dashboarding & Executive Reporting Create clear, executive-ready dashboards and insights that help sales, marketing, and partner teams take action.
Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Sales/Go-To-Market, Partner Programs, Marketing, RevOps, and Finance to align on metrics, reporting, and business priorities.


Qualifications


Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Experience: 3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a SaaS or technology environment, with a focus on customer data analytics. Experience in SaaS B2B performance metrics such as Annual Recurring Revenue, Net Recurring Revenue, and Gross Recurring Revenue analysis is a plus.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) a must. Experience with customer systems such as CRM systems (e.g., Dynamics CRM, PRMs), Gainsight CS, Everstage Commission, Segment Marketing, DealHub, OutReach, and Zoominfo experience are also a plus.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.
Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and persuasively.
Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and attention to detail in data handling and analysis.
Business Acumen: Understanding of sales, marketing, and customer success processes and how data can inform strategy and decision-making.
Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

The listed salary range represents a good faith estimate, with final offers based on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. The listed range reflects base salary only; our total rewards include base salary, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO), and depending on the role, bonuses, commissions, or equity (RSUs). We welcome compensation discussions—apply even if your expectations fall outside the range.

Title: GTM Data Analyst
Description:
👋 About Us

sunday is building the fastest, simplest way to pay in restaurants. With a quick scan of a QR code, diners can pay, tip, and leave in about 10 seconds. We believe great products should feel obvious, not complicated, and we focus relentlessly on keeping things simple while earning trust from restaurants and guests at every interaction. Today, sunday powers payments in thousands of restaurants across the US, UK, and France, helping operators turn tables faster, increase tips, and unlock valuable insights. We push ourselves to go beyond what’s expected, building with ownership, moving fast, and scaling with ambition as we tackle our biggest growth opportunity in the US.

About The Role

As a GTM Data Analyst at sunday, your ultimate goal will be to make our go-to-market performance easier to understand, measure, and improve. You will become an expert in sunday’s data architecture and reporting infrastructure, helping teams across the US, UK, and France turn complex business questions into clear, actionable insight. You can be based in London or in the US.

You will report to the Global GTM Program Manager and join a five-person GTM Operations team. This is a highly technical, hands-on role: you will work closely with GTM operators, RevOps, and Data to build the reporting foundations that help sunday grow intelligently, while also identifying where AI and agentic workflows can make our revenue teams more effective. In your first 6–12 months, you will become an expert in sunday’s data architecture and reporting infrastructure, identify clear gaps in our data and reporting, and deliver solutions to many of them.

Join early, grow fast, and shape the journey!

Key Responsibilities


Serve as the primary analytics resource for GTM operators across the US, UK, and France, delivering complex analyses and ad hoc deep dives.
Build and own the reporting standard used in sales leadership’s regular GTM performance reviews.
Build the foundational KPI reporting layer across the funnel, from leadership dashboards to rep-level execution tools.
Design and maintain dashboards covering account and territory views, opportunity management, activity, and pipeline analysis.
Query and model data directly in SQL and BigQuery to answer questions beyond out-of-the-box Salesforce reporting.
Maintain data integrity and reporting consistency across regions, systems, and tools.
Identify opportunities to deploy AI and agentic workflows across revenue processes, and help build the technical foundations they require.
Support AI-assisted reporting and analysis workflows, and help drive fluency and adoption of the team’s AI tooling.


Must-haves

About You


You have 2–4 years of experience in a data analyst or similar analytics role.
You have strong SQL skills and can write, troubleshoot, and improve queries independently. This is the most important technical requirement for the role.
You have experience with a cloud data warehouse; we use Google BigQuery, and experience with Snowflake, Redshift, or an equivalent is also relevant.
You are fluent in Salesforce objects, reports, and dashboards.
You have built dashboards and reports in a BI tool; we use Metabase.
You are comfortable using AI tools to accelerate or improve analytical workflows.
You pay close attention to data quality and look for the “so what”, not just the output.
You can understand business needs and translate them into focused analyses and practical reporting solutions.
You are comfortable working hands-on with RevOps and Data teams as a technical partner.


Nice to have:


Exposure to go-to-market, sales, or revenue operations environments.
Experience working with global or multi-region teams.
Prior exposure to building or using AI or agentic workflows in a business context.


What we Offer


£70,000–£85,000 base salary London OR $90.000-$115.000 USD base salary in our US Locations.
Stock Options
A great office with a balance of in-person and remote work
Free Vacation Policy
100% Employer-Covered Health Insurance

Share your story: application with resume
Let's get to know each other through a screening interview
Meet with the hiring manager
Impress your future colleagues with a case study
Meet with a Leader
Reference Checks (3 most recent managers)
Offer: we want you


Thank you for taking the time to apply, and looking forward to getting to know you!

Job Summary

As an Associate Performance Analyst at HM Land Registry, you'll join a skilled analytical community at the heart of our digital transformation journey.

Working alongside experienced Performance Analysts and Senior Performance Analysts, you'll help deliver meaningful analysis and insight that supports the development of digital products and services used across the organisation. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your analytical skills, gain experience working with a wide variety of stakeholders, and build a rewarding career in data and performance analysis.

Please note that we will only offer sponsorship for a skilled worker visa where a role is in a certain business critical category. This role does not meet that category, and we will not sponsor a skilled worker visa. You must ensure you have the appropriate right to work in the UK before applying.

Job Description

At HM Land Registry, we're transforming the way we deliver services through digital innovation, and data plays a vital role in that journey. We're looking for an enthusiastic and motivated Associate Performance Analyst to join our analytical team and help us understand how our digital products are performing, where improvements can be made, and how we can provide better outcomes for our customers and colleagues.

You'll work in a supportive and collaborative environment, learning from experienced analysts while developing your own technical and analytical capabilities. Using data from a variety of sources, you'll help generate actionable insights that inform decision-making and support the continuous improvement of our digital services.

This role offers exposure to a broad range of digital transformation projects and the opportunity to work closely with colleagues from different professions, including data science, user research, customer insight, delivery and product management. Whether you're starting your analytical career or looking to build on existing experience, you'll be supported to learn, grow and make a meaningful impact.

Main Duties


Support Performance Analysts and Senior Performance Analysts in delivering data, analysis and insight to a range of stakeholders.
Help identify, source and analyse the most appropriate data to answer business questions and support decision-making.
Contribute to the creation of meaningful performance measures and frameworks for digital product teams.
Assist in developing analytical products that provide actionable insight and tell compelling data stories.
Communicate findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders, helping to influence digital product development and service improvements.
Build an understanding of HM Land Registry's business processes, services and digital products to enhance analytical outputs.
Collaborate with colleagues across a range of professions, including data science, user research, customer insight and product teams.
Support the monitoring and evaluation of product performance throughout the product lifecycle.
Work within Agile teams and contribute to the delivery of analytical outputs in a fast-paced environment.
Manage competing priorities effectively and adapt to changing business needs.
Contribute to continuous improvement activities, sharing knowledge and supporting the development of analytical best practice.


Key Role Benefits


Play a key role in supporting HM Land Registry's ambitious digital transformation programme.
Develop valuable technical and analytical skills while working on high-profile projects and services.
Gain hands-on experience using data to influence decision-making and improve digital products.
Work alongside experienced analysts in a supportive and collaborative team environment.
Build your understanding of digital delivery, performance measurement and evidence-based decision-making.
Collaborate with a diverse range of professionals across the organisation, broadening your knowledge and experience.
Access learning and development opportunities to support your personal and professional growth.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Permanent

Job title:
Senior SQL Data Analyst

Salary:
$90,000 - $95,000 + Bonus + Benefits

Role status:
Current opening

Our client:
A well-established Canadian professional services organization with a national presence and a strong reputation within its industry.

This is a highly visible role offering exposure to senior leadership and key business stakeholders across the organization. Our client is looking for a strong Senior SQL Data Analyst who can work with large, complex datasets, identify trends and business drivers, and translate analysis into clear, actionable insights for the business. This opportunity is ideal for someone who combines advanced SQL and analytical capability with polished communication skills, strong business acumen, and the confidence to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Principal tasks and responsibilities include:

Write complex SQL queries to extract, validate, analyze, and interpret large volumes of business and operational data.
Analyze revenue, pricing, productivity, profitability, utilization, and other key business performance metrics to support decision-making and performance improvement.
Identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities in the data, and provide actionable recommendations to business leaders.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting packages, dashboards, scorecards, and presentations for senior leadership.
Translate raw data into meaningful business insights that can be clearly understood by both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
Partner closely with leadership, finance, operations, and other business groups to understand reporting needs and answer key business questions through data.
Support strategic analysis, business planning, and performance reviews by delivering data-driven insight and thoughtful commentary.
Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards, management reporting tools, and automated reporting solutions.
Validate data integrity, troubleshoot reporting issues, and help improve the quality, consistency, and accessibility of business data.
Support business intelligence, reporting automation, and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
Present findings, trends, and recommendations in a polished, concise, and business-friendly manner to senior stakeholders.
Participate in special projects and ad hoc analytical initiatives requiring a strong mix of technical skill, business judgment, and communication.

Qualifications and pre-requisites:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, or a related field.
Strong academic background preferred. Candidates from well-regarded Canadian universities such as Western, Queen's, Laurier, Waterloo, McMaster, University of Toronto, Toronto Metropolitan, or other prominent Ontario / GTA schools would be of particular interest.
5+ years of progressive experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, commercial analytics, business insights, or a related analytical role.
Advanced SQL skills are a must. This role requires someone who can independently write complex queries, pull and manipulate large datasets, validate outputs, and use data to solve business problems.
Strong experience analyzing large datasets and turning complex information into clear, relevant, and actionable insights for the business.
Experience with Power BI, Excel, and other reporting / visualization tools. Exposure to VBA, Python, Tableau, or similar tools would be considered an asset.
Excellent communication skills are a must. This role requires someone who can confidently and clearly explain analysis, trends, and recommendations to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
Must be able to bridge the gap between data and the business - not just run reports, but clearly speak to what the data means, why it matters, and what actions should be taken.
Strong presentation skills, executive presence, and the ability to simplify complex information into a clear and compelling message.
We would be especially interested in candidates who have demonstrated strong communication and presentation ability through debate teams, Toastmasters, case competitions, client-facing roles, or other environments that reflect strong verbal communication and presence.
Strong critical thinking, curiosity, and problem-solving ability, with the instinct to dig into root causes and connect data back to business performance.
Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively in a visible role with accountability to senior stakeholders.
Polished, professional, and credible communicator with a strong business partnering mindset.

Additional information or perks:

Hybrid work environment.
Highly visible role with regular exposure to senior leadership and key decision-makers.
Opportunity to influence business decisions through data, analysis, and strategic insight.
Blend of technical analytics, reporting, and stakeholder-facing business support.
Strong long-term career growth opportunity within a well-established Canadian organization.
Comprehensive benefits package.
Competitive bonus opportunity.
Collaborative and team-oriented culture.
Strong commitment to employee development and continuous learning.

As a Data Analyst, you will join Canada Life’s Canada Operations & Business Enablement, Data Analytics and Reporting team. In this role you will support all Canada Operations and Business Enablement teams with the development, implementation, and maintenance of analytics solutions ranging from descriptive and diagnostic to predictive.

The Analyst, Data & Analytics supports decision making, monitors business performance, and provides actionable insights using analytics and statistical techniques.

In this role, you will assist in modelling, analysing, and predicting business processes. You will translate business requirements into data, reporting, and analytics projects, which you will support throughout their entire lifecycle.

What You Will Do


Translate business needs into data requirements, collect, integrate, clean, explore, model, and analyze large datasets and visualize results and present to business leaders
Build, implement and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards
Work with large datasets that are not consistent, clean, or fully modelled
Communicate effectively and demonstrate critical thinking and business acumen.
Define, implement, and monitor metrics and KPIs and ensure ongoing strategic alignment with short and long-term business objectives
Enable effective, efficient working relationships with business partners
Work closely with senior leaders to understand business drivers and enable them to make decisions based on data
Support projects throughout the entire analytics lifecycle
Present and communicate insights and recommendations in a visual and simplified manner

Reliability Status Security Clearance – this can only be completed with candidates who receive an offer of employment. 1-3 years of relevant experience and a bachelor’s degree in a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification is preferred
Demonstrated experience in working with data analytics tools (SQL, Python), Databases (SQL Server), Cloud (Azure, Databricks), data visualisation tools (Power BI) with experience at creating interactive dashboards
Ability to write efficient SQL and Python queries to extract, integrate, and transform data from multiple sources, and to automate data pipelines
Proficiency in Power BI, Data Modelling, Power Query, and DAX
Experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Good knowledge in data analytics and statistical modelling
Strong communication and presentation skills
Proven ability to learn quickly and independently and handle multiple priorities in a challenging work environment
Experience within the Financial Services sector would be an asset

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Autodesk Education
Description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100787

Position Overview

Autodesk Education Experiences, or AEX, helps students, educators, and education institutions build the skills and experience needed for the future of design and make. We strengthen connections between education and industry, expand adoption of Autodesk technology, and support workforce readiness in an increasingly AI-enabled world.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Business Operations and Analytics team. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Strategy, and other teams to understand business needs, scope analytical work, and turn customer and business data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

This role focuses on delivering insights and decision support while collaborating with data and technology teams as needed. You will work hands-on with SQL, Python, Snowflake, and business intelligence tools, and use approved AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, coding, synthesis, and communication.

Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.

Title: Analyste de données / Data Analyst
Description:
***An English version will follow***




À propos de nous

Fondée en 2015, Data Sciences (DS) n'est pas une agence comme les autres. Nous sommes un groupe d’experts de pointe en analyse de données, en recherche, en marketing numérique et en campagnes d'engagement avec un objectif commun et ambitieux : inspirer des changements de comportement qui ont un impact réel.

Ensemble, nous offrons aux ONG canadiennes et internationales, aux partis politiques et aux grandes entreprises des conseils stratégiques et des analyses fondées sur des bases scientifiques rigoureuses. Notre but ? Les aider à mieux comprendre, mobiliser et approfondir leurs liens avec leurs clients et leurs parties prenantes.

Chez DS, on vit selon la « règle du campeur » : on s’engage à laisser chaque projet, partenariat et communauté dans un meilleur état qu'on l'a trouvé. Puisque notre mission est de comprendre l’humain, nous plaçons l’humain au premier plan. Ici, on valorise une culture de transparence, d’entraide et une bonne dose de memes sur Slack. Que ce soit lors de nos dîners d'été ou de nos pauses café virtuelles mensuelles, on priorise la connexion humaine autant que l'excellence technique.




Ce que nous offrons

** Échelle salariale : 80k - 95k CAD **
Un régime d'assurance médicale et dentaire compétitif, payé à 100 % par l'employeur.
Perkopolis: Un accès gratuit à une foule de rabais et d'économies sur les divertissements, les voyages, le magasinage et les produits de bien-être.
Mode de travail hybride avec un bureau dans le quartier St-Henri, approvisionné en collations et en café.
Une tonne d'activités et de traditions pour créer un environnement inclusif et divertissant.
Un ordinateur MacBook fourni dès ton arrivée.
3 semaines de vacances par année.
5 jours personnels à utiliser à ta discrétion.
Un environnement de travail dynamique où aucune journée ne se ressemble.
Des opportunités de croissance grâce au financement de cours, de conférences et de certifications.
Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».
La chance de rejoindre une équipe multidisciplinaire en pleine croissance.




Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) analyste de données qui rejoindra notre équipe diversifiée et en pleine croissance à Montréal. La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Nous valorisons la créativité, le travail acharné et l’excellence au travail. La personne idéale est très motivée, soucieuse du détail, curieuse et à la recherche de défis. Elle doit pouvoir travailler eﬃcacement avec les membres de nos équipes d'ingénierie des données, de recherche et de numérique.




Responsabilités

Interpréter les objectifs globaux du client et les traduire en exigences visant à fournir des renseignements (« insights ») et/ou à générer des gains d'eﬃcacité.
Accéder, comprendre, interroger et transformer des données provenant d’une grande variété de sources, chacune avec son propre ensemble de subtilités.
Concevoir, développer et déployer des rapports sur mesure et automatisés, dans le but de fournir aux clients des informations rapides et exploitables.
Concevoir et coordonner des protocoles expérimentaux dans divers départements afin d'identifier des gains d'eﬃcacité stratégiques.
Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.
Participer à des projets spéciaux et autres tâches connexes selon les besoins.




Exigences

D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
Bilinguisme français et anglais.
Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.




La connaissance de la langue anglaise est exigée pour ce poste, car les fonctions de la personne titulaire nécessiteront des communications quotidiennes avec une clientèle majoritairement anglophone située à l'extérieur du Québec.




--




About Us

Established in 2015, Data Sciences (DS) isn’t your typical agency. We are a group of leading experts in the fields of data analytics, research, digital marketing and engagement campaigns that have a common, ambitious goal: driving meaningful behaviour change.

Together, we provide Canadian and international NGOs, political parties, and major companies with well-designed, scientifically sound guidance, research, analytics, and marketing, in order to help them understand, engage and deepen their relationships with their customers and stakeholders.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.




What We Offer

** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **
100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.
Hybrid work model with a snacks-and-coffee-stocked office in Montreal’s St-Henri neighbourhood.
Many internal traditions to create an inclusive and fun environment.
A MacBook computer on your first day.
3 weeks vacation.
5 personal days to use at your discretion.
A fast-paced work environment where every day is different.
The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.




About The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful applicant will be responsible for leveraging client data to produce rapid insights through automated reporting and custom analytics. This individual has experience manipulating large and often complex datasets, both structured and unstructured. We are looking for individuals from a wide range of backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative and problem-solving skills. We value creativity, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated, detail oriented, curious and who seeks to take on a challenging role. We need someone who can work effectively with members of our data engineering, research and digital teams to deliver data-driven products to organizations.




Key Responsibilities

Translate a client’s overarching business objectives into requirements and then into discrete projects that aim to provide insight and/or generate eﬃciencies.
Access, understand, query, and transform data from a large variety of data sources, each with its own set of intricacies.
Design, develop, and deploy custom automated reporting solutions with the goal of providing clients with rapid, actionable insights.
Design and coordinate experimental protocols in various departments to identify strategic eﬃciencies.
Communicate insights and methodologies clearly and succinctly to both technical and lay audiences.
Special projects, and other duties as required.




Candidate Qualifications

Strong problem solving skills.
2+ years experience writing complex SQL queries to transform and extract data from relational databases or data warehouses.
Experience writing R and/or Python code aimed at manipulating and analyzing large datasets.
Understanding of statistical principles.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Fully bilingual in English and French.
Ability to coordinate across teams.




Knowledge of English is required for this position as the incumbent will be required to interact daily with a predominantly English-speaking clientele located outside of Quebec.

Description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to work a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in our San Francisco or Toronto offices, and to translate complex healthcare and product data into clear, actionable insights that drive strategy and business impact. You are a fit if you thrive in ambiguous, cross-functional environments, own analytical deep work end to end, and enjoy influencing decisions through rigorous, well-communicated analysis.

What you’ll do:


Work cross-functionally with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success to scope and implement trusted business metrics, proactively identify data integrity issues, and optimize operational workflows.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights with strategic recommendations that drive measurable actions and outcomes to inform business priorities.
Communicate analysis results and outcomes clearly and tailor messaging based on the audience.
Help build and evolve our analytical foundation, including event instrumentation, metric frameworks, and scalable self-serve analytics tools.

Description:
Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. We provide the world’s best end-to-end software supply chain security solution, combining the only proactive protection against malicious open source, the only enterprise grade SBOM management and the leading open source dependency management platform. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.

As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers and our open source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.

More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains.

At Sonatype, we empower developers with best in class tools to build secure, high-quality software at scale. Our mission is to create a world where software is always secure and developers can innovate without fear. Trusted by thousands of organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, we are pioneers in software supply chain management, open source security, and DevSecOps.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team. In this role, you will transform complex product datasets into actionable insights, build scalable analytics infrastructure, mentor associate-level analysts, and drive data-informed product decisions.

What You’ll Do


Product Analytics & Telemetry: Analyze product usage, feature adoption, and telemetry data alongside financial metrics to optimize user experience and support product strategy.
Analytics & Data Modeling: Own the end-to-end analytics lifecycle, including data modeling, dashboard creation, and KPI development. Deliver high-accuracy analyses independently across various product initiatives.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with cross-functional business stakeholders, managing requirements and delivering precise insights on tight turnarounds.
Mentorship: Serve as a technical guide to coach and mentor the team’s cohort of associate-level analysts.
Execution Metrics: Maintain high standards for ticket throughput, speed of delivery, and on-time completion rates for analytics tasks.


What You'll Bring


Experience: 5+ years in data analysis, BI, or product analytics—specifically within a SaaS or tech company. Experience working with product telemetry/usage data is strictly required.
Location: Must be based in Canada (excluding Quebec; Ontario or Eastern time zone preferred).
Technical Stack:
Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).
Hands-on experience with visualization tools—Looker is heavily preferred (or ability to quickly adapt from Power BI/Tableau).
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.
Qualitative Traits: Strong curiosity, meticulous attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and clear communication skills.
Nice to Have: Knowledge of business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Amplitude, Gainsight).

What We're Proud Of


2025 Best DevSecOps Solution by DevOps Dozen
Visionary in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Application Security Testing
2025 DEVIES Award to our SBOM Manager new product for its innovation and impact in developer technology
2024 Industry Leader in Forrester-Wave for Software Composition Analysis (2024 Q4 report)
2023 Fast Company Best Places for Innovators

2023 Software Report's Top 100 Software Companies
2023 BuiltIn Best Places to Work

2022 PeerSpot Silver Peer Award in Software Composition Analysis
2022 Tech Ascension Best DevOps Security Solution Award
2022 NVCT Cyber Company of the Year
Company Wellness days - We shut down company operations during some days of the year (5 in total) to enable all employees to pursue personal growth and enjoy much-needed and deserved additional rest.

Title: Data Analyst, Program Evaluation & Reporting
Description:
Data Analyst, Program Evaluation & Reporting




The University of Manitoba is a driving force of innovation, discovery and advancement. Our momentum is propelled by our campus community – UM faculty, staff and students whose determination and curiosity shape our world for the better. Our teaching, learning and work environment is uniquely strengthened and enriched by Indigenous perspectives. With two main campuses in Winnipeg, satellite campuses throughout Manitoba, and world-wide research, UM’s impact is global.




Discover outstanding employee benefits, experience world-class facilities and join a dynamic community that values reconciliation, sustainability, diversity, and inclusion. We are one of Manitoba’s Top Employers and one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers. At the University of Manitoba, what inspires you can change everything.




The opportunity:




The Department of Family Medicine is seeking a Data Analyst, Program Evaluation & Reporting to support evidence-based decision-making, accreditation, workforce planning, and continuous quality improvement across its education and academic programs. The successful candidate will collect, validate, analyze, and interpret quantitative and qualitative data from multiple sources, develop dashboards and standardized reports, support program evaluation and accreditation activities, and provide meaningful insights to departmental leadership and committees.




This role will also support data integration and reporting from systems such as Entrada, SurveyMonkey, Cognito Forms, and Excel; conduct audits and longitudinal analyses; track learner outcomes, teaching capacity, and workforce trends; and identify opportunities to improve data quality, accessibility, and reporting efficiency. The ideal candidate will bring strong analytical and communication skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to translate complex information into clear, actionable insights while working collaboratively with academic and administrative stakeholders.




The qualifications and experience we’re looking for:




Undergraduate degree in data analytics, health informatics, statistics, public health, business analytics, or a related discipline required.
Master’s degree in a related discipline preferred.
Minimum three (3) years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or program evaluation.

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
Junior Data Analyst

Location: Toronto, ON

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience Level: Junior / Entry Level (0–2 years)

About the Role

We are looking for a curious, detail-oriented Junior Data Analyst to support our growing analytics and reporting needs.You will work closely with the Business Intelligence Lead and cross-functional teams including Field Operations, Client Services, Finance, and leadership. The role combines reporting, data quality, and business analysis, with a strong focus on understanding not only what is happening in the data, but why.

What You’ll Do

Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), identify trends and anomalies, and investigate changes in business performance.
Conduct root-cause analysis by drilling into performance across clients, campaigns, markets, offices, teams, and individual representatives.
Work with Field Operations and Client Services to validate findings and understand the operational drivers behind performance.
Support the development and maintenance of dashboards, reports, and analytical tools.
Write and maintain SQL queries to extract, clean, join, aggregate, and analyze data.
Prepare, import, clean, transform, and reconcile datasets from multiple sources.
Perform regular data-quality checks and investigate missing, duplicated, inconsistent, or unexpected records.
Validate reports and analytical outputs before distribution and support processes that improve data accuracy and reliability.
Perform ad-hoc analysis to answer business questions and support decision-making.

What We’re Looking For

Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
0–2 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or a related role.
Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Strong Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and data manipulation.
Experience with a BI/visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, or Zoho Analytics.
Understanding of data cleaning, joins, aggregations, segmentation, and KPI analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
Ability to communicate findings clearly and collaborate with technical and non-technical teams.

Nice to Have: Experience with Zoho Analytics, Python, APIs/workflow automation, or CRM, fundraising, financial, sales, or transaction data.

Salary Range: $50,000–$70,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.
