Job Title: Data Analyst

Vacancies: This posting is for (1) new role

Location: Toronto, ON (Detailed office location information can be found by visiting this link: https://cancer.ca/en/contact-us)

Work Model: Hybrid Work Model

Salary Band: 5 ($70,000 - $75,000 CAD)

HELP SHAPE THE FUTURE OF CANCER CARE IN CANADA

The Canadian Cancer Society works tirelessly to save lives, improve lives and drive collective action against cancer. Together with patients, volunteers, donors and communities across the country, we raise funds to invest in transformative cancer research, we provide a caring support system for everyone affected by cancer and we advocate to governments to create a healthier future for all. It takes a society to take on cancer – and the Canadian Cancer Society is leading the way




MAKING AN IMPACT

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Data Governance and Analytics, the Data Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining analytics solutions, reports, and dashboards that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Leverage SQL, scripting, and modern analytics platforms to extract, transform, and analyze complex datasets, delivering actionable insights and recommendations that align with business goals
Partner with business and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable, and well-governed analytics solutions
Support a culture of data-driven decision-making by applying automation, engineering best practices, and modern design patterns to improve how data is analyzed, visualized, and utilized across the organization




What You’ll Be Doing




1.Analytics & Reporting Development

Report & Dashboard Development

Design, develop, and maintain reports and dashboards using Salesforce CRM Analytics, Salesforce Reporting, and Power BI to support organization teams
Build and optimize semantic models and datasets to support business reporting and analytics needs
Optimize reporting and dashboard assets for usability, performance and accessibility

Analytics & Insights

Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities across business functions
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for business teams
Use predictive models and statistical analyses to support donor segmentation, campaign targeting, and fundraising forecasting
Leverage advanced analytics techniques including propensity scoring, trend analysis, and cohort modeling to inform business strategy

Collaboration & Engagement

Partner with cross-functional teams including business partners, data engineers, and digital teams
Provide guidance and support to business users on reporting and analytics tools




2.Data Development & Transformation

Data Preparation & Processing

Extract, transform, and prepare analytical datasets using SQL, Python and scripting languages
Build and maintain reporting datasets, dataflows, and curated data assets incorporating key metrics and business data
Utilize enterprise data platforms (e.g., Microsoft Fabric) as supporting data sources where required

Data Modeling & Documentation

Contribute to the design and optimization of data models that support reporting and analytics platforms
Develop and maintain documentation for datasets, data definitions, and analytical processes




3.Operational Excellence

Automation

Automate repetitive reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows using Python and scripting

DevOps

Utilize version control practices for analytics assets, reports, and code
Contribute to CI/CD processes for analytics solution deployment using Azure DevOps

Quality

Develop and maintain automated testing for reports, datasets, and analytics solutions
Support monitoring and validation of analytics pipelines and reporting processes
Apply development best practices including code quality, documentation, and peer review




4.Data Governance & Standards

Governance & Compliance

Apply data governance, compliance, and data quality standards when developing analytics solutions
Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting outputs
Adhere to data privacy, security and compliance requirements (PII, PHI etc.)

Data Standards

Support adherence to established data policies, standards, and best practices




5.Other

Contribute to our culture of diversity, inclusion, belonging and equity (DIBE) by ensuring that all staff feel represented, valued, and heard across all aspects of their identity, including gender, age, religion, ethnicity, nationality, race, and sexuality.
Other duties as assigned




QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics or a related discipline
More than 3 years, up to and including 5 years - similar or related general experience in progressively more important positions




Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and analytical dataset development
Proficiency in Python and/or scripting languages for data analysis and automation
Experience designing and developing reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Salesforce Reporting, Salesforce CRM Analytics and Power BI
Experience building and optimizing semantic models and analytical datasets
Experience working with Fabric to build and manage data pipelines, dataflows, automated workflows, and analytics solutions.
Understanding of data modeling concepts and relational database design
Others may apply




Operational Excellence

Experience with DevOps practices including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks
Experience automating reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows
Knowledge of Agile development practices including code quality, testing, documentation, and peer review
Experience developing and maintaining automated testing for analytics solutions and reports




Analytical Skills

Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear, scalable analytics solutions
Strong exploratory data analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
Ability to identify trends, patterns, and insights from large and complex datasets
Experience with predictive modeling, statistical analysis, or data-driven segmentation techniques




Communication Skills

Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to present complex data findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience collaborating across business functions to support data-driven decision-making
Bilingualism (French/English) is highly preferred , with French being an asset due to the organization’s nationwide operations and the need for effective communication across various regions




What You Can Expect From Us

CCS provides impactful opportunities to transform the lives of Canadians affected by cancer. We are devoted to creating an inclusive workplace that celebrates diverse experiences and skills, encouraging all qualified candidates to join us. Our inspiring culture is rooted in our core values and commitment to meaningful change: COURAGEOUS UNITED CARING RIGOROUS

Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About The Role

As a CBRE Business Intelligence Sr. Analyst, you will be responsible for conducting advanced research, data mining,reporting and interpretation of company performance metrics.

This job is part of the Data Science & Analytics job function. They are responsible for reviewing data that supports improving effectiveness and predicting outcomes to develop business intelligence.

What You’ll Do


Generate and review reports using aggregate data from multiple sources to assist in creating a complete evaluation, improvement, or recommendation.
Review the accuracy of information provided and respond to escalated requests from management and vendors.
Understand and work with advanced scenario planning tools and models. Investigate new trends in general business conditions.
Identify opportunities for large improvements among the clients and company.
Work with personnel from other departments and information technology groups to facilitate successful project implementations.
Review the maintenance and reporting of benchmarks and performance metrics.
Act as subject matter expert for key systems and processes and day-to-day functions.
Apply general knowledge of standard principles and techniques/procedures to accomplish assigned tasks and solve routine problems.
Have a broad knowledge of own job discipline and some knowledge of several job disciplines within the function.

About The Department

The Regional Municipality of Wood Buffalo (RMWB) is one of Canada's most unique and fast-evolving regions — a place where innovative thinking meets real-world impact. Our Planning and Development Division shapes where we live, work and play.

Planning & Development at RMWB is more than policies and plans, it’s about creating vibrant, inclusive and sustainable communities. Join a collaborative team that leads long-term strategy, supports development initiatives, and partners with residents and community partners to build our shared future.

If you're passionate about smart growth and public service, this is your opportunity to make your mark.

General Description

Under general supervision, the Data Analyst supports Planning and Development Services in all data extraction, transformation, and analysis functions for the department. The incumbent extracts, transforms, structures, and analyzes data on all Planning and Development Services key performance indicators (KPIs) and overall metrics to provide insight into permitting and licensing activities in the Municipality. This position also researches, analyzes, and reports on the Municipality's economic and demographic trends using municipal and third-party data to inform various municipal projects and statutory plans.

Responsibilities


Prepares and releases scheduled or ad-hoc reports on Planning and Development Services activities by extracting, transforming, and analyzing permit and licensing data.
Supports Planning and Development Services department with strategies and process enhancements to reduce data input errors in the Accela permitting database.
Processes and responds to internal and external stakeholder Planning and Development Services data and analysis requests.
Supports department with data extraction and transformation from the Accela permitting database.
Uses statistical and data visualization tools to implement and maintain an interactive dashboard that provides real-time information and interprets data on permitting and licensing activities in the Municipality.
Works with Planning and Development Services to support all Accela functionality improvement efforts through best practice research.
Creates documentation that allows stakeholders to understand the steps of the data analysis process.
Analyzes municipal-specific primary and secondary demographic and socio-economic data to generate insight into population trends in the Municipality.
Supports all infield data collection analysis and reporting during the Municipal census.
Other related duties as required.


Qualifications

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:


Ability to work independently or in a team and establish and maintain cooperative, collaborative, and productive work relationships.
Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources.
Exceptional research and reporting skills, with the ability to analyze information from a variety of sources and accurately present in a concise manner.
High degree of precision and accuracy in data entry, documentation, and investigative procedures.
Ability to learn, understand, and apply new technologies in data science and analytics.
Strong analytic and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in computer technology, as it relates to data science and analytics, particularly in the use of spreadsheets, databases, presentation, and data visualization tools (SQL, R, Python, Tableau, Microsoft Power BI, etc.).


Education And Experience


Degree in Geography, Economics, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, or other related field is required.
Three (3) years of experience in data analysis and research, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), or data science is required.
Experience with GIS tools such as ArcMap 10.8 or ArcGIS Pro is an asset.
Experience in policy analysis and project management is an asset.
Experience working with third-party data sources such as Statistics Canada is an asset.


Other Requirements


Submission of a Criminal Record Check.
Pre-employment testing may be required as part of the interview process.


Safety

As an employee of the Regional Municipality of Wood Buffalo, the incumbent is responsible for understanding and actively participating in the RMWB’s health and safety management system, including all policies, practices, procedures, as well as properly utilizing all control measures including the required use of personal protective equipment. All employees must take reasonable care to protect the health and safety of themselves and others, as well as immediately report any concerns, near misses, incidents, and hazardous conditions to their supervisor.

To apply: Please visit our website at jobs.rmwb.ca

Current employees must apply through the internal careers site.

We appreciate the interest of all applicants; however, only those individuals

selected for interviews will be contacted. Late applications will not be accepted.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Project Description

Hiredbuddy is seeking a motivated Data Analyst to join our remote team. You will support business decisions by collecting, cleaning, and interpreting data, creating reports and dashboards, and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Ideal for entry-level candidates with a strong foundation in SQL, Excel, and data visualization.

Full Description

Hiredbuddy is looking for an entry-level Data Analyst to join our growing analytics team. This fully remote role is perfect for someone who is eager to apply their analytical skills to real-world business challenges, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and build a strong foundation in data-driven decision making.

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for collecting, cleaning, and interpreting data from various sources, transforming raw numbers into actionable insights. You will work closely with stakeholders in marketing, operations, and product to understand their reporting needs and deliver clear visualizations that drive strategy.

Your day-to-day will involve writing SQL queries to extract data from relational databases, performing exploratory analysis in Excel or Python, and building dashboards in tools like Tableau or Power BI. You will also assist in maintaining data quality by identifying and correcting inconsistencies, documenting data pipelines, and suggesting improvements to data collection processes.

We expect you to be curious, detail-oriented, and committed to continuous learning. You will receive mentorship from senior analysts, participate in regular team meetings, and have opportunities to present your findings to leadership. While prior internship or coursework is beneficial, we value a strong analytical mindset and the ability to communicate complex ideas simply.

Key responsibilities include:

Writing and optimizing SQL queries to pull and aggregate data
Cleaning and preprocessing datasets to ensure accuracy and completeness
Performing statistical analysis and trend identification
Creating and maintaining dashboards and ad-hoc reports
Collaborating with team members to define metrics and KPIs
Documenting analysis processes and findings for reproducibility
Staying up-to-date with industry best practices and emerging tools

This role offers an excellent chance to grow your technical skills while contributing directly to business outcomes. If you are passionate about turning data into insights and thrive in a remote-first culture, we encourage you to apply.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field
0–2 years of experience (internships or academic projects acceptable)
Proficiency in SQL and Excel (pivot tables, formulas, charting)
Familiarity with data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or similar
Basic knowledge of Python or R for data manipulation is a plus
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent written and verbal communication abilities
Ability to work independently in a remote environment
A keen eye for detail and a commitment to data accuracy

Benefits

Flexible remote work environment
Professional development budget for courses and certifications
Paid time off and paid holidays

Description:
SYSTRA Canada is part of the SYSTRA group, an international consulting and engineering group, a world leader in the design of transport infrastructures. SYSTRA Canada is an engineering and consulting firm whose primary focus is to offer transportation solutions, whether for passengers or goods: feasibility studies of building a new railway line, increasing the capacity of the existing infrastructure, privatization of a railway.

Context

The ALTO project is a major infrastructure initiative in Canadian history, aimed at developing over 1,000 km of new passenger rail service between major urban centers, including Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal and Quebec City.

Missions/Main Duties


Manage, structure, analyze, and standardize project data to support business and user requirements.
Develop and automate data processes and optimize tools across the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem to improve efficiency and data quality.
Build and maintain dashboards, visualizations, dataflows, and semantic models in Power BI and Microsoft Fabric to monitor performance and generate insights.
Work with stakeholders to define reporting needs, deliver effective solutions, and support informed decision-making.
Maintain documentation and ensure compliance with governance, security, and regulatory requirements.


Profile/Skills

Education: Bachelor’s degree in in computer science, business intelligence, data analytics, statistics, business administration, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

Years of experience: 2 to 3 years of experience in a similar role.

Technical Skills


Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Dataflow Gen2, Data Factory, and Notebooks, for data ingestion, storage, organization, transformation, and orchestration of analytics workflows.
Proficiency in Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric to design, maintain, and optimize semantic models, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
Strong command of DAX and Power Query for data modeling, extraction, cleansing, transformation, and advanced analytics.
Solid understanding of data modeling, data governance, and data quality principles.
Ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing, in French and English*
Reasons for the bilingual requirement: You will have the opportunity to collaborate with various project stakeholders; bilingualism is essential for building strong relationships with our clients, understanding their specific needs, and communicating effectively in their preferred language.

Analytical mindset, rigor, and autonomy
Ability to work in an agile and collaborative environment

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Lookout, Inc. is the leader in mobile AI security, delivering continuous threat exposure management for the modern, mobile-driven enterprise. Built on over 15 years of specialized expertise and informed by a global dataset analyzing hundreds of millions of mobile devices and applications, Lookout protects organizations against both behavioral and structural mobile risk.

Through its unified platform, featuring AI Visibility & Governance and the Mobile Software Exposure Center (MSEC), Lookout secures both sides of the mobile AI equation: governing user-to-AI interactions to prevent outbound data leakage while illuminating the mobile software supply chain to neutralize inbound, machine-speed vulnerabilities. By seamlessly feeding real-time mobile telemetry into broader enterprise CTEM and SOC workflows, Lookout closes the mobile exposure blind spot, enabling organizations to reduce risk and operate with confidence. To learn more, visit www.lookout.com and follow Lookout on LinkedIn and X.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead the company's reporting and analytics function. As the sole Data Analyst, this role serves as an internal analytics consultant, partnering with teams across the organization to turn business, product, and security data into actionable insights.

The Senior Data Analyst analyzes business operations, customer behavior, mobile application telemetry, and security event data to support decision-making, measure product performance, identify trends, and inform strategic planning. They also contribute to financial reporting, assisting with quarter-end close, invoicing and reconciliation. Success in this role requires advanced SQL skills, strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, independence, and excellent communication skills.

What You'll Do

Business, Product & Security Analytics


Develop and maintain executive dashboards and operational reports using Tableau.
Analyze and contextualize:
business metrics including revenue, customer growth, subscriptions, retention, product adoption, and operational performance.
mobile application telemetry, customer behavior, product usage, and feature adoption.
security event data to monitor threats, trends, anomalies, and product effectiveness.


Partner with Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, and Security Intelligence to address recurring and ad hoc analytical needs.
Define and monitor KPIs and identify trends and opportunities for business and product improvement.
Translate complex data findings into clear insights and recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.



Data & Reporting


Write efficient SQL queries in AWS Athena to extract and analyze large datasets stored in Amazon S3.
Integrate data from multiple internal systems to develop meaningful reporting and analytical solutions.
Design, develop, publish, and maintain Tableau dashboards used throughout the organization.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
Document data sources, business rules, report definitions, and analytical methodologies.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and analysis.




Qualifications

Required


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
5+ years of experience delivering analytics or business intelligence solutions in technology, mobile applications, cybersecurity, or a related environment.
Expert-level SQL proficiency and experience working with complex relational datasets.
Experience with AWS Athena or a similar cloud-based analytical query engine.
Advanced Tableau or equivalent BI platform experience.
Strong understanding of relational databases and data modeling.
Experience analyzing software product telemetry, application usage, or operational event data.
Experience working with large-scale datasets in cloud environments.
Ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and recommendations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects with minimal supervision.




Preferred


Experience with Python or R for statistical analysis, data exploration, and automation.
Experience in cybersecurity, mobile applications, and/or SaaS.
Knowledge of data governance and data quality practices.
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools and workflows for automating reporting and analysis.




Success In This Role

Success in this role means becoming a trusted analytics partner across the organization. The Senior Data Analyst will deliver accurate, timely, and actionable insights; proactively identify opportunities for improvement; and continuously enhance the company's reporting and analytical capabilities.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.




We are seeking experienced Data Analysts to support a large-scale data migration and integration initiative. You will be responsible for investigating existing data structures, analyzing business logic hidden in queries and reports, mapping source data to target systems, and collaborating with business stakeholders to ensure accuracy and completeness.




This role is highly investigative and requires a blend of technical analysis and business communication skills. You should be comfortable navigating undocumented environments, reverse-engineering logic, and documenting findings clearly for both technical and business audiences.




This role follows our in‑office work model and requires employees to be onsite four days per week to support collaboration and business needs.




Key Responsibilities




Source System Analysis

Investigate source systems and databases to understand data structures, relationships, and logic.
Analyze existing SQL queries, reports, and stored procedures to reverse engineer business rules.

Data Mapping & Transformation

Map source fields to target model requirements.
Identify gaps, data quality issues, and transformation needs.
Work closely with data engineers to validate ETL/transformation rules.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with business SMEs and stakeholders to clarify definitions, logic, and requirements.
Translate technical findings into clear documentation for non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer

Produce detailed data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Capture undocumented business logic and processes uncovered during investigation.

Validation & Testing Support

Support data validation and reconciliation efforts during development and UAT.
Assist in resolving discrepancies between source and target systems.




Required Skills & Experience




Strong SQL skills, with ability to read, analyze, and write complex queries.
Proven experience in data migration, data warehousing, or system integration projects.
5 years of Data Analyst experience with a strong background in analyzing large datasets.
Strong data profiling, mapping, and reconciliation skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities in ambiguous environments.
Strong communication skills to work with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
Experience creating data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Experience with dashboard tools such as Sigma or equivalent
Experience with code repository systems – Bitbucket or Git




Nice to Have




Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data platforms.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and tools.
Exposure to financial services or other regulated industries

Title: Data Analyst, Power BI
Description:
SYSTRA Canada is part of the SYSTRA group, an international consulting and engineering group, a world leader in the design of transport infrastructures. SYSTRA Canada is an engineering and consulting firm whose primary focus is to offer transportation solutions, whether for passengers or goods: feasibility studies of building a new railway line, increasing the capacity of the existing infrastructure, privatization of a railway.

Context

The ALTO project is a major infrastructure initiative in Canadian history, aimed at developing over 1,000 km of new passenger rail service between major urban centers, including Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal and Quebec City.

Missions/Main Duties


Manage, structure, analyze, and standardize project data to support business and user requirements.
Develop and automate data processes and optimize tools across the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem to improve efficiency and data quality.
Build and maintain dashboards, visualizations, dataflows, and semantic models in Power BI and Microsoft Fabric to monitor performance and generate insights.
Work with stakeholders to define reporting needs, deliver effective solutions, and support informed decision-making.
Maintain documentation and ensure compliance with governance, security, and regulatory requirements.


Profile/Skills

Education: Bachelor’s degree in in computer science, business intelligence, data analytics, statistics, business administration, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

Years of experience: 2 to 3 years of experience in a similar role.

Technical Skills


Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Dataflow Gen2, Data Factory, and Notebooks, for data ingestion, storage, organization, transformation, and orchestration of analytics workflows.
Proficiency in Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric to design, maintain, and optimize semantic models, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
Strong command of DAX and Power Query for data modeling, extraction, cleansing, transformation, and advanced analytics.
Solid understanding of data modeling, data governance, and data quality principles.
Ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing, in French and English*
Reasons for the bilingual requirement: You will have the opportunity to collaborate with various project stakeholders; bilingualism is essential for building strong relationships with our clients, understanding their specific needs, and communicating effectively in their preferred language.


Interpersonal Skills


Analytical mindset, rigor, and autonomy
Ability to work in an agile and collaborative environment
Strong technical communication skills.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver

  • Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
  • Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
  • Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
  • Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
  • Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
  • Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
  • Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships

Transform

  • Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
  • Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
  • Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
  • Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
  • Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making

What We’re Looking For

  • 3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
  • Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
  • Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
  • Intermediate SQL for analytics
  • Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
  • A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
  • Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent

Nice-to-have

  • Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
  • Mentoring or coaching experience
  • Experience in Python or PySpark
  • Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.

Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits

  • 4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
  • 1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
  • Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.

Title: Analyste sénior en intelligence d'affaires
HTML:
Sous la supervision de la Directrice-adjointe analyse, l'analyste en intelligence d'affaires senior jouera un rôle clé dans la conception de tableaux de bord, l'analyse de tendances et la production de prévisions basées sur les données. Il/Elle contribuera à la définition, la mise en place et l'évolution des indicateurs de performance, des mesures, des tableaux de bord et des schémas de données nécessaires au déploiement de l'intelligence d'affaires d'AGA.

L'analyste sera également responsable de promouvoir et d'assurer l'application de bonnes pratiques en matière de gestion et d'utilisation sécuritaire des données. Le développement de relations solides, tant avec les collègues multidisciplinaires de l'équipe qu'avec les clients internes sur le terrain, demeure essentiel pour réussir dans ce rôle.

Le·la titulaire de ce poste sera, entre autres, appelé à :

  • Collecter, transformer, nettoyer et organiser les données provenant de différentes sources internes, en veillant à leur qualité et à leur cohérence;
  • Concevoir, maintenir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord et rapports à l'aide d'outils de visualisation comme Power BI ou outils similaires;
  • Accompagner les équipes dans la gestion du changement lors de l'implantation de nouvelles solutions, notamment par la formation et la documentation;
  • Proposer et réaliser des analyses descriptives et exploratoires pour identifier des tendances, infos pertinentes, anomalies ou opportunités;
  • Collaborer avec l'ensemble des équipes métiers AGA (actuariat, finances, opérations, marketing, etc.) afin de comprendre leurs besoins, analyser leurs flux de travail afin de proposer des solutions et identifier des axes d'amélioration basées sur les données;
  • Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus de gestion de données et de production de rapports;
  • Documenter les méthodologies, les besoins, les indicateurs de performance, les mesures, les tableaux de bord, les schémas de données, les sources de données, les processus afin d'assurer la traçabilité et la fiabilité des analyses;
  • Déterminer les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI), élaborer les mesures nécessaires à l'évaluation de la performance, analyser l'évolution des résultats et développer des modèles prévisionnels lorsque requis;
  • Effectuer des analyses ad hoc ou extraire des listes de données selon les besoins;
  • Documenter et mettre à jour de façon quotidienne et systématique l'ensemble de ses tâches et projets dans JIRA, afin d'assurer un suivi clair et en temps réel de l'avancement;
  • Créer et maintenir des flux Power Automate;
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe de même nature et en relation directe avec cet emploi ou à la demande de son supérieur.

Le·la candidat·e idéal·e possède ce qui suit:

Formation et expérience

  • Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, finances, intelligence d’affaires, informatique / sciences informatiques / informatique de gestion, gestion de l'information ou Baccalauréat d’ingénieur (génie informatique / génie des technologies de l’information) et/ou d’ingénierie et analytique des données (Maîtrise est un atout);
  • 5-7 ans d’expérience en analyse de données, prévisions et création de tableaux de bord;
  • Expérience en assurances collectives est un atout.

Compétences techniques

  • Maîtrise de Power BI;
  • Maîtrise d’Excel, de la suite Office et de SQL;
  • Compétences mathématiques et/ou académiques nécessaires pour recueillir, mesurer, organiser et analyser des données et effectuer des prévisions statistiques;
  • Capacité à transformer des données brutes en informations utiles et compréhensibles;
  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, pour collaborer efficacement avec nos équipes partout au Canada;
  • Connaissance de Power Automate un atout;
  • Connaissance de Power BI Report Builder un atout;
  • Familiarité avec un langage de programmation analytique (Python ou R) un atout;
  • Connaissance de base de JIRA et de Confluence un atout.

Qualités personnelles et professionnelles

  • Esprit analytique développé et grande rigueur;
  • Forte curiosité analytique et esprit critique pour proposer des axes d’analyse innovants et des visualisations percutantes;
  • Excellent sens de l’organisation et de la gestion des priorités;
  • Aptitude à travailler en équipe et à communiquer clairement avec des interlocuteurs non techniques (vulgarisation des calculs ou des résultats);
  • Discrétion et respect de la confidentialité des données.

Au sein du service des données de Mistplay, l'analyste de données sénior I, Produit jouera un rôle crucial dans l'amélioration de la performance commerciale de Mistplay grâce à une analyse perspicace et à une stratégie d'analyse dynamique. Rattaché au Responsable de l'analyse des données et de l'expérimentation, tu collaboreras avec les responsables des produits et du cycle de vie pour planifier et analyser les résultats des tests A/B, et tu conduiras des rapports d'analyse afin d'informer le lancement de nouvelles fonctionnalités du produit et de stratégies d'engagement.


Tes missions chez Mistplay : 






Mener des analyses proactives pour identifier des informations exploitables, notamment en se plongeant dans l'entonnoir du produit de base, les cohortes d'utilisateurs et en analysant les données relatives au comportement des utilisateurs, afin d'identifier les domaines de l'expérience utilisateur qui peuvent être améliorés pour générer de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires.








Définir des ICP pour l'entreprise et construire des tableaux de bord automatisés, des rapports et des modèles pour permettre aux équipes de Mistplay de prendre de meilleures décisions.








Concevoir, coordonner et analyser les résultats d'expériences multivariées sur les produits afin de stimuler la croissance, d'améliorer les caractéristiques des produits existants et de tester de nouveaux domaines d'opportunités.








Collaborer avec les parties prenantes des données, du produit, du marketing et de l'ingénierie pour définir les problèmes commerciaux, les projets, identifier les risques et les dépendances, et créer des plans d'exécution.







Ce que tu apporteras à Mistplay :






BA/BS en informatique, mathématiques, économie, statistiques ou autres domaines quantitatifs.








4+ ans d'expérience dans l'analyse quantitative (de préférence dans l'industrie technologique) et une expérience avérée de l'impact sur les décisions relatives à l'entreprise ou au produit.








Capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer des concepts et des analyses complexes de manière simple et facile à comprendre, à un large éventail de publics techniques et non techniques.








Expérience des tests A/B et solides connaissances de base des concepts de statistiques inférentielles (signification, puissance, intervalles de confiance, variance, etc.)








Maîtrise du langage SQL. Expérience de l'extraction de données complexes et hautement dimensionnelles, ainsi que de la modélisation de scénarios et de l'analyse de sensibilité à l'aide d'Excel.








Expérience de Python ou d'un autre outil de programmation pour la modélisation statistique








Familiarité avec Tableau ou tout autre outil de BI 








Familiarité avec les technologies de données en nuage telles que AWS, Azure ou Databricks pour interroger et construire des modèles de données et des rapports. 








Une attitude positive et une bonne dose de curiosité naturelle. Il faut répondre aux questions et nos données ne vont pas s'analyser toutes seules. (Nous y travaillons.)







Un atout si tu as... :






Une passion pour les jeux et une bonne connaissance de l'industrie du jeu.








Une compréhension de la science des données et des techniques d'apprentissage automatique








Une expérience du travail avec de très grands ensembles de données et de l'informatique distribuée (Hive/Hadoop).

Un poste chez Mistplay s’accompagne de toute une série d'avantages que nous proposons en mode virtuel ou présentiel : Dîners d'équipe, soirées jeux, événements à l'échelle de l'entreprise, et bien plus encore.

Senior Data Analyst I, Product


The Senior Data Analyst I, Product  within Mistplay's Data department will play a crucial role in enhancing Mistplay's business performance through insightful analysis and driving analytics strategy. Reporting to the Manager of Data Analytics & Experimentation, you will collaborate with Product & Lifecycle Managers to plan and analyze the results of A/B tests, and drive insights reporting in order to inform the release of new product features and engagement strategies.





What You'll Be Doing:







Conduct proactive analysis to identify actionable insights, including diving into the core product funnel, user cohorts, and analyzing user behaviour data, in order to identify areas of the user experience that can be improved to drive new business opportunities.








Define KPIs for the company and build automated dashboards, reports, and models to enable teams at Mistplay to make better decisions.








Design, orchestrate, and analyze the results of multivariate product experiments to help drive growth, improve existing product features, and test new areas of opportunity.








Collaborate with data, product, marketing, and engineering stakeholders to define business problems, scope out projects, identify risks and dependencies, and create execution plans.







What We're Looking For:






BA/BS in Computer Science, Math, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative fields








4+ years of work experience doing quantitative analysis (preferably in the tech industry) and a proven track record of impacting a business or product decisions








Pro-level ability to synthesize and communicate complex concepts and analyses in simple, easy-to-understand ways, to a wide range of technical and non-technical audiences








Past experience in A/B testing, and a strong foundational knowledge of core inferential statistics concepts (significance, power, confidence intervals, variance, etc.)








Fluency in SQL. Experience pulling highly dimensional and complex data, as well as modeling scenarios and sensitivity analysis using Excel








Experience with Python or another programming tool for statistical modeling








Familiarity with Tableau or any BI tool 








Familiarity with cloud data technologies such as AWS, Azure, or Databricks to query and build data models and reports 








Positive attitude and a healthy dose of natural curiosity. Questions have to be answered and our data isn't just going to analyze itself. (We're working on that.)







Bonus if you have:






A love of gaming and familiarity with the games industry








Understanding of data science and machine learning techniques








Experience working with very large data sets and distributed computing (Hive/Hadoop)

BA/BS in Computer Science, Math, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative fields

Positive attitude and a healthy dose of natural curiosity. Questions have to be answered and our data isn't just going to analyze itself. (We're working on that.)

Title: Advanced Data Analyst - EA SPORTS™ FC
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Advanced Data Analyst, Experimentation Lead - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking an Advanced Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will lead the Experimentation program for FC Premium Analytics. You’ll also collaborate closely with data, production, and product management partners to drive informed decision-making within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of cultivating and uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data leader, driving design, implementation, and evaluation of numerous player-facing experiments.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Design and implement player-facing experimentation using best practices in a complex, live environment
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners
Explore user behavioral patterns through experimentation to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making
Act as a subject-matter expert in all things experimentation, helping to drive adoption of a data-driven, test-and-learn focused culture across FC’s development team


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research) or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making
Expert knowledge or equivalent practical experience in leading an experimentation function for a live product
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a strong plus.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$114,300 - $156,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Drug Intelligence is a leading Canadian health care data market research company with a 30+ year history. We specialize in providing relevant information, data and insights about serious and complex diseases from various therapeutic areas to our clients in the pharmaceutical industry.




As a Data Analyst at Drug Intelligence, you will be joining a dynamic team in a working environment that embraces high quality standards, initiative, creativity, and collaboration.




Important: to be considered for this position, in addition to the LinkedIn application we require candidates to fill out a 2, step, 20-min survey. You will automatically receive a link (by email) to complete the cognitive assessment (step 2) within 5 min of submitting the Predictive Index Assessment (step 1).

Link to survey: https://assessment.predictiveindex.com/bo/5PWK/Drug-Intelligence-Data-Analyst




Salary: $70,000-75,000 annually

 

Key Position Responsibilities:

 

Execute routine data processing tasks, including validation and transformation of data collected in a variety of formats into an analysis-ready format for other teams.
Extract, structure, and analyze relevant information from specific data sets, both recurring and on an ad-hoc basis, to meet client needs.
Own maintenance of existing data processes using Python and T-SQL (Azure): updating code to support new data elements and new analyses as requirements evolve and creating new data processing scripts as new projects arise.
Build and maintain data collection forms across multiple platforms (e.g., JotForm, Qualtrics).
Translate business and project requirements into data requirements with autonomy.
Become a subject matter expert on existing processes and work closely with data engineers to identify and help design solutions for process improvement and automation.
Collaborate with team members and cross-functionally on multiple simultaneous projects.




Desired Experience:

 

1-2 years of experience working as a Data Analyst, Data Engineer, or in a similar role, with strong foundational skills in Python and SQL.
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or equivalent preferred.
Strong knowledge of Python (including Pandas) and SQL, especially for data manipulation and analysis.
Strong understanding of data warehousing methodologies and ETL concepts.
Experience with Azure SQL Database or a similar cloud database platform.
Strong project management and time management skills.
Effective multidisciplinary problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Experience with data collection forms (e.g., JotForm, Qualtrics) would be a plus.




What Will You Get Out of This Role?

 

Exposure to and experience with a variety of tools across the Azure cloud platform, Python, and data collection platforms such as JotForm and Qualtrics, with future exposure to data visualization tools as your knowledge and responsibility grows.
Direct ownership over projects based on your skill set, with growing responsibility and room to grow into a broader technical or subject-matter-expert role over time.
The ability to work directly with cross-functional team members, including leadership.
The chance to build strong analytical and problem-solving skills by troubleshooting real data processing issues that arise in day-to-day operations.

Description:
When applicable, Bombardier promotes flexible and hybrid work policies.

Why join us?

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing employee growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the best work happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

Bombardier’s Benefits Program

With our employees’ well-being top of mind, we offer a comprehensive and competitive Benefits Program, which includes the following:


Insurance plans (Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)
Competitive base salary
Retirement savings plan
Employee Assistance Program
Tele Health Program



What are your contributions to the team?


Develop dashboards and reporting solutions that provide clear visibility into Ethics & Compliance metrics, trends, and risks (e.g., investigations, hotline, third-party risk, training).
Integrate and analyze data across multiple Ethics & Compliance datasets, creating a unified view to support decision-making and oversight.
Perform in-depth data analysis to identify anomalies, patterns, and potential indicators of misconduct or non-compliance.
Design and optimize data pipelines, data models, and automation processes to improve scalability, timeliness, and reliability of compliance data.
Partner with cross-functional teams (including Legal, HR, Audit, Risk, IT) to understand data needs and deliver actionable insights.
Enable data-driven investigations by extracting, analyzing, and interpreting relevant data.
Lead the evolution of analytics for our Ethics and Compliance organization, including the development of predictive analytics and forward-looking risk indicators.
Support the Strategy & Governance analyst to translate complex data into clear, business-friendly insights for leadership and stakeholders.



How to thrive in this role?


You have a Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Statistics, or a related field.
You have 5–8+ years of experience in data analytics.
You have advanced technical skills in:
SQL and data querying
Data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
You have familiarity with Databricks and programming languages such as Python or R; this would be considered an asset.
You have experience working with multiple, complex datasets and integrating them into cohesive reporting solutions.
You have an analytical mindset with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, and hidden risks.
You demonstrate a high level of integrity and discretion when handling sensitive information.
You are curious and adaptable, with an interest in advancing into predictive and advanced analytics.
You have the ability to build dashboards and tell a compelling data story to both technical and non-technical audiences.
You have experience working within an Ethics & Compliance, Risk, Audit, or Legal environment, as well as familiarity with compliance-related frameworks and data (e.g., hotline reports, investigations, risk management, policy adherence); this would be considered an asset.



Now that you can see yourself in this role, apply and join the Bombardier Team!

Please note: You don’t need all the skills, knowledge, and experience listed to apply for this position. We’re not looking for the perfect candidate, we’re looking for great talent and passionate individuals.

What You’ll Do


Collaborate with audit teams to understand audit objectives, business processes, data requirements, and reporting needs.
Design and execute data analytics procedures for audit engagements, including control testing, population analysis, exception reporting, and pattern identification.
Summarize analytical results into clear, concise insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Extract, clean, transform, and analyze data using SQL, Python, or Excel to support audit testing and risk assessments.
Identify anomalies, trends, outliers, and risk indicators through advanced data analysis.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI.
Build reusable analytics scripts, templates, and reporting assets to improve efficiency and consistency.
Use Power Automate to support workflow automation, reporting processes, and repeatable analytics activities.
Support continuous improvement of Internal Audit’s data analytics capabilities, tools, and methodologies.
Leverage tools such as KNIME or similar platforms where applicable to support data preparation, analytics workflows, and automation.

Post-secondary education in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Analytics or related field.
3–5 years of experience in data analytics, audit, risk management, or a related field.
Strong hands-on experience with Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI, Power Automate, etc.
Experience with KNIME, Azure Synapse, Copilot Studio is an asset.
Strong data visualization skills, with the ability to present analytical findings in a clear and business-relevant manner.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
Ability to work with structured and unstructured data from multiple sources and translate business questions into analytical solutions.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Knowledge of audit, risk management, internal controls, and business processes.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
Proficiency in SQL
Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
Strong statistical knowledge
Working knowledge of Python
Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is CA$121,100 - CA$181,700. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

  • MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
  • Proficiency in SQL
  • Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
  • Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
  • Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
  • Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
  • Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
  • Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
  • Strong statistical knowledge
  • Working knowledge of Python
  • Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs
  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding


In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is CA$121,100 - CA$181,700. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Vous stimulez le changement et l’amélioration continue en vue de dépasser les attentes de la clientèle.
