Job Description Summary

We are seeking an Analyst, Business Intelligence to support the design, development, and maintenance of interactive dashboards and reports for Inventory Management stakeholders. This role will work closely with Inventory Management, Accounting, FP&A, and business teams to translate financial data into meaningful insights that support decision-making.

The ideal candidate has strong experience in Microsoft Power BI, solid understanding of Inventory Management processes, and the ability to transform complex datasets into intuitive visualizations.

Responsibilities

Job Description


Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports for Inventory Management processes (e.g., inventory health, stock levels, turns, aging, service levels, fill rate, OTIF, and KPI tracking).
Collaborate with Inventory Management, Demand Planning, and Purchasing stakeholders to gather business requirements and translate them into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
Build and optimize Power BI data models, measures, and relationships to support inventory visibility and decision-making.
Develop and maintain ETL processes using Power Query and related data transformation tools to integrate inventory, supply, and demand data.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across inventory reports and analytics outputs.
Manage and maintain Power BI workspaces, including access control, deployment pipelines, and governance practices.
Leverage Microsoft Fabric capabilities (e.g., dataflows, lakehouse, semantic models) to enhance data integration, scalability, and performance of inventory analytics.
Work with data from ERP systems (e.g., SAP), warehouse management systems, and other enterprise data sources.
Optimize report performance and troubleshoot issues related to data refresh, model performance, and visualization efficiency.
Document data models, report logic, KPIs, and business definitions related to inventory management.
Provide training and support to end-users on Power BI dashboards and self-service inventory analytics capabilities.
Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on inventory optimization, working capital reduction, and service level performance.
Leverage Python for advanced data analysis, automation, and data transformation (e.g., building data pipelines, performing complex calculations, and enhancing Power BI datasets through integrated workflows).


Qualifications


3–5 years of experience in BI/reporting roles, with at least 2–3 years of hands-on experience in Power BI.
Strong proficiency in:
Power BI Desktop & Service
Power Query (M language)
Data modeling concepts
Solid understanding of Inventory Management and accounting principles.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
Experience integrating data from ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, etc.) is an asset.
Hands-on experience with Power BI Service, including workspace management and deployment pipelines.
Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric (Dataflows Gen2, Lakehouse, or related components) is an asset.
Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

The Anticipated Salary Range For This Position

$81,600.00 - $122,400.00 Annual

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

Medline Canada, Corporation is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Senior Insights Analyst
Description:
Senior Insights Analyst




About Us

At TTC, we are Enriching lives by connecting people and places.

For over 100 years, we’ve been bringing the world closer together by crafting journeys that create lasting memories, lifelong friendships and meaningful cultural connections. Across more than 70 countries and our award-winning brands, we design and deliver travel experiences that go beyond sightseeing - they change perspectives.

Behind every unforgettable journey is a passionate team making it happen. That’s where you come in.




OUR VALUES

Everything we do is guided by our five shared commitments:

Value Every Voice - We put people first.
Act with Integrity - We do what’s right.
Explore Beyond Boundaries - We’re driven by curiosity.
Own the Outcome - We take responsibility for our decisions.
Succeed Together - We’ve got each other’s backs.




Position Summary

The Senior Insights Analyst is responsible for supporting TTC's global contact centre reporting, analytics, and operational insight capabilities across sales, service, workforce, and omnichannel performance.This role combines technical expertise with business-facing analytical support, partnering closely with operational leadership and key stakeholders to deliver scalable reporting solutions, actionable insights, and data-driven decision support.

The successful candidate will possess strong experience working with Snowflake, SQL, Power BI, and large operational datasets, while demonstrating the ability to communicate meaningful business insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience supporting contact centre or customer operations environments is highly valued, along with the ability to adapt to evolving business priorities and support continuous improvement initiatives.




Key Responsibilities

Reporting & Business Insights

Analyze global contact centre performance across sales, service, customer experience, productivity, and operational KPIs.
Deliver actionable insights through dashboards, executive reporting, and performance reviews.
Support forecasting, incentive reporting, benchmarking, and strategic decision-making.
Identify trends, risks, opportunities, and key performance drivers across regions and teams.

Technical Development & Data Management

Develop and maintain SQL queries, datasets, and reporting solutions within Snowflake and Power BI.
Manage and integrate data from contact centre, CRM, workforce, and sales platforms.
Support reporting automation, dashboard modernization, and analytical initiatives.
Ensure data quality, KPI consistency, and reporting governance standards are maintained.

Stakeholder Partnership & Communication

Partner with operational, commercial, and transformation stakeholders to align reporting with business priorities.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
Present reporting outcomes to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Serve as a trusted resource for KPI definitions, reporting methodology, and operational analytics.

Process Improvement & Transformation

Drive improvements in reporting efficiency, automation, and operational visibility.
Support transformation initiatives, including CCaaS, AI, and reporting modernization programs.
Expand customer-centric and omnichannel analytics capabilities.
Contribute to scalable reporting governance, best practices, and future-state analytics architecture.




About You

Essential Skills

3–5 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, operational reporting, or contact centre analytics environments.
Strong proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, and Power BI.
Experience developing dashboards, reporting solutions, and business intelligence datasets.
Strong understanding of operational KPIs, reporting frameworks, and performance measurement.
Ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into actionable business insights.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
Experience working with CRM, contact centre, workforce management, or sales platforms.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Desirable skills

Experience working within contact centre, customer operations, or sales environments.
Experience with Genesys, Salesforce, or similar customer engagement platforms.
Experience supporting reporting modernization, automation, or transformation initiatives.
Exposure to omnichannel reporting, customer journey analytics, or AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
Experience working within global or multi-regional organizations.

The Senior Insights Analyst is responsible for supporting TTC's global contact centre reporting, analytics, and operational insight capabilities across sales, service, workforce, and omnichannel performance.This role combines technical expertise with business-facing analytical support, partnering closely with operational leadership and key stakeholders to deliver scalable reporting solutions, actionable insights, and data-driven decision support.

Experience supporting contact centre or customer operations environments is highly valued, along with the ability to adapt to evolving business priorities and support continuous improvement initiatives.


Key Responsibilities

Reporting & Business Insights

  • Support reporting automation, dashboard modernization, and analytical initiatives.

  • Partner with operational, commercial, and transformation stakeholders to align reporting with business priorities.

  • Drive improvements in reporting efficiency, automation, and operational visibility.

  • Expand customer-centric and omnichannel analytics capabilities.

Title: Analyste des données commerciales et digitales / Business and Online Data Analyst
Description:
Votre mission

Au sein de l'équipe Business Intelligence et Performance, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'analyse de la performance commerciale et digitale de l'entreprise. Grâce à votre expertise analytique et votre maîtrise des outils de reporting, vous transformez les données en informations stratégiques permettant d'orienter les décisions et d'optimiser les performances.

Vous contribuez également à l'amélioration continue des outils, des processus et de la qualité des données, dans un environnement collaboratif et omnicanal.

Principales responsabilités

Analyse et suivi de la performance commerciale


Assurer une compréhension approfondie de la performance globale de l'activité et des principaux leviers opérationnels.
Produire, analyser et présenter les reportings bimensuels et mensuels destinés aux équipes et à la direction.
Réaliser des analyses ponctuelles afin de soutenir les priorités opérationnelles et les décisions stratégiques.
Accompagner les exercices de prévision, les revues d'activité et le suivi de la performance grâce à l'analyse des données.
Garantir la fiabilité, la cohérence et la qualité des indicateurs, rapports et tableaux de bord.


Analyse de la performance digitale


Suivre et analyser les performances des différents canaux digitaux (site web, campagnes médias, SEO, CRM, etc.).
Concevoir, développer et optimiser les tableaux de bord de suivi de la performance digitale.
Veiller à la qualité du suivi et de la collecte des données en collaboration avec les équipes techniques et les parties prenantes concernées.
Réaliser des analyses approfondies sur les performances des campagnes, des promotions et des tendances de marché.
Présenter régulièrement les résultats et recommandations aux équipes métiers et aux partenaires internes.
Participer à des projets digitaux internationaux et transverses.


Gestion des données et amélioration continue


Extraire, analyser, valider et interpréter les données à l'aide d'outils tels que BigQuery et SQL.
Maintenir et faire évoluer les outils de reporting et les processus d'analyse existants.
Répondre aux besoins quotidiens en matière d'analyses et de reporting des différentes équipes.
Contribuer aux projets liés à l'omnicanalité, à la business intelligence et à la transformation de la donnée.
Identifier et mettre en œuvre des opportunités d'amélioration visant à optimiser les processus de reporting et la qualité des données.


Profil recherché

Formation et expérience


Formation universitaire en analyse de données, statistiques, informatique, finance, marketing analytique ou domaine connexe.
Expérience significative dans un rôle d'analyse de données, de business intelligence ou de performance digitale.


Compétences techniques


Excellente maîtrise de SQL et de BigQuery.
Solide expérience dans la création et l'optimisation de tableaux de bord via Power BI, Looker ou des outils similaires.
Maîtrise avancée d'Excel (tableaux croisés dynamiques, formules complexes, automatisations et macros).
Bonne connaissance des outils d'analyse digitale tels que Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager ou équivalents.


Compétences personnelles


Forte capacité d'analyse, de synthèse et de résolution de problèmes.
Rigueur, souci du détail et sens de l'organisation.
Excellentes aptitudes en communication et en présentation de données.
Capacité à vulgariser des analyses complexes et à influencer la prise de décision.
Aisance à travailler en mode transversal dans un environnement dynamique et omnicanal.
Esprit collaboratif, curiosité et orientation résultats.


Atouts


Expérience dans les environnements e-commerce, marketing digital ou omnicanaux.
Connaissance des outils de visualisation et d'analyse avancée de données.
Expérience dans un contexte international ou multi-marchés.

Leveraging your analytical expertise and reporting capabilities, you will transform data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making and drive business results.

Business Performance Analysis & Reporting


Develop a strong understanding of overall business performance and the key operational drivers impacting results.
Produce, analyze, and present bi-weekly and monthly business reports and dashboards for stakeholders and leadership teams.

Provide analytical support for business reviews, forecasting activities, and performance tracking.

Design, develop, and optimize digital performance dashboards and reporting solutions.

Conduct in-depth analyses of campaign performance, promotional activities, customer trends, and digital initiatives.
Present performance results, insights, and recommendations to business and cross-functional teams.

Education & Experience

Significant experience in a Data Analyst, Business Intelligence, Digital Performance, or related analytical role.

Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

Comfortable working cross-functionally within a dynamic and collaborative omnichannel environment.
Curious, proactive, and results-oriented mindset.


Assets

Knowledge of advanced analytics, data visualization, and business intelligence methodologies.
Experience working in an international or multi-market environment.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team to help build out the analytics and data infrastructure behind one of our newer business lines. You'll start by strengthening the production dashboards and data onboarding that our stakeholders rely on every day, then move into designing new data models largely from the ground up, helping shape what additional data sources could sharpen our analysis.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership: you'll work directly with stakeholders across the business to understand what they need, shape the data models and pipelines that get them there, and communicate your findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike. If you're energized by ambiguity, enjoy building something net new, and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You’ll Do


Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and onboarding data pipelines that our business stakeholders rely on.
Design and build out new data models largely from scratch, helping identify additional data sources that could strengthen our analysis.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis and reporting.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings, models, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We’re Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data analytics, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, i.e., Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience with consumer credit or lending analytics, ideally from a banking background.
Fintech or SaaS fintech experience is strongly preferred.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.
Python or another coding language.
Experience with dbt,Airflow, and Snowflake.


Why You’ll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership – opportunity to build your process and influence the company workforce and at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by leading a critical part of our customer experience.
You’ll have a broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - 125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.


Clutch is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed. If you require accommodation at any stage of the interview process, please email talent@clutch.ca.

Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) est un leader mondial de l’industrie aérospatiale établi à Longueuil, au Québec. Si vous êtes un professionnel capable de travailler de manière assez autonome et que vous avez une connaissance approfondie de la discipline et de la fonction, nous vous invitons à poser votre candidature.

Automatiser et améliorer les rapports existants
Développer avec Power BI, des outils et des rapports pour aider à la prise de décision pour l'organisation des pièces de rechange
Développer le processus et des méthodes pour améliorer la qualité des données (codes ELM , model family group,...)
Contribuer à l’amélioration des modèles d’intelligence artificielle (modélisation, visualisation, …)

Baccalauréat en ingénierie, sciences appliquées, science de la gestion;
7 années d’expérience pertinente
Connaissance de langages de programmation (idéalement Python)

Sens de l'organisation et capacité à travailler sous pression avec des priorités concurrentes et variables

Title: Analyste BI senior
Description:
Overview

Join the Business Systems Team and help turn complex project data into clear, useful insights. As a Senior BI Analyst, you will work with project teams, business stakeholders and technology specialists to develop and improve business intelligence solutions for the Major Projects Sector.

You do not need to have experience with every technology listed below. We are looking for someone with a solid BI foundation, strong analytical skills and an interest in learning and growing with the team.

Your role


Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into practical BI solutions.
Design data models, reports and dashboards that transform raw data into meaningful information.
Develop and optimize SQL queries, data transformation processes and reporting solutions.
Contribute to the development, enhancement and maintenance of Power BI solutions.
Support the quality, integrity and reliability of data used for reporting and analysis.
Participate in solution testing and deployment, from development through production.
Collaborate with developers, business analysts, project managers and business owners.
Recommend practical improvements to existing dashboards, reporting methods and BI practices.
Help automate recurring business and reporting processes where appropriate.


About You


A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Practical experience developing business intelligence, reporting or data analytics solutions.
Experience using Power BI, including data modelling, Power Query and DAX.
The following experience would help you succeed in the role, but candidates with comparable or transferable experience are encouraged to apply:
Experience designing, developing or maintaining BI reports, data models or data warehouse solutions.
Experience working with data from multiple sources, such as databases, files, spreadsheets, SharePoint, enterprise applications or cloud platforms.
Experience supporting solutions from development through production.
Experience with one or more of the following would be an asset; expertise across the full list is not expected:
Microsoft Power Automate for workflow or business-process automation.
REST APIs and Web services, including authentication, JSON, endpoints, pagination and error handling.
Python for data preparation, automation or analytics.
Power BI Dataflows.
Microsoft SQL Server.
Microsoft Azure services such as Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage or Azure Functions.
Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.
SharePoint and enterprise application integration.
Other cloud data and analytics platforms.
Data warehouse design or advanced data integration patterns.
Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Understanding of data quality, governance, security and access-management practices.
Familiarity with ETL or data integration processes.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and organizational skills.
Ability to communicate in both French and English when supporting stakeholders in both languages. The specific business need for English should be validated and stated in the posting where applicable.*
Ability to understand business needs and translate them into clear technical or analytical solutions.
Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment.
The ability to explain technical topics clearly.
An interest in continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
Curiosity and a willingness to learn new tools and business domains.
A collaborative and client-focused approach.
Sound judgement and attention to detail.
A practical, solution-oriented mindset.
This position requires knowledge of a language other than French, namely English, as it involves collaboration with members of the Canadian or global leadership team located outside Québec.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career at AtkinsRéalis in Canada.

Enjoy competitive compensation, employee recognition, and a brilliant range of flexible benefits you can tailor to your health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle needs.

Make the most of diverse opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise.

And take advantage of our hybrid working culture and generous time-off policies to balance a fulfilling career with your personal life.

Be rewarded. Find out more.

About The Role

As a CBRE Business Intelligence Sr. Analyst, you will be responsible for conducting advanced research, data mining,reporting and interpretation of company performance metrics.

This job is part of the Data Science & Analytics job function. They are responsible for reviewing data that supports improving effectiveness and predicting outcomes to develop business intelligence.

What You’ll Do


Generate and review reports using aggregate data from multiple sources to assist in creating a complete evaluation, improvement, or recommendation.
Review the accuracy of information provided and respond to escalated requests from management and vendors.
Understand and work with advanced scenario planning tools and models. Investigate new trends in general business conditions.
Identify opportunities for large improvements among the clients and company.
Work with personnel from other departments and information technology groups to facilitate successful project implementations.
Review the maintenance and reporting of benchmarks and performance metrics.
Act as subject matter expert for key systems and processes and day-to-day functions.
Apply general knowledge of standard principles and techniques/procedures to accomplish assigned tasks and solve routine problems.
Have a broad knowledge of own job discipline and some knowledge of several job disciplines within the function.
Lead by example and model behaviors consistent with CBRE RISE values. May convince to reach an agreement.
Impact the quality of own work and the work of others on the team.
Work primarily within standardized procedures and practices to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.
Explain complex information to others in straightforward situations.

Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
Understanding of existing procedures and standards to solve slightly complex problems.
Ability to analyze possible solutions using technical experience to apply appropriate judgment and precedents.
In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset.

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. About The Department

The Regional Municipality of Wood Buffalo (RMWB) is one of Canada's most unique and fast-evolving regions — a place where innovative thinking meets real-world impact. Our Planning and Development Division shapes where we live, work and play.

Planning & Development at RMWB is more than policies and plans, it’s about creating vibrant, inclusive and sustainable communities. Join a collaborative team that leads long-term strategy, supports development initiatives, and partners with residents and community partners to build our shared future.

If you're passionate about smart growth and public service, this is your opportunity to make your mark.

General Description

Under general supervision, the Data Analyst supports Planning and Development Services in all data extraction, transformation, and analysis functions for the department. The incumbent extracts, transforms, structures, and analyzes data on all Planning and Development Services key performance indicators (KPIs) and overall metrics to provide insight into permitting and licensing activities in the Municipality. This position also researches, analyzes, and reports on the Municipality's economic and demographic trends using municipal and third-party data to inform various municipal projects and statutory plans.

Responsibilities


Prepares and releases scheduled or ad-hoc reports on Planning and Development Services activities by extracting, transforming, and analyzing permit and licensing data.
Supports Planning and Development Services department with strategies and process enhancements to reduce data input errors in the Accela permitting database.
Processes and responds to internal and external stakeholder Planning and Development Services data and analysis requests.
Supports department with data extraction and transformation from the Accela permitting database.
Uses statistical and data visualization tools to implement and maintain an interactive dashboard that provides real-time information and interprets data on permitting and licensing activities in the Municipality.
Works with Planning and Development Services to support all Accela functionality improvement efforts through best practice research.
Creates documentation that allows stakeholders to understand the steps of the data analysis process.
Analyzes municipal-specific primary and secondary demographic and socio-economic data to generate insight into population trends in the Municipality.
Supports all infield data collection analysis and reporting during the Municipal census.
Other related duties as required.


Qualifications

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:


Ability to work independently or in a team and establish and maintain cooperative, collaborative, and productive work relationships.
Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources.
Exceptional research and reporting skills, with the ability to analyze information from a variety of sources and accurately present in a concise manner.
High degree of precision and accuracy in data entry, documentation, and investigative procedures.
Ability to learn, understand, and apply new technologies in data science and analytics.
Strong analytic and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in computer technology, as it relates to data science and analytics, particularly in the use of spreadsheets, databases, presentation, and data visualization tools (SQL, R, Python, Tableau, Microsoft Power BI, etc.).


Education And Experience


Degree in Geography, Economics, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, or other related field is required.
Three (3) years of experience in data analysis and research, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), or data science is required.
Experience with GIS tools such as ArcMap 10.8 or ArcGIS Pro is an asset.
Experience in policy analysis and project management is an asset.
Experience working with third-party data sources such as Statistics Canada is an asset.


Other Requirements


Submission of a Criminal Record Check.
Pre-employment testing may be required as part of the interview process.


Safety

As an employee of the Regional Municipality of Wood Buffalo, the incumbent is responsible for understanding and actively participating in the RMWB’s health and safety management system, including all policies, practices, procedures, as well as properly utilizing all control measures including the required use of personal protective equipment. All employees must take reasonable care to protect the health and safety of themselves and others, as well as immediately report any concerns, near misses, incidents, and hazardous conditions to their supervisor.

To apply: Please visit our website at jobs.rmwb.ca

Current employees must apply through the internal careers site.

We appreciate the interest of all applicants; however, only those individuals

selected for interviews will be contacted. Late applications will not be accepted.

Title: Data Analyst- Claims
Description:
Company: CGIC

Department: Claims

Employment Type: Regular Full-Time

Work Model: Hybrid (2 days in office)

Language: Bilingualism in English and French is an asset.

The Opportunity

We are a leading Canadian financial services co-operative committed to being a catalyst for a sustainable and resilient society and our team is essential to deliver on this strategy. That’s why we prioritize our people, to ensure we provide a strong culture and development opportunities which enables our team to thrive and to live our purpose. The best part is that you will work with people that care passionately about you, our clients and our communities.

Our Claims team aspires to create peace of mind for our clients and our communities. Our national team of knowledgeable and trusted professionals serve our clients with compassion. We are passionate about continuous improvement and operate with high-integrity, motivated by our desire to do the right thing for our clients.

As Data Analyst, you actively contribute to various initiatives by analyzing data to solve business problems and providing valuable insights. You understand the insurance business domain and ensure your own tasks contribute to meeting the business objectives by applying appropriate methods and critical thinking and performing analysis.

How You Will Create Impact


Autonomously perform descriptive and diagnostic analysis using recommended methods (ex: regression, cohort analysis, cluster analysis, A/B testing, factor analysis).
Design and develop metrics to enable descriptive analysis and diagnostic analysis.
Autonomously design proof of concept and deliver with guidance a prototype analytical solution to enable effective storytelling and descriptive/diagnostic analysis.
Work on Data querying (T-SQL, SQL, MySQL, etc.)
Extract, clean, reconcile and prepare the data required for the analysis.
Autonomously communicate findings to colleagues and your manager in an effective manner.



To Join Our Team


You have 3-5 years of relevant experience in Business Intelligence or other relevant domain.
You have a University Degree in Business Intelligence, Computer Science, Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or equivalent technical experience.
ACAS or FCAS designations are considered an asset.
You have experience solving standard problems by analyzing possible solutions by using our experience, judgment and precedent & challenging status quo.
You have good knowledge and understanding of data analysis, programing, modeling techniques, data warehouse and data management, research, architecture and design.
Experience with the following technologies is required: Sql, Python, R, Microsoft Fabric
Experience with the following technologies is an asset: Service now , Jira, Databricks



How You Will Succeed


You influence change and are committed to continuous improvement, in order to exceed client expectations.
You leverage critical thinking skills to identify problems and proactively propose solutions.
Your strong communication skills allow you to clearly convey messages.
You’re an effective team player who shares knowledge to support our peers.



What You Need To Know


You will be subject to a Background check as a condition of employment, in the event you are the successful candidate.



What’s in it for you?


Training and development opportunities to grow your career.
Flexible work options and paid time off to support your personal and family needs.
A holistic approach to your well-being, with physical and mental health programs and a supportive workplace culture.
Paid volunteer days to give back to your community.
In addition to our competitive salary and incentive programs, eligible employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package including group retirement savings plans, pension and benefits (e.g., health and wellness, dental, disability and life coverage), mental health support and an employee assistance program.



Salary information

Expected Salary range : CAD $60,574.00 to $100,956.00 CAD

The salary amount for the successful candidate is determined by Co-operators in its discretion and will vary depending on several criteria including but not limited to: local market conditions, geography and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualification, experience and education.

Employees may also have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and earn additional compensation tied to individual and/or business performance, or other business metrics.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Title: Data Analyst

Vacancies: This posting is for (1) new role

Location: Toronto, ON (Detailed office location information can be found by visiting this link: https://cancer.ca/en/contact-us)

Work Model: Hybrid Work Model

Salary Band: 5 ($70,000 - $75,000 CAD)

HELP SHAPE THE FUTURE OF CANCER CARE IN CANADA

The Canadian Cancer Society works tirelessly to save lives, improve lives and drive collective action against cancer. Together with patients, volunteers, donors and communities across the country, we raise funds to invest in transformative cancer research, we provide a caring support system for everyone affected by cancer and we advocate to governments to create a healthier future for all. It takes a society to take on cancer – and the Canadian Cancer Society is leading the way




MAKING AN IMPACT

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Data Governance and Analytics, the Data Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining analytics solutions, reports, and dashboards that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Leverage SQL, scripting, and modern analytics platforms to extract, transform, and analyze complex datasets, delivering actionable insights and recommendations that align with business goals
Partner with business and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable, and well-governed analytics solutions
Support a culture of data-driven decision-making by applying automation, engineering best practices, and modern design patterns to improve how data is analyzed, visualized, and utilized across the organization




What You’ll Be Doing




1.Analytics & Reporting Development

Report & Dashboard Development

Design, develop, and maintain reports and dashboards using Salesforce CRM Analytics, Salesforce Reporting, and Power BI to support organization teams
Build and optimize semantic models and datasets to support business reporting and analytics needs
Optimize reporting and dashboard assets for usability, performance and accessibility

Analytics & Insights

Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities across business functions
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for business teams
Use predictive models and statistical analyses to support donor segmentation, campaign targeting, and fundraising forecasting
Leverage advanced analytics techniques including propensity scoring, trend analysis, and cohort modeling to inform business strategy

Collaboration & Engagement

Partner with cross-functional teams including business partners, data engineers, and digital teams
Provide guidance and support to business users on reporting and analytics tools




2.Data Development & Transformation

Data Preparation & Processing

Extract, transform, and prepare analytical datasets using SQL, Python and scripting languages
Build and maintain reporting datasets, dataflows, and curated data assets incorporating key metrics and business data
Utilize enterprise data platforms (e.g., Microsoft Fabric) as supporting data sources where required

Data Modeling & Documentation

Contribute to the design and optimization of data models that support reporting and analytics platforms
Develop and maintain documentation for datasets, data definitions, and analytical processes




3.Operational Excellence

Automation

Automate repetitive reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows using Python and scripting

DevOps

Utilize version control practices for analytics assets, reports, and code
Contribute to CI/CD processes for analytics solution deployment using Azure DevOps

Quality

Develop and maintain automated testing for reports, datasets, and analytics solutions
Support monitoring and validation of analytics pipelines and reporting processes
Apply development best practices including code quality, documentation, and peer review




4.Data Governance & Standards

Governance & Compliance

Apply data governance, compliance, and data quality standards when developing analytics solutions
Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting outputs
Adhere to data privacy, security and compliance requirements (PII, PHI etc.)

Data Standards

Support adherence to established data policies, standards, and best practices




5.Other

Contribute to our culture of diversity, inclusion, belonging and equity (DIBE) by ensuring that all staff feel represented, valued, and heard across all aspects of their identity, including gender, age, religion, ethnicity, nationality, race, and sexuality.
Other duties as assigned




QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics or a related discipline
More than 3 years, up to and including 5 years - similar or related general experience in progressively more important positions




Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and analytical dataset development
Proficiency in Python and/or scripting languages for data analysis and automation
Experience designing and developing reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Salesforce Reporting, Salesforce CRM Analytics and Power BI
Experience building and optimizing semantic models and analytical datasets
Experience working with Fabric to build and manage data pipelines, dataflows, automated workflows, and analytics solutions.
Understanding of data modeling concepts and relational database design
Others may apply




Operational Excellence

Experience with DevOps practices including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks
Experience automating reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows
Knowledge of Agile development practices including code quality, testing, documentation, and peer review
Experience developing and maintaining automated testing for analytics solutions and reports




Analytical Skills

Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear, scalable analytics solutions
Strong exploratory data analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
Ability to identify trends, patterns, and insights from large and complex datasets
Experience with predictive modeling, statistical analysis, or data-driven segmentation techniques




Communication Skills

Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to present complex data findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience collaborating across business functions to support data-driven decision-making
Bilingualism (French/English) is highly preferred , with French being an asset due to the organization’s nationwide operations and the need for effective communication across various regions




What You Can Expect From Us

CCS provides impactful opportunities to transform the lives of Canadians affected by cancer. We are devoted to creating an inclusive workplace that celebrates diverse experiences and skills, encouraging all qualified candidates to join us. Our inspiring culture is rooted in our core values and commitment to meaningful change: COURAGEOUS UNITED CARING RIGOROUS




COME AS YOU ARE

At CCS, we celebrate individuality and the strength of diversity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace that empowers everyone. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, including those from equity-deserving groups such as BIPOC, 2SLGBTQI+ communities, individuals with disabilities, veterans, and others who contribute to the richness of our organization. Together, we unite Canadians to shape the future of cancer care.




How To Apply

Qualified candidates are invited to submit their resume, cover letter, and salary expectations by August 27, 2026

If selected for a position at CCS the information provided will be used for the purposes of pre-employment checks and added to your employee file. The Opportunity

We are a leading Canadian financial services co-operative committed to being a catalyst for a sustainable and resilient society and our team is essential to deliver on this strategy. That’s why we prioritize our people, to ensure we provide a strong culture and development opportunities which enables our team to thrive and to live our purpose. The best part is that you will work with people that care passionately about you, our clients and our communities.

Our Claims team aspires to create peace of mind for our clients and our communities. Our national team of knowledgeable and trusted professionals serve our clients with compassion. As Data Analyst, you actively contribute to various initiatives by analyzing data to solve business problems and providing valuable insights. How You Will Create Impact


Autonomously perform descriptive and diagnostic analysis using recommended methods (ex: regression, cohort analysis, cluster analysis, A/B testing, factor analysis).
Design and develop metrics to enable descriptive analysis and diagnostic analysis.
Autonomously design proof of concept and deliver with guidance a prototype analytical solution to enable effective storytelling and descriptive/diagnostic analysis.
Work on Data querying (T-SQL, SQL, MySQL, etc.)
Extract, clean, reconcile and prepare the data required for the analysis.
Autonomously communicate findings to colleagues and your manager in an effective manner.



To Join Our Team


You have 3-5 years of relevant experience in Business Intelligence or other relevant domain.
You have a University Degree in Business Intelligence, Computer Science, Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or equivalent technical experience.
ACAS or FCAS designations are considered an asset.
You have experience solving standard problems by analyzing possible solutions by using our experience, judgment and precedent & challenging status quo.
You have good knowledge and understanding of data analysis, programing, modeling techniques, data warehouse and data management, research, architecture and design.
Experience with the following technologies is required: Sql, Python, R, Microsoft Fabric
Experience with the following technologies is an asset: Service now , Jira, Databricks



How You Will Succeed


You influence change and are committed to continuous improvement, in order to exceed client expectations.

Your strong communication skills allow you to clearly convey messages.
You’re an effective team player who shares knowledge to support our peers.



What You Need To Know


You will be subject to a Background check as a condition of employment, in the event you are the successful candidate.



What’s in it for you?


Training and development opportunities to grow your career.
Flexible work options and paid time off to support your personal and family needs.
A holistic approach to your well-being, with physical and mental health programs and a supportive workplace culture.
Paid volunteer days to give back to your community.
In addition to our competitive salary and incentive programs, eligible employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package including group retirement savings plans, pension and benefits (e.g., health and wellness, dental, disability and life coverage), mental health support and an employee assistance program.

Expected Salary range : CAD $60,574.00 to $100,956.00 CAD

The salary amount for the successful candidate is determined by Co-operators in its discretion and will vary depending on several criteria including but not limited to: local market conditions, geography and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualification, experience and education.

Title: Analyste sénior en intelligence d'affaires
HTML:
Sous la supervision de la Directrice-adjointe analyse, l'analyste en intelligence d'affaires senior jouera un rôle clé dans la conception de tableaux de bord, l'analyse de tendances et la production de prévisions basées sur les données. Il/Elle contribuera à la définition, la mise en place et l'évolution des indicateurs de performance, des mesures, des tableaux de bord et des schémas de données nécessaires au déploiement de l'intelligence d'affaires d'AGA.

L'analyste sera également responsable de promouvoir et d'assurer l'application de bonnes pratiques en matière de gestion et d'utilisation sécuritaire des données. Le développement de relations solides, tant avec les collègues multidisciplinaires de l'équipe qu'avec les clients internes sur le terrain, demeure essentiel pour réussir dans ce rôle.

Le·la titulaire de ce poste sera, entre autres, appelé à :

  • Collecter, transformer, nettoyer et organiser les données provenant de différentes sources internes, en veillant à leur qualité et à leur cohérence;
  • Concevoir, maintenir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord et rapports à l'aide d'outils de visualisation comme Power BI ou outils similaires;
  • Accompagner les équipes dans la gestion du changement lors de l'implantation de nouvelles solutions, notamment par la formation et la documentation;
  • Proposer et réaliser des analyses descriptives et exploratoires pour identifier des tendances, infos pertinentes, anomalies ou opportunités;
  • Collaborer avec l'ensemble des équipes métiers AGA (actuariat, finances, opérations, marketing, etc.) afin de comprendre leurs besoins, analyser leurs flux de travail afin de proposer des solutions et identifier des axes d'amélioration basées sur les données;
  • Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus de gestion de données et de production de rapports;
  • Documenter les méthodologies, les besoins, les indicateurs de performance, les mesures, les tableaux de bord, les schémas de données, les sources de données, les processus afin d'assurer la traçabilité et la fiabilité des analyses;
  • Déterminer les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI), élaborer les mesures nécessaires à l'évaluation de la performance, analyser l'évolution des résultats et développer des modèles prévisionnels lorsque requis;
  • Effectuer des analyses ad hoc ou extraire des listes de données selon les besoins;
  • Documenter et mettre à jour de façon quotidienne et systématique l'ensemble de ses tâches et projets dans JIRA, afin d'assurer un suivi clair et en temps réel de l'avancement;
  • Créer et maintenir des flux Power Automate;
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe de même nature et en relation directe avec cet emploi ou à la demande de son supérieur.

Le·la candidat·e idéal·e possède ce qui suit:

Formation et expérience

  • Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, finances, intelligence d’affaires, informatique / sciences informatiques / informatique de gestion, gestion de l'information ou Baccalauréat d’ingénieur (génie informatique / génie des technologies de l’information) et/ou d’ingénierie et analytique des données (Maîtrise est un atout);
  • 5-7 ans d’expérience en analyse de données, prévisions et création de tableaux de bord;
  • Expérience en assurances collectives est un atout.

Compétences techniques

  • Maîtrise de Power BI;
  • Maîtrise d’Excel, de la suite Office et de SQL;
  • Compétences mathématiques et/ou académiques nécessaires pour recueillir, mesurer, organiser et analyser des données et effectuer des prévisions statistiques;
  • Capacité à transformer des données brutes en informations utiles et compréhensibles;
  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, pour collaborer efficacement avec nos équipes partout au Canada;
  • Connaissance de Power Automate un atout;
  • Connaissance de Power BI Report Builder un atout;
  • Familiarité avec un langage de programmation analytique (Python ou R) un atout;
  • Connaissance de base de JIRA et de Confluence un atout.

Qualités personnelles et professionnelles

  • Esprit analytique développé et grande rigueur;
  • Forte curiosité analytique et esprit critique pour proposer des axes d’analyse innovants et des visualisations percutantes;
  • Excellent sens de l’organisation et de la gestion des priorités;
  • Aptitude à travailler en équipe et à communiquer clairement avec des interlocuteurs non techniques (vulgarisation des calculs ou des résultats);
  • Discrétion et respect de la confidentialité des données.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Permanent

Job title:
Senior SQL Data Analyst

Salary:
$90,000 - $95,000 + Bonus + Benefits

Role status:
Current opening

Our client:
A well-established Canadian professional services organization with a national presence and a strong reputation within its industry.

This is a highly visible role offering exposure to senior leadership and key business stakeholders across the organization. Our client is looking for a strong Senior SQL Data Analyst who can work with large, complex datasets, identify trends and business drivers, and translate analysis into clear, actionable insights for the business. This opportunity is ideal for someone who combines advanced SQL and analytical capability with polished communication skills, strong business acumen, and the confidence to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Principal tasks and responsibilities include:

Write complex SQL queries to extract, validate, analyze, and interpret large volumes of business and operational data.
Analyze revenue, pricing, productivity, profitability, utilization, and other key business performance metrics to support decision-making and performance improvement.
Identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities in the data, and provide actionable recommendations to business leaders.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting packages, dashboards, scorecards, and presentations for senior leadership.
Translate raw data into meaningful business insights that can be clearly understood by both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
Partner closely with leadership, finance, operations, and other business groups to understand reporting needs and answer key business questions through data.
Support strategic analysis, business planning, and performance reviews by delivering data-driven insight and thoughtful commentary.
Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards, management reporting tools, and automated reporting solutions.
Validate data integrity, troubleshoot reporting issues, and help improve the quality, consistency, and accessibility of business data.
Support business intelligence, reporting automation, and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
Present findings, trends, and recommendations in a polished, concise, and business-friendly manner to senior stakeholders.
Participate in special projects and ad hoc analytical initiatives requiring a strong mix of technical skill, business judgment, and communication.

Qualifications and pre-requisites:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, or a related field.
Strong academic background preferred. Candidates from well-regarded Canadian universities such as Western, Queen's, Laurier, Waterloo, McMaster, University of Toronto, Toronto Metropolitan, or other prominent Ontario / GTA schools would be of particular interest.
5+ years of progressive experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, commercial analytics, business insights, or a related analytical role.
Advanced SQL skills are a must. This role requires someone who can independently write complex queries, pull and manipulate large datasets, validate outputs, and use data to solve business problems.
Strong experience analyzing large datasets and turning complex information into clear, relevant, and actionable insights for the business.
Experience with Power BI, Excel, and other reporting / visualization tools. Exposure to VBA, Python, Tableau, or similar tools would be considered an asset.
Excellent communication skills are a must. This role requires someone who can confidently and clearly explain analysis, trends, and recommendations to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
Must be able to bridge the gap between data and the business - not just run reports, but clearly speak to what the data means, why it matters, and what actions should be taken.
Strong presentation skills, executive presence, and the ability to simplify complex information into a clear and compelling message.
We would be especially interested in candidates who have demonstrated strong communication and presentation ability through debate teams, Toastmasters, case competitions, client-facing roles, or other environments that reflect strong verbal communication and presence.
Strong critical thinking, curiosity, and problem-solving ability, with the instinct to dig into root causes and connect data back to business performance.
Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively in a visible role with accountability to senior stakeholders.
Polished, professional, and credible communicator with a strong business partnering mindset.

Additional information or perks:

Hybrid work environment.
Highly visible role with regular exposure to senior leadership and key decision-makers.
Opportunity to influence business decisions through data, analysis, and strategic insight.
Blend of technical analytics, reporting, and stakeholder-facing business support.
Strong long-term career growth opportunity within a well-established Canadian organization.
Comprehensive benefits package.
Competitive bonus opportunity.
Collaborative and team-oriented culture.
Strong commitment to employee development and continuous learning.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Permanent Full Time

As a Data Analyst, you will join Canada Life’s Canada Operations & Business Enablement, Data Analytics and Reporting team. In this role you will support all Canada Operations and Business Enablement teams with the development, implementation, and maintenance of analytics solutions ranging from descriptive and diagnostic to predictive.

The Analyst, Data & Analytics supports decision making, monitors business performance, and provides actionable insights using analytics and statistical techniques.

In this role, you will assist in modelling, analysing, and predicting business processes. You will translate business requirements into data, reporting, and analytics projects, which you will support throughout their entire lifecycle.

What You Will Do


Translate business needs into data requirements, collect, integrate, clean, explore, model, and analyze large datasets and visualize results and present to business leaders
Build, implement and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards
Work with large datasets that are not consistent, clean, or fully modelled
Communicate effectively and demonstrate critical thinking and business acumen.
Define, implement, and monitor metrics and KPIs and ensure ongoing strategic alignment with short and long-term business objectives
Enable effective, efficient working relationships with business partners
Work closely with senior leaders to understand business drivers and enable them to make decisions based on data
Support projects throughout the entire analytics lifecycle
Present and communicate insights and recommendations in a visual and simplified manner


What You Will Bring


Reliability Status Security Clearance – this can only be completed with candidates who receive an offer of employment. This is a personal security status that is required as a condition of employment before an employee can gain access to Protected B information, assets or work sites as outlined by the Government of Canada website. The cost of submitting these checks will be covered by Canada Life
1-3 years of relevant experience and a bachelor’s degree in a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification is preferred
Demonstrated experience in working with data analytics tools (SQL, Python), Databases (SQL Server), Cloud (Azure, Databricks), data visualisation tools (Power BI) with experience at creating interactive dashboards
Ability to write efficient SQL and Python queries to extract, integrate, and transform data from multiple sources, and to automate data pipelines
Proficiency in Power BI, Data Modelling, Power Query, and DAX
Experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Good knowledge in data analytics and statistical modelling
Strong communication and presentation skills
Proven ability to learn quickly and independently and handle multiple priorities in a challenging work environment
Experience within the Financial Services sector would be an asset


Given the size and scope of our organization, we have the flexibility for this position to be located in the following head office locations: Toronto, London, Winnipeg. This role follows a hybrid work model, with an in-office presence required three days per week.

The base salary for this position is between $65,800 - $109,700 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you.

Career opportunities will be open a minimum of 5 business days from the date of posting, closing dates will vary depending on the search activity. All applications received will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Autodesk Education Experiences, or AEX, helps students, educators, and education institutions build the skills and experience needed for the future of design and make. This role focuses on delivering insights and decision support while collaborating with data and technology teams as needed. You will work hands-on with SQL, Python, Snowflake, and business intelligence tools, and use approved AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, coding, synthesis, and communication.

Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.

We are seeking a highly analytical and business-focused Senior Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across our Life Insurance operations. The successful candidate will leverage analytics, automation solutions to improve business outcomes, operational efficiency, and customer experience.




Key Responsibilities




1. Sales Optimization & Growth Support (30%)

Analyze sales performance and identify opportunities to improve lead conversion, agent productivity, and overall sales effectiveness

Provide actionable insights to support the continued growth of the sales organization

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to work a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in our San Francisco or Toronto offices, and to translate complex healthcare and product data into clear, actionable insights that drive strategy and business impact. You are a fit if you thrive in ambiguous, cross-functional environments, own analytical deep work end to end, and enjoy influencing decisions through rigorous, well-communicated analysis.

What you’ll do:


Work cross-functionally with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success to scope and implement trusted business metrics, proactively identify data integrity issues, and optimize operational workflows.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights with strategic recommendations that drive measurable actions and outcomes to inform business priorities.
Communicate analysis results and outcomes clearly and tailor messaging based on the audience.
Help build and evolve our analytical foundation, including event instrumentation, metric frameworks, and scalable self-serve analytics tools.
Mentor other analysts and raise the bar for data storytelling, analytical rigor, and stakeholder influence across the organization.

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent years of practical work experience.
5+ years of experience using SQL or similar big data querying languages.
5+ years of experience with a programming language such as Python or R.
5+ years of experience with applied statistical techniques, such as inferential methods, causal methods, A/B testing, or statistical modeling techniques.
Strong experience working with Salesforce or other CRM platforms, including modeling and analyzing customer, pipeline, and revenue data.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex findings from data and models into compelling insights for technical and non-technical audiences.

Advanced degree in applied mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, economics or a related field.
Experience working with sales organizations and familiarity with funnel and pipeline processes.
Strong mentorship and leadership skills, with a track record of elevating scientific standards and developing junior talent across teams.

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:


Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
A home office stipend.
401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.

A local in-person meet-up program.
Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.
