Title: Quantitative Analyst
Description:
Powerex Corp. is the wholly owned energy marketing subsidiary of BC Hydro, responsible for marketing clean electricity across North America. We are seeking an experienced Quantitative Analyst with a background in Operations Research to join our Analytics team. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep analytical expertise with strong programming skills and a passion for applying both to complex, real-world energy market problems. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, self-driven, and comfortable delivering rigorous analysis in a fast-paced trading environment.

Reporting to the Director, Analytics, you will work closely with traders and senior analysts to support Front Office operations through mathematical modelling, deal valuation, data analysis, and tool development. Your primary function will be to support and maintain existing mathematical programming models and to develop new ones from concept to implementation. This position will be relied upon to support the achievement of our purpose and long-term goals by fostering our values: teamwork, accountability, integrity, service, ingenuity, and safety.

Key Responsibilities


Maintain and enhance existing mathematical programming models, ensuring reliability, accuracy, and alignment with evolving business needs
Design and develop new quantitative models from concept through to implementation, applying operations research techniques to real-world energy market problems
Perform deal valuation and quantitative analysis to support Front Office trading decisions
Build and maintain analytical tools and data pipelines that support trading operations and workflows
Conduct data analysis using large datasets, extracting insights that inform trading strategy and risk assessment
Collaborate with traders, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions
Contribute to the continuous improvement of Front Office tools, models, and processes through innovation and automation
Produce clear technical documentation and communicate findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences
Support ad-hoc analytical requests while managing longer-term modelling projects in parallel



Qualifications

Required


Bachelor's degree in a field such as Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, or Statistics
At least five years of quantitative analytical work experience, a substantial portion of which has been specifically in operations research. Candidates without a formal operations research background will be considered provided they demonstrate sufficient quantitative and technical experience and aptitude
Demonstrated ability to solve challenging technical problems without the guarantee of adequate or perfect information, delivering both quick ad-hoc solutions and long-term in-depth models
Experience solving real-world problems by translating them into constraints represented by computer models
Strong grounding in probability and statistics, and the judgement to know which methods fit a given problem
Ability to explain quantitative reasoning to traders and commercial staff, and to defend it under challenge
Expert-level proficiency in MS Excel and at least one data visualization or dashboarding tool such as Tableau
Scripting experience in a mathematical programming language, ideally AMPL & CPLEX
Programming experience in at least one of VBA, Python, C++/C#, or SQL (Snowflake, dbt)
Proven experience working with large datasets and managing end-to-end data pipelines
Strong technical writing skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with both technical and business stakeholders
Ability to work independently, multi-task, and thrive under pressure in a fast-paced, open work environment



Preferred


A Master's degree in Operations Research or another analytical field, and/or successful completion of a professional development program such as a CFA
Experience in the energy industry
Experience working with LLMs such as Claude to support research and the development of tools, models, and data pipelines
Knowledge or experience in hydrology, hydropower engineering, time-series forecasting, or general data science



Work Arrangements & Other Requirements


Full-time, in-office position based at our Vancouver, BC office
Must be located in the Vancouver/Lower Mainland area
Must be legally authorized to work in Canada
A background check and references will be required for the position



What We Offer


Compensation: The expected salary range for this role is $109,680 - $148,400
Comprehensive benefits package including extended health, dental, vision, and pension
Opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced quantitative analysis and North America's energy markets, contributing directly to Front Office trading and decision-making
A collaborative, innovation-driven environment that embraces modern analytical tools, AI, and emerging technologies in energy trading
Professional development support, including funding for relevant certifications, training, and continuing education



About Powerex

Powerex Corp. is a market leader in the trading and marketing of clean and renewable wholesale electricity and associated environmental products. We are at the forefront of the clean energy transition, helping our wholesale customers throughout Western North America meet their increasingly ambitious environmental goals. Our customers include electricity and natural gas utilities, global energy companies, large financial institutions, and global technology companies. Powerex's financial success directly benefits British Columbians by helping to lower BC Hydro's electricity rates.

Fast paced, dynamic, and empowering are words that describe a career with Powerex. We pride ourselves on having a supportive and fun culture, and a strong commitment to the development and wellbeing of our employees. With an average tenure of 15+ years on our trade floor, Powerex stands out as an employer of choice in Vancouver. Ask any Powerex employee what they love about their job, and their first comment will likely be "the people I work with every day."

At Powerex we believe that a diverse team is a strong team, and our dedication to equity and inclusion is intertwined with our performance-based culture. Powerex Corp. is the wholly owned energy marketing subsidiary of BC Hydro, responsible for marketing clean electricity across North America. We are seeking an experienced Quantitative Analyst with a background in Operations Research to join our Analytics team. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep analytical expertise with strong programming skills and a passion for applying both to complex, real-world energy market problems. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, self-driven, and comfortable delivering rigorous analysis in a fast-paced trading environment.

Reporting to the Director, Analytics, you will work closely with traders and senior analysts to support Front Office operations through mathematical modelling, deal valuation, data analysis, and tool development. Your primary function will be to support and maintain existing mathematical programming models and to develop new ones from concept to implementation. This position will be relied upon to support the achievement of our purpose and long-term goals by fostering our values: teamwork, accountability, integrity, service, ingenuity, and safety.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain and enhance existing mathematical programming models, ensuring reliability, accuracy, and alignment with evolving business needs
  • Design and develop new quantitative models from concept through to implementation, applying operations research techniques to real-world energy market problems
  • Perform deal valuation and quantitative analysis to support Front Office trading decisions
  • Build and maintain analytical tools and data pipelines that support trading operations and workflows
  • Conduct data analysis using large datasets, extracting insights that inform trading strategy and risk assessment
  • Collaborate with traders, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Front Office tools, models, and processes through innovation and automation
  • Produce clear technical documentation and communicate findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Support ad-hoc analytical requests while managing longer-term modelling projects in parallel


Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in a field such as Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, or Statistics
  • At least five years of quantitative analytical work experience, a substantial portion of which has been specifically in operations research. Candidates without a formal operations research background will be considered provided they demonstrate sufficient quantitative and technical experience and aptitude
  • Demonstrated ability to solve challenging technical problems without the guarantee of adequate or perfect information, delivering both quick ad-hoc solutions and long-term in-depth models
  • Experience solving real-world problems by translating them into constraints represented by computer models
  • Strong grounding in probability and statistics, and the judgement to know which methods fit a given problem
  • Ability to explain quantitative reasoning to traders and commercial staff, and to defend it under challenge
  • Expert-level proficiency in MS Excel and at least one data visualization or dashboarding tool such as Tableau
  • Scripting experience in a mathematical programming language, ideally AMPL & CPLEX
  • Programming experience in at least one of VBA, Python, C++/C#, or SQL (Snowflake, dbt)
  • Proven experience working with large datasets and managing end-to-end data pipelines
  • Strong technical writing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with both technical and business stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently, multi-task, and thrive under pressure in a fast-paced, open work environment


Preferred

  • A Master's degree in Operations Research or another analytical field, and/or successful completion of a professional development program such as a CFA
  • Experience in the energy industry
  • Experience working with LLMs such as Claude to support research and the development of tools, models, and data pipelines
  • Knowledge or experience in hydrology, hydropower engineering, time-series forecasting, or general data science


Work Arrangements & Other Requirements

  • Full-time, in-office position based at our Vancouver, BC office
  • Must be located in the Vancouver/Lower Mainland area
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada
  • A background check and references will be required for the position


What We Offer

  • Compensation: The expected salary range for this role is $109,680 - $148,400
  • Comprehensive benefits package including extended health, dental, vision, and pension
  • Opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced quantitative analysis and North America's energy markets, contributing directly to Front Office trading and decision-making
  • A collaborative, innovation-driven environment that embraces modern analytical tools, AI, and emerging technologies in energy trading
  • Professional development support, including funding for relevant certifications, training, and continuing education


About Powerex

Powerex Corp. is a market leader in the trading and marketing of clean and renewable wholesale electricity and associated environmental products. We are at the forefront of the clean energy transition, helping our wholesale customers throughout Western North America meet their increasingly ambitious environmental goals. Our customers include electricity and natural gas utilities, global energy companies, large financial institutions, and global technology companies. Powerex's financial success directly benefits British Columbians by helping to lower BC Hydro's electricity rates.

Fast paced, dynamic, and empowering are words that describe a career with Powerex. We pride ourselves on having a supportive and fun culture, and a strong commitment to the development and wellbeing of our employees. With an average tenure of 15+ years on our trade floor, Powerex stands out as an employer of choice in Vancouver. Ask any Powerex employee what they love about their job, and their first comment will likely be "the people I work with every day."

At Powerex we believe that a diverse team is a strong team, and our dedication to equity and inclusion is intertwined with our performance-based culture. We strive for excellence in everything we do, and we recognize that diverse perspectives and backgrounds fuel innovation and drive superior performance.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Overview

Remarcable is purpose-built for trade contractors, helping them manage procurement, tools, and warehouse operations with unmatched visibility and control. As we scale across North America, data is at the core of how we deliver on that promise.

As our Data Scientist, you'll partner closely with Data Engineering to design and build out our data lakehouse, bringing data from across the business into one place to power in-platform and internal reporting, sharpen Remarcable's product intelligence, and surface the trends and next-step recommendations that help contractors and our own teams make better decisions.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who's comfortable wearing multiple hats (analyst, scientist, developer) to shape data architecture and build out reporting, models, and insights that drive action and decision-making.

What You’ll Do


Partner with Data Engineering to design the lakehouse's semantic and analytical layers (on top of AWS S3, Redshift, Athena, Glue)
Translate ambiguous business questions into clear analyses, and communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholder
Analyze product, operations, and customer usage data to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities that inform product and business decisions
Build models and heuristics that power Remarcable Intelligence (e.g. smart search, recommendation engine, forecasting)
Build out AI/ML data infrastructure - feature engineering, training datasets, and model evaluation - supporting SageMaker and Bedrock workflows
Develop and maintain core analytics supporting company metrics (ARR, churn, NRR, product usage, ROI)
Create customer-facing and internal reporting for customers and internal teams
Design and validate product experiments (A/B tests and other measurement methodologies) to drive data-informed decisions that improve user experience and business outcomes


Who You Are


3+ years of experience in a Data Scientist, Analytics, or similar role
Someone who thrives in a startup - adaptable, resourceful, and motivated by impact.
Strong SQL skills: complex queries, window functions, performance tuning
Proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy)
Experience building dashboards/reporting (e.g., QuickSight, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or custom-built reporting)
Experience with modern data transformation tools (e.g., dbt).
Experience building, validating, and deploying practical ML and heuristic models to solve business problems (e.g. recommendation, trend analysis, scoring).
Bonus: experience with AWS data/ML stack (Redshift, Athena, SageMaker, Bedrock), and/or building recommendation or "next best action" style features


WHY JOIN US?

High Impact: Join a builder-led team where your work directly shapes the core product used by thousands.

Culture: Hybrid work environment in our Vancouver office.

Retirement: RRSP Matching Program (50% match on the first 6% of your contribution).

Care: Health Spending Account (HSA) and Wellness Spending Account (WSA) administered via RBC.

Competitive PTO

Who We Are

Remarcable is a cloud based platform that helps electrical contractors and distributors streamline purchasing processes to save time and money.

Dedicated to the Electrical Contractor Industry, Remarcable provides cloud-based Procurement & Tool Management Software nationwide. With multiple workflows, two applications in one software, and direct contractor accounting integrations, Remarcable significantly, and efficiently, increases communication, streamlines workflows, and provides visibility for all users.

Our team is composed of contractor and distribution experts located coast to coast. Through collaborations with industry leaders, we've gained insight into the struggles they face. Together, we believe in providing a solution that brings efficiency, visibility, and better communication to streamline the relationship between the contractor and distributor partners.

Our Mission

To advance the adoption of technology in the construction industry and bring better efficiency, visibility, and communication to our customers.

Title: Quantitative Equity Analyst Process Engineering
Description:
We are looking for a Quantitative Equity Analyst to join our Quantitative Equity Team! We are a high-performance team embedded in a top-performing quantitative equity fund that manages over $78+ billion USD in financial assets. We are dedicated to the mission-critical operation of our investment engine—a well-tuned machine responsible for generating key decisions that drive trades and investment insights. Leveraging finance skills and cutting-edge technology, we ensure data quality, continuous process improvement, and operational excellence.

As a core member of our team, you'll collaborate with investment experts to tackle challenging analytical problems, be accountable to ensure accurate and timely trade generation, and drive operational innovation. Based in West Coast Vancouver, we value mentorship, collaboration, and growth in a supportive and innovative environment. Join us to make a significant impact on our investment engine and overall success.

What You Will Do

This is an exciting full-time role for individuals who are passionate about learning the quantitative equity investment management business and excited to tackle a broad range of investment, mathematical, and technology challenges.

You will start with a comprehensive training program, learning about various elements of quantitative equity investment management and our investment process.

You will then continue to a specialized role utilizing data science and process engineering skillsets to accelerate the Quantitative Equities Team’s various investment functions. Your specialized role may involve building, scaling, managing and/or analyzing our quantitative model, portfolios, data assets and optimizers.

You will be supported with coaching and mentorship from senior members of the team.

We are creating the conditions for you to grow your career steadily over time.

Investment Process Management

The team you will be joining is our Investment Process Management (IPM) group within our Quantitative Equities Team. IPM plays a central role in building highly scalable, efficient, and robust process management systems. The processes and infrastructure we maintain are critical in the team’s ability to develop systematic investment insights and generate daily trades to capture these insights in portfolios. The opportunity within the IPM group allows ambitious individuals to drive their career growth within IPM, or across the other functions of the Quantitative Equities Team in Research, Portfolio Construction, or Trading.

Skills

While we take the approach of tailoring the career path for the individual, we have found our functions to cover two main overarching technical skillsets:

Process and Reliability Engineering


Design, implement and test production processes to run the alpha and risk, portfolio optimization and market implementation processes.
Design robust, high performance and effective process orchestration.
Monitor production health and respond to critical issues in a timely manner.
Effectively communicate real-time production issues to portfolio managers, traders and researchers.
Identify computational bottle necks and improve run speeds in production systems.
Collaborate with investment teams to ensure their process needs are being met.
Find and evaluate areas for process improvements.
Assess and evaluate data quality of production processes.
Maintain process repos, clean code and tools within production processes.


Data Science


Construct and run algorithms to explore and assess data effectively.
Validate structured and unstructured data sets for data quality.
Design and test data loaders and security matching processes and specifications.
Perform data analysis and provide data expertise to support researcher’s projects.
Facilitate production machine learning operational pipelines with effective and timely auditing and analysis.
Enable accessibility and clarity within our data assets through robust documentation and data scrubbing.
Develop robust methodologies for assessing and analyzing data in time critical production environments.
Respond to and mitigate vendor data issues effectively in a production setting.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate traditional and alternative data into existing analytical frameworks and decision-making processes.
Present findings and recommendations to key stakeholders in a clear, concise, and compelling manner.


What You Bring


Analytical Mindset – You think critically and creatively and are adept at balancing intuition with statistical validation.
Financial Knowledge – You possess a thorough understanding of (or strong desire to learn) key drivers of business success, including financial theory, economic models, and corporate financial statements.
Self-Starter – You are motivated and willing to take personal accountability for quality and timeliness of work.
Collaborative Approach – You thrive in a collaborative environment and value shared success. You proactively solicit and provide input and excel at communicating complex and technical concepts.
Time Management – You have the ability to manage and prioritize multiple ongoing projects and daily responsibilities.
Academic Training – At a minimum, an undergraduate degree in finance, mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or related discipline. Completion of CFA or relevant graduate degree is considered an asset.
Industry Experience – You have a passion for quantitative finance, equity investment, data science or related fields.


We welcome applications from candidates with different levels of experience, including interns, new graduates, and experienced professionals. The base salary range for full-time roles is $125,000 – $200,000 annually plus a competitive performance bonus. Compensation will be determined based on experience and qualifications.

To apply for this position, please submit your resume, cover letter, and academic transcript.

Learn more by exploring our website: www.cclimq.com

CC&L Financial Group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or expression, disability, or age. 

Your application will be reviewed by a member of the hiring team - AI is not used in the screening, assessment or selection of applications at this time.

Title: Senior Associate, Strategy & Operations - Integrity (International)
Description:
About the Team

The Integrity team is seeking a Strategy & Operations Senior Associate to help reduce fraud costs and drive solutions that safeguard the integrity of our platform. In this role, you'll develop a deep understanding of our three core audiences—Consumers, Dashers, and Merchants—and become a key resource for analyzing behaviors that may indicate risky or abusive patterns. You'll lead investigations into high-risk activity, design data-informed strategies, and implement cross-functional initiatives to mitigate losses while maintaining a seamless and trusted user experience. Most importantly, you'll help strike the right balance between user trust and risk management, ensuring we continue to support growth while protecting the platform.

About the Role

Our best Senior Associates are data-driven, truth seeking, strategic thought partners and operators. They combine business context and analytics to take on a problem area and implement a customized solution. Think this is you? Read on…

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Establish and refine DoorDash's strategic approach to payments, credit and refund risks - work on the operations, engineering, and analytics needed to protect DoorDash's audiences from bad actors
Analyze user behavior across DoorDash's platform – complete end-to-end analysis that allows us to better identify the bad actors and improve the experience of good users
Influence and engage across the company - partner with the product, engineering, and analytics teams to establish goals and build strategic programs
Improve through experimentation – use data-driven decision-making to run tests in order to reduce risk while accelerating growth


We're excited about you because…


2+ years of experience in consulting, strategy, business development, operations, technology, investment banking, analytics or related experience
Experience leading projects, hitting goals, and succeeding in a team environment
Strong communicator, both written and verbal
Problem solving and analytical skills, including proficiency in SQL and expertise in Excel (can maintain complex spreadsheets/sheets)
You have a bachelor's degree


Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That's why we offer a comprehensive benefits package for all regular employees, that includes paid time off, paid parental leave, wellness benefit and several paid holidays.

Additionally, for full-time employees, DoorDash offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, disability and basic life insurance, an RRSP including an employer match, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographical market up to our highest geographical market within British Columbia.

$97,000—$121,000 CAD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Title: Actuarial Analyst
Description:
We’re searching for an Actuarial Analyst. Are you searching for new possibilities?

Title: Specialist, Personal Insurance Financial Reporting & Analysis
Description:
Job Description

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Manager, PI Operational Reporting & Analysis, the Specialist, PI Financial Reporting & Analysis plays a critical role in providing timely, insightful performance reporting to support senior leaders across Personal Insurance. This role focuses heavily on the weekly presentation of current results, ensuring variances from Plan are clearly identified, investigated, and communicated to business partners.

In addition, the Specialist supports the end‑to‑end annual and quarterly Plan and forecast cycles, including the collection, aggregation, and validation of business assumptions. The analysis and insights generated by this role enable leadership to understand performance trends, identify risks and opportunities, and make effective decisions for both short‑term operations and long‑term strategic planning.

What To Expect


Lead the weekly results reporting cycle, including preparing and presenting performance updates to senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
Monitor and flag deviations from Plan, providing clear, concise explanations of drivers and partnering with business teams to validate assumptions and understand emerging trends.
Support the development and maintenance of the annual Plan and forecast, including collecting, aggregating, and analyzing business inputs and assumptions.
Develop financial models and analytical tools to evaluate performance, scenario impacts, and business initiatives.
Prepare and peer-review monthly and quarterly business performance reporting for internal (senior leadership, Board) and external stakeholders (regulators, auditors, investors).
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reporting quality, timeliness, and governance across Personal Insurance.
Support documentation updates for internal governance activities such as business continuity management and vendor risk management.
Provide timely ad‑hoc analysis to respond to emerging questions and issues raised by business stakeholders.


What You Bring


University degree in Business, Accounting, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Actuarial or a related field.
4+ years of experience in financial reporting, planning, or business performance analysis.
Professional designations such as CPA, MBA, or CFA are considered an asset.
Demonstrated experience with financial modeling, variance analysis, and performance storytelling.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to deliver clear, concise insights to senior leadership.
Advanced proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint and SQL knowledge would be asset
Experience in P&C insurance is an asset but not required.
Exceptional analytical skills, high attention to detail, and a track record of identifying trends and key performance drivers.
Self‑motivated, proactive, and able to work effectively both independently and in a team environment.


Salary Range: $73,500 - $123,500

About Us

Actual salary for the role may vary depending on work location of the successful candidate and other factors including but not limited to, skills, education, experience, working conditions and the local labour market.

This position is being posted to fill an existing vacancy.

Interested in this role, but don’t meet every requirement? We encourage you to apply! We know from experience that a candidate doesn’t need 100% of the qualifications listed to bring incredible value to our team. We’re actively seeking diverse backgrounds and perspectives to help us make insurance better. At Definity, inclusion, diversity, and equity aren’t just “nice to have” — they’re essential to our success.

What’s in it for you?


Hybrid work schedule for most roles
Company share ownership program
Incentive Program - Eligible employees may participate in various incentive plans which are paid out at the discretion of the company and subject to individual and company performance.
Pension and savings programs, with company-matched RRSP contributions
Paid volunteer days and company matching on charitable donations
Educational resources, tuition assistance, and paid time off to study for exams
Focus on inclusion with employee groups, support for gender affirmation surgery, access to BIPOC counsellors, access to programs for working parents
Wellness and recognition programs
Discounts on products and services


Go ahead and expect a lot — you deserve it.

It’s better here — but don’t take our word for it. Definity was named by Great Place to Work® as one of the Best Workplaces™ in Canada for women, for youth, and for inclusion.

Our inclusive work environment welcomes diversity and supports accessibility. If you require accommodation at any time during the recruitment process, please let us know by contacting accessibility@economical.com.

As part of Definity’s commitment to reconciliation, we acknowledge that our work, meetings, and travel take place on the lands now known as Canada, and recognize the enduring presence, wisdom, and stewardship of the First Nations, Métis, and Inuit peoples who have long cared for these lands.

Background checks

This role requires successful clearance of background checks (including criminal checks and leadership references).

About The Team

Definity is the parent company to some of Canada’s most long-standing and innovative insurance brands, including Economical Insurance, Sonnet Insurance, Family Insurance Solutions, and Petline Insurance. Our ambition is to be one of Canada’s leading and most innovative property and casualty insurers. We can’t do that without our people, so we embrace and encourage a culture that’s collaborative, ambitious, rewarding, and empowering.

We offer a flexible, hybrid work experience where employees work from the office and virtually depending on the type of work they are doing and who they are working with. Bring your true self and be a part of our journey. It’s better here.

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
Requisition ID: 46984

Organization

Vancouver is consistently ranked as one of the world’s most liveable and environmentally sustainable cities. Recognized among BC’s Top Employers and Canada’s Greenest Employers, the City of Vancouver is seeking colleagues who can help advance our core commitments to exceptional public service, sustainability, equity, and an outstanding quality of life for all residents.

With a strong commitment to being a City of Reconciliation, we invite you to join our dedicated team and become part of an innovative, inclusive, and engaging workplace. A career with the City of Vancouver and within the broader public service, offers meaningful work where you play a key role in ensuring equitable access to services, upholding ethical governance, and supporting the needs of citizens with integrity and dedication.

Main Purpose & Function

Business Analyst is responsible for leading and supporting a diverse portfolio of work spanning strategic initiatives, enterprise projects, operational effectiveness improvements, data-enabled transformation, and business process modernization. This role applies advanced business analysis, data analysis, data mapping, research, business process review and re-engineering, and management reporting to identify opportunities, solve complex problems, and develop practical, evidence-based recommendations. The position works across a broad range of business areas and initiatives, requiring the ability to move effectively between project-based assignments, operational problem-solving, and enterprise improvement work.

Operating with a high degree of independence, the Business Analyst is expected to scope, structure, and deliver work in areas that may be complex, cross-functional, or not fully defined. The role translates broad direction into clear workplans, analysis, options, recommendations, and implementation actions.

The work directly informs and influences leadership and executive decision-making, including the assessment of options, trade-offs, risks, operational impacts, and recommended courses of action. Assignments may involve significant organizational, service delivery, financial, operational, data, technology, or change-management implications.

Business Analysts play a key role in improving how the organization uses data, optimizes processes, delivers services, and aligns operational practices with strategic priorities. The role supports scalable, efficient, data-informed, and client-focused service delivery across the organization.

This role reports to the Director, Enterprise Data, Analytics and AI and regularly works with business unit leaders, operational managers, technical teams, data teams, subject matter experts, vendors, consultants, and external partners. The role is expected to build productive working relationships across diverse stakeholder groups and influence outcomes without always having direct authority.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities


Leads and supports projects and analytical initiatives of varying size, complexity, and organizational impact, including defining scope, developing workplans, coordinating activities, managing deliverables, identifying dependencies, tracking issues and risks, and supporting successful delivery within established timelines, constraints, and budgets.
Leads cross-functional work by aligning stakeholders, clarifying objectives, structuring ambiguous problems, and driving work forward through analysis, collaboration, and sound judgement.
Supports project governance by preparing decision materials, briefing notes, presentations, options analysis, recommendations, and implementation updates for senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
Develops recommendations that improve efficiency, effectiveness, scalability, consistency, accountability, and client service. This may include identifying systemic issues, operational gaps, duplication of effort, manual processes, data quality concerns, unclear accountabilities, or opportunities for standardization and automation.
Supports the design and implementation of improved operating models, business practices, service delivery approaches, and management reporting processes.
Applies structured business and data analysis methods to support strategic and operational decision-making. Analyze quantitative and qualitative information to identify patterns, trends, risks, issues, opportunities, and business impacts.
Uses data to support problem definition, root cause analysis, options assessment, performance measurement, benefits identification, and implementation planning.
Translates complex data and business information into clear insights that can be understood and acted on by technical, operational, and executive audiences.
Leads or supports data mapping activities to document data sources, data flows, data definitions, business rules, system relationships, ownership, dependencies, and handoffs across processes and systems.
Works with business and technical stakeholders to understand how data is created, used, transformed, stored, governed, reported, and relied upon for decision-making.
Identifies opportunities to improve data quality, consistency, usability, reporting, governance, and alignment between business processes and data systems.
Supports initiatives that improve the organization’s ability to use data as a strategic asset, including analytics, reporting, dashboarding, operational metrics, and data-informed decision-making.
Leads and supports end-to-end reviews of business processes across a variety of operational and strategic areas. Document current-state processes, identify pain points, assess root causes, and develop improved future-state processes.
Applies methods such as process mapping, value stream mapping, workflow analysis, fit/gap analysis, service design, requirements analysis, and performance measurement to develop practical and implementable recommendations.
Assesses the operational, data, technology, people, policy, governance, and change-management implications of proposed process changes.
Develops implementation considerations, transition plans, success measures, and reporting approaches to help sustain process improvements over time.
Conducts targeted and in-depth research to support complex business questions, operational reviews, data initiatives, and transformation efforts. Research may include leading practices, peer jurisdiction comparisons, service delivery models, performance indicators, standards, frameworks, emerging technologies, and organizational trends.
Provides advisory support to business areas by helping stakeholders clarify objectives, understand current-state challenges, assess alternatives, and make informed decisions.
Leads or supports the implementation of recommendations arising from projects, operational reviews, data initiatives, and process improvement work.
Coordinates with business and technical teams to support adoption of new processes, tools, data practices, reporting approaches, and operating procedures.
Identifies risks, dependencies, stakeholder impacts, training needs, communications requirements, and change-management considerations to support successful and sustainable implementation.
Synthesizes complex and sometimes ambiguous information into practical decision-ready materials, including options analysis, risk analysis, implementation considerations, and recommended courses of action.
Develops and maintains effective working relationships with stakeholders across business, operational, technical, and leadership groups.
Facilitates discussions, workshops, interviews, requirements sessions, process reviews, and decision-making conversations with diverse participants.
Other duties/responsibilities as assigned


Qualifications

Education and Experience:


A bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline such as Business, Commerce, Public Administration, Public Policy, Economics, Data Analytics, Information Management, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, and/or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
Significant progressive experience, typically 6 to 8 years or an equivalent depth of experience, in business analysis, data analysis, operational effectiveness, process improvement, management reporting, business advisory, project delivery, or related functions within a complex organization.
Experience in consulting, advisory services, public sector, technology-enabled transformation, data and analytics, or enterprise service delivery environments is considered an asset.
Training or experience in analytics, business analysis, project delivery, process improvement, data management, or quality improvement methodologies is required. Certifications or formal training such as IIBA, Lean Six Sigma, project management, change management, data analytics, or related disciplines are considered assets.


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Strong knowledge of business analysis methods, including requirements gathering, stakeholder analysis, current-state and future-state assessment, options analysis, gap analysis, and benefits identification.
Strong understanding of business process review and re-engineering methods, including current-state documentation, value stream mapping, workflow analysis, service delivery analysis, fit/gap assessment, and future-state design.
Ability to apply business analysis techniques to define complex problems, assess current and future states, identify risks, dependencies and opportunities, evaluate options, and develop practical, evidence-based recommendations.
Ability to balance strategic objectives, operational realities, data insights, stakeholder needs, risks, and implementation considerations.
Ability to analyze data, interpret results, identify trends, and communicate insights.
Ability to document data sources, flows, definitions, relationships, ownership, dependencies, and business rules across systems and processes.
Ability to identify data quality issues, reporting gaps, and opportunities to improve the use of data in decision-making.
Ability to work with data, reporting, visualization, workflow, and business analysis tools as required by the assignment
Ability to develop workplans, manage timelines, coordinate stakeholders, track risks and issues, and deliver high-quality work with limited direction.
Ability to lead cross-functional work, facilitate alignment, influence decisions, and move work forward without direct reporting authority.
Ability to build trust and credibility with senior leaders, operational teams, technical experts, and external partners.
Ability to develop and maintain strong working relationships across diverse business, technical, and leadership groups.
Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills.
Ability to synthesize complex information into clear, concise, and decision-ready products for a range of audiences, including senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
Ability to prepare compelling reports, presentations, briefing notes, dashboards, and recommendations.
Judgement and Independence
Ability to exercise sound professional judgement, discretion, and objectivity when working on sensitive, complex, or high-impact matters.
Ability to work independently, make recommendations within scope, identify when escalation is required, and provide balanced advice based on evidence and organizational context.
Ability to independently manage multiple concurrent initiatives, shifting priorities, and complex deliverables in a dynamic environment.
Ability to move between strategic initiatives, operational reviews, data work, process improvement, and implementation support.
Strong client-service orientation, with the ability to understand business needs, support problem-solving, and deliver practical outcomes.
Proficiency with office productivity and analytical tools, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and collaboration platforms.
Demonstrated interest in learning about a broad range of business areas, operational models, data practices, technologies, and emerging approaches.
Ability to quickly develop sufficient subject-matter understanding to contribute meaningfully across varied assignments.

Title: Commercial Analytics and Insights Lead
Description:
We’re seeking an Analytics & Insights Lead to support complex customer and utility reporting needs while partnering with Product to design scalable, long-term solutions and shape the roadmap for our data and reporting productes. This role plays a critical part in translating bespoke reporting requests into repeatable insights and helping retire manual workflows over time.

This is a highly visible, cross-functional role working across Analytics, Product, Customer Success, and external partners—including direct interaction with customers to clarify reporting needs, explain insights, and ensure alignment on data outputs.

Key Responsibilities


Fulfill complex, short-term reporting requests for utilities and enterprise customers
Triangulate data across internal systems (e.g., platform + BI tools)
Identify patterns in ad hoc requests and document recurring needs as inputs to product requirements
Partner with Product to:
Define canonical metrics
Validate data models
Inform reporting roadmap decisions
Create interim standardized templates where possible
Improve documentation and data definitions used by internal teams
Help reduce reliance on bespoke reporting over time
Serve as a customer-facing analytics resource—responding to questions, clarifying requirements, and communicating insights in a clear, approachable way


This role is expected to evolve over time from fulfilling complex reporting requests to owning the product roadmap for standardized insights and reporting – including metric definitions and executive facing analysis – as reporting becomes productized. For the right candide, this is a path toward product management for our data products.

What Success Looks Like


Fewer “net-new” reporting requests each quarter
Faster turnaround on remaining requests
Clear documentation of metrics and definitions
Seamless handoff of repeatable insights into productized reporting
A clear, prioritized view of which reporting needs should be built into the product


Qualifications


2+ years in analytics, data science, or BI roles
2+ years in the EV Charging/eMobility space.
Strong BI experience (Domo preferred)
Experience supporting enterprise customers or external stakeholders
Comfortable working with ambiguity and imperfect data
Strong communicator—can explain data tradeoffs clearly
Demonstrated ability to handle customer-facing communication, including clarifying requests, gathering requirements, and translating technical data concepts for non-technical audiences
Interest in growing toward product management – i.e. translating recurring customer needs into product requirements – is a strong plus

Come work as an Analyst/Administrative Assistant with Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH)!

Vancouver Coastal Health is looking for an Analyst/Administrative Assistant to join the Facility Functional Planning team. Apply today to join our team!

As an Analyst/Administrative Assistant with Vancouver Coastal Health you will


Provide analytical support to the Program team for purposes such as data analysis, statistical reporting, benchmarking activities, developing and generating queries, preparing and compiling reports and technical documents utilizing various software and tools.
Provide confidential administrative and secretarial assistance and research support to the Director and to the IWMS team.
Maintain the Manager and management team’s appointment calendars, coordinate meetings, process and prioritize information, screen, triage and act upon requests and inquiries, including confidential and sensitive information.
Work independently and interface with other Executive Directors, Managers and staff at all levels of the organization.
Effectively partner with other VCH departments and liaises on behalf of the department with external agencies to coordinate the flow of information, keeping the Director apprised of relevant issues and activities.



This work is framed within VCH’s commitments to our pillars of Indigenous Cultural Safety, Anti-Racism, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, and Planetary Health.

Education & Experience


Diploma in a related program plus three to four (3-4) years' recent, related experience in a complex health care environment with progressively more responsible secretarial and administrative positions supporting senior level management, experience in information analysis and benchmarking, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Advanced computer skills in spreadsheet, database, graphics and word processing programs is required, e.g. Microsoft Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word, and Visio.



Knowledge & Abilities


Employs expertise in the use of computer software and applications to create a variety of analytical reports, documents, and presentations, and to maintain databases.
Applies acquired skills and knowledge to efficiently and independently resolve administrative issues/ problems.
Effectively utilizes both verbal and written communication skills when providing advice or information or seeking/acquiring information.
Develops and maintains strong relationships with key internal and external partners to promote and enhance services provided with sensitivity to diversity and indigenous lens.
Practices the recognition, inclusion and support of all types and aspects of diversity at all stages of engagement, with an understanding of the issues faced by people from equity-deserving groups.
Optimizes departmental effectiveness and contributes to organizational success by applying excellent time management skills to prioritize and complete assignments and schedule activities.
Practices diligence and care when maintaining, monitoring, calculating and summarizing data, records and budget information.
Physical ability to perform the duties of the position.



As per Ministry of Health policy, all health care workers working in publicly-funded health care facilities are required to report their past receipt of certain vaccines or history of certain infections. Collecting these records will allow for offering of any missing vaccines, and for appropriate actions to be taken in the event of any future exposure to a communicable disease or during outbreaks. For all new hires and appointments to Vancouver Coastal Health, you will be asked to provide this information as part of the onboarding process.

VCH is a world class innovator in medical care, research and teaching, delivering service to more than one million BC residents. At VCH, we embrace thinking boldly, taking smart risks, and 'going first' when we believe it will lead to the best possible outcomes for patients and their families. We invite you to join us in creating healthy lives in healthy communities by showcasing our passion for care, connection to the communities we serve and our culture of teamwork that makes VCH a great place to work.

Title: Senior Associate, New Verticals - Canada Strategy & Operations
Description:
About the Team

New Verticals launched in 2020 to take the DoorDash marketplace beyond restaurants: it now spans 100,000+ grocery, convenience, alcohol, retail, and DashMart stores across the US and Canada. This team focuses on building our Canadian marketplace to ensure we are able to deliver exactly what consumers are looking for when they want it, with speed and quality.

About the Role

We are hiring a few Senior Associates on our Canada New Verticals Strategy & Operations. One role will focus on improving how we partner with our Dashers and driving efficiencies to how they operate. The second role will focus on driving quality improvements to our platform that enhances the shopping experience resulting in higher consumer spend. Both roles will require you to understand marketplace data and constraints to strategize actionable plans to improve efficiency levers impacting things like in-store navigation, in-app experience, dasher pay, pricing & promotions and so much more! These roles require you to understand our three-sided marketplace and the unit economics that impact our financial success all while balancing growth, cost and quality. You'll need to weigh both sides of that tradeoff in every lever you pull.

These roles sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, and product. The best operators today are rapidly generating new ideas, taking ownership over metrics and moving them in the right direction through building product visions, synthesizing complex analyses and testing every idea — all while leveraging AI to uplevel how we operate. We expect this person to stay at the forefront of how AI is reshaping the work, actively exploring new tools, automating repetitive workflows, and finding ways to do in hours what used to take weeks.

You will report into a Manager on our New Verticals Strategy & Operations team and be an individual contributor position. We operate in a hybrid model and spend a few days a month in person together. We have two positions so throughout the interview process, we will consider you for two roles and align on role fit throughout the interview process!

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Strategize. From first principles, you'll develop the optimal strategy for best serving all sides of the marketplace - dashers, merchants and consumers.
Operate. Own tracking dashboards and manage week over week metrics to drive high quality operations.
Experiment. Design, launch, and share out operational experiments and product features that impact things like dynamic delivery windows, order batching, predictive ordering, in-app merchandising, etc.
Analyze. Build models using Excel and SQL to evaluate the economic, operational and strategic costs and benefits of various programs and experiments — and increasingly, use AI to accelerate and deepen that analysis.
Build with AI. You'll use AI tools to automate manual processes, build new prototypes and develop product visions. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team.
Lead, collaborate and Influence. You'll partner with and influence cross-functional teams including growth, quality, finance, product, analytics and engineering to launch initiatives to the finish line.
Own. You will manage core metrics across Dashers or Consumers and be the DRI for the success of metrics ranging from acceptance rates, batch rates, subtotals, basket size and so many others!
Partner. Work with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and our US Logistics counterparts to share learnings and scale what works.


We're excited about you because…


You solve problems from first principles. You resist "this is how it's always been done" thinking.
You're entrepreneurial. You have a bias for action and are able to build things from the ground up.
You are an operator. You solve problems by actually understanding the problem.
You like data, and you let it win arguments. You're comfortable building complex SQL queries across multiple data sources and have experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools.
You're energized by AI tools — and you actively experiment with them. You don't wait to be told how to use a new tool; you're already exploring tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini and more. You bring a builder's mindset to AI: using it to automate the repetitive, accelerate the analytical, and unlock work that would otherwise require a larger team. You're comfortable with a role whose scope will continue to shift as AI becomes more capable, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a threat.
You're unafraid of uncharted territory. This role is still taking shape, and you're excited to help define it rather than inherit a fixed playbook.
You have 2-4+ years of experience. You've succeeded in high-performing cultures (tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, startups or a related experience).
You have a completed Bachelor's Degree.


Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That's why we offer a comprehensive benefits package for all regular employees, that includes paid time off, paid parental leave, wellness benefit and several paid holidays.

Additionally, for full-time employees, DoorDash offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, disability and basic life insurance, an RRSP including an employer match, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographical market up to our highest geographical market within British Columbia.

$97,000—$121,000 CAD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Title: Senior Analyst, FP&A
Description:
Procurify is the AI-enhanced procurement and AP automation platform for the mid-market. We make it easy for organizations to take control of spend and save money. We’re looking for a talented and team-driven Senior FP&A Analyst to join us on our journey.

About The Role

Procurify is looking for a curious, proactive, and data centric person who is passionate about supporting strategic decision making.

You are a person with a knack for detail, and you’re motivated by helping our internal customers achieve the best version of themselves.

Everyone at Procurify is a team player. A big part of this role involves building relationships internally and driving adoption of new tools, metrics, or processes. We’re seeking entrepreneurial people who are willing to challenge the status quo and contribute to larger strategic objectives.

What you’ll be working on:


Build and maintain driver-based operating models tied to business assumptions (headcount, ARR growth, pipeline)
Perform meaningful and in-depth financial analyses on current and future financial performance, which includes but is not limited to budget variance analysis, standard monthly, quarterly and annual financial analysis.
Champion the adoption of AI and LLM-powered workflows across the team by defining best practices, identifying high-impact use cases, and enabling knowledge sharing.
Drive effective application of AI tools for data analysis, insight generation, and narrative commentary to improve accuracy, increase efficiency, and streamline day-to-day operations.
Research and analyze historical, current and projected financial data for use in planning, forecasting and management decision making
Partner with broader Finance and RevOps teams to ensure data integrity and consistency across systems
Develop/maintain automated reporting and dashboards to track key SaaS metrics, providing commentary and actionable insights to support decision making
Drive improvements in planning processes, reporting cadence, and tooling
Build relationships across the organization to ensure alignment on assumptions, definitions and support storytelling through data
Other Ad Hoc duties as assigned


Who we’re looking for


5+ years of relevant experience in FP&A, Finance or other data focused roles
Advanced proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets
Demonstrated ability to work with large, complex datasets
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate financial insights into business recommendations
Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
Must maintain a professional and current LinkedIn profile, ensuring it is updated upon joining Procurify to reflect their new role and maintain a consistent company presence.


WHY PROCURIFY?

Help us modernize spend management

Procurify is a remote-first company with a big heart and a strong ambition to modernize the way organizations manage business spend. We’re trusted by hundreds of companies around the world — across industries like biotechnology, education, health care, manufacturing, and software — to manage over $30B in spend. We recently closed $50M in Series C funding to help us strengthen our core offering, launch new payment capabilities, and provide customers with an AI-enhanced procure-to-pay experience. Read the press release here.

Be empowered to do your best work

We’ve created an environment where personal and professional growth is a real priority. Some of the great perks we offer include:


Flexible working: We’re a remote-first organization with flexible working hours. Work anywhere from within Canada!
Responsible time off: We trust our team to take the time they need to rest and recharge while staying accountable to their commitments.
Extended health benefits: We prioritize our team’s health and well-being. We offer a competitive health, vision, and dental package along with an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a health and wellness spending account.
Community initiatives: We have a strong commitment to giving back to our communities, including regular volunteer days, our Donate Your Day program, and education lunch and learns.
Stock options: Everyone has a chance to own a part of Procurify with our competitive stock program.
Base Salary Range: $72,000-$90,000 (This range is dependent on experience and not inclusive of any bonus, commission, benefits or equity that might exist in your total compensation package.)


Work with an amazing team

We’ve welcomed team members who were boat captains, funeral directors, swing dancers, competitive gamers, plumbers, and novelists. Everyone has a story and we’re here to embrace them!

LEARN MORE

Procurify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against any team members or applicants for employment because of race, color, disability, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity and/or expression.

If you feel like you don’t meet all of the requirements for this role, we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that feelings of imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting incredible candidates, and we certainly don’t want those feelings to get in the way of meeting you! We really want to get to know you and why you're great for the role. Please avoid including your picture and age on your resume.

Apply online today and let’s start a conversation.

Check out what our customers are saying about us
Learn more about our procure-to-pay platform

Title: Associate Analyst - Inventory
Description:
Job Description

As an Associate Analyst - Inventory you will be focused on inventory analysis and/or execution of strategies and processes to ensure that inventory and service levels are optimized.

Responsibilities


Executes accurate, scheduled daily, weekly, and monthly reports.
Reconciles report data to ensure data integrity.
Audits processing errors or bad data points before releasing reports.
Maintains report contact database, controls user access to shared network drives and other common resources, and executes regular backups.
Maintains production reports, makes approved changes to report data by modifying Teradata SQL, formatting Excel macros, and Access databases.
Executes on demand processes and reports, adjusts input parameters, data, and formatting prior to execution, and validates report data prior to publishing results.
Assists in ad-hoc report development and execution, including modifying existing or developing new SQL, running reports, and formatting data using advanced Excel capabilities.
Prepares and analyzes data for various projects and initiatives, including interpreting and summarizing findings in PowerPoint or Microsoft Word format.


Qualifications


High School Degree or equivalent experience required. Bachelor’s degree in business related field preferred.
4-year degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience
Ability to follow established processes and schedule to deliver timely and consistent report execution.
Ability to work independently, check your results, troubleshoot problems and exercise judgment.
Expert knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including creating and editing macros and utilizing other advanced functionality.
Knowledge of Microsoft Access, including creating basic queries, code and reports.
Understanding of relational databases, including creating SQL statements.
Knowledge of other applications, including Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.
Excellent analytical and problem solving skills, proven ability to apply these in business environment.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to lift up to 50lbs.
Ability and willingness to work in the warehouse/yard.
1 year forklift experience preferred.
Knowledge of distribution industry, supply chain, purchasing, and inventory concepts, practices, and procedures.

Title: Supply Chain Business Analyst
Description:
Reporting to the Director, Inventory Management, the Supply Chain Business Analyst provides analytical, forecasting, reporting, and process‑optimization support across the supply chain organization. This role focuses on developing insights, improving systems and processes, and supporting data‑driven decisions that enhance inventory performance, forecasting accuracy, operational efficiency, and the overall customer experience.

What You Will Do


Develop, enhance, and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPI tracking tools to monitor supply chain performance
Analyze supply chain data across forecasting, inventory, procurement, and logistics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
Conduct root‑cause analyses on service failures, forecast variances, and inventory challenges
Support the development of data governance standards and ensure data integrity across systems
Support demand planning cycles through trend analysis, modeling, and scenario planning
Evaluate forecast accuracy and partner with teams to improve inputs and assumptions
Collaborate with Sales and Inventory teams to align demand forecasts with budgets and category growth plans
Assess end‑to‑end supply chain processes and identify opportunities for efficiency, automation, and standardization
Support ERP enhancements, functional improvements, and system implementation projects
Prepare business cases, cost‑benefit analyses, and operational assessments to drive continuous improvement
Act as the central strategic bridge, connecting the dots between Sales, Procurement, Operations, and Logistics to ensure a unified strategy and a seamless customer experience.
Work closely with Inventory, Procurement, Operations, Logistics, and Sales teams to support strategic and operational initiatives
Participate in supplier and logistics partner performance reviews by providing analytical insights
Support issue resolution related to supply disruptions, service delays, or data inconsistencies
Assist in inventory investment planning, demand/supply balancing, and capacity assessments
Provide analytical support for annual budgeting and long‑range planning
Support compliance with supply chain regulatory requirements (import/export, sustainability, documentation


About You


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent post‑secondary education in Supply Chain, Business, Analytics, Engineering, or a related field
3-5 years of experience in supply chain analytics, business analysis, or a similar analytical supply chain function
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience using data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau)
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to multitask and manage competing priorities
Proficiency with ERP systems and supply chain planning tools
Certifications: SCMP, CPIM, CSCP, or other relevant designations considered an asset

Description:
Job Title: Analyst Insights and Pipeline Management

Vacancies: This posting is for (1) new role.

Location: Vancouver, BC | Victoria, BC | Ottawa, ON | Calgary, AB | Halifax, NS | St John's, NL | Kelowna, BC| Prince George, BC | Montreal, QC | Quebec, QC (Detailed office location information can be found by visiting this link: https://cancer.ca/en/contact-us)

Work Model: Hybrid Work Model

Salary Band: 3 ($52,000 - $59,000 CAD)

HELP SHAPE THE FUTURE OF CANCER CARE IN CANADA

The Canadian Cancer Society works tirelessly to save lives, improve lives and drive collective action against cancer. Together with patients, volunteers, donors and communities across the country, we raise funds to invest in transformative cancer research, we provide a caring support system for everyone affected by cancer and we advocate to governments to create a healthier future for all. It takes a society to take on cancer – and the Canadian Cancer Society is leading the way

MAKING AN IMPACT

Under the direction of the Director, Insights and Pipeline Management, the Analyst supports the delivery of fundraising analytics, and pipeline management services for the Corporate Partnerships team. This role supports organizational fundraising by designing and maintaining data reporting, optimizing fundraiser portfolios, and ensuring the integrity and strategic use of prospect data.

What You’ll Be Doing


Data Analysis
Use Salesforce and analytics/visualization tools to generate insights that support strategic, data‑informed fundraising selection.
Retrieve, analyze, and interpret data to support performance management of prospect pools, pipelines, portfolios, forecasting, and fundraiser activity.
Act as the Corporate team’s lead representative in DAS project discussions.
Serve as the Salesforce subject‑matter expert for the Corporate Giving team, including managing updates, creating and editing reports, supporting process changes, and building campaigns.
Manage the time‑sensitive Gifts of Securities (GOS) process in accordance with CCS Gift Acceptance Policy, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Prospect Development and Reporting
Implement prospect development strategies and data integrity initiatives; design and produce regular and ad‑hoc audit reports to ensure accuracy of ratings, stages, assignments, proposals, and prospect groups.
The Analyst keeps up to date on market trends and best practices to ensure continual service improvements.
Create efficiencies by streamlining tools, processes, and reports based on feedback from colleagues and observance of data input results. Identify opportunities to leverage technology to facilitate information delivery and work alongside the DAS team to enact updates.
Maintain and update the Business Procedures and Policies document to reinforce consistency in data and analytics practices that can also serve as a reference guide for fundraisers and securing required approvals.
Support fundraiser pipeline management
Provide recommendations to fundraising staff on how to interpret, comprehend, and leverage data visualization and predictive data model scores for the benefit of prospect discovery and pipeline management.
Enable quarterly pipeline review meetings with fundraisers to review portfolios to ensure fundraising activities are on track and moving through the solicitation cycle. Initiate and drive regular meetings with fundraisers to review pipelines to ensure data cleanliness prior to quarterly reviews.
Monitor portfolio composition and performance; provide recommendations on portfolio size, stage distribution, moves management, fundraising plans, and prospect stagnation or sunsetting.
Design and contribute toward training sessions on new reports and tools to fundraisers to ensure that KPIs and financial goals are achieved and data competency is maintained. Utilize strong data analysis and data presentation skills to present information clearly to staff at different levels of the department.
Drive corporate record clean‑up initiatives to strengthen authority-driven linkages and eliminate duplicate records across industry sectors.
Conduct lead‑generation and prospecting activities to refresh the corporate donor pool and identify new or existing prospects within the database.
Other duties as assigned
Contribute to our culture of diversity, inclusion, belonging and equity (DIBE) by ensuring that all staff feel represented, valued, and heard across all aspects of their identity, including gender, age, religion, ethnicity, nationality, race, and sexuality.


Qualifications


Demonstrated experience retrieving, interpreting, and synthesizing complex datasets using Salesforce and analytics/visualization tools to support evidence‑based decision‑making.
Hands‑on experience creating and modifying reports, managing data updates, supporting process changes, and serving as a subject matter expert for business users.
Experience working with technical teams (e.g., data/analytics) and frontline fundraisers to translate business needs into actionable insights, tools, and process improvements.
Experience implementing data‑integrity initiatives, conducting portfolio/pipeline reviews, and supporting prospect management strategies in a fundraising or CRM‑driven environment.
Ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, diagnose issues in pipelines or portfolios, and recommend clear, actionable solutions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present data clearly to both technical and non‑technical audiences and guide fundraisers in applying insights.
Commitment to accuracy, consistency, and governance in data entry, reporting, and documentation.
Ability to work effectively with fundraisers, leadership, and technical teams, fostering trust and shared ownership of data‑driven practices.
Bilingualism (French/English) is required due to the organization’s nationwide operations and the need for effective communication across various regions.
Others may apply

Our inspiring culture is rooted in our core values and commitment to meaningful change:

COURAGEOUS UNITED CARING RIGOROUS

We offer a competitive salary, excellent benefits, including paid parental leave, family sick time, and health insurance—and a fulfilling work environment where your efforts make a meaningful impact daily.

At CCS, we celebrate individuality and the strength of diversity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace that empowers everyone. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, including those from equity-deserving groups such as BIPOC, 2SLGBTQI+ communities, individuals with disabilities, veterans, and others who contribute to the richness of our organization.
