About Us:

With over 60 years of industry experience, Gescan has 29 branches located across Western Canada. At Gescan, we leverage our strong global resource base, our local expertise, and our family-oriented values to deliver the best service to our customers and suppliers.

We are a proud member of the Sonepar Group, the world's largest privately-held electrical distributor. The Sonepar Group is present in more than 40 countries with over 45,000 employees. In Canada, we are represented by 6 locally managed electrical and industrial distributors and have over 110 locations with coverage in 9 provinces.

To explore and learn more about Sonepar opportunities, please visit www.career.sonepar.com




What’s In It For You?

You will be joining a market leader with over 40 years of experience to help you elevate your potential.
You will be working for the world's #1 privately held business to business distributor of electrical products and related solutions.
A chance to get involved in the forever growing electrical industry.
We house the largest inventory to better service our customers and deliver on sales commitments.
An opportunity for career development across many business departments within our organization.




Scope

Under the supervision of the Pricing Manager, the primary mandate of the Pricing Analyst is to analyze any trend, from products, categories, customers and suppliers. The analyst will be responsible for the creation, structure and management of the product database.




Responsibilities

Tool development
Develop dynamic pricing tools and models to effectively meet business needs.
Extract, process, and edit reports from Cognos and Power BI (Excel file, Access, pivot tables).
Perform complex analyses of our current pricing, product, vendor customer data using Excel, Power BI, Cognos, and our internal and external databases.
Analyze and interpret market trends in collaboration with internal teams for the purpose of developing competitive pricing strategies;
Analyze data from a variety of sources to better understand pricing strategies, better structure our customer types, and better aggregate our products and suppliers.
Prepare and present the results of the pricing and profitability analysis to management.
Keep abreast of different methods of price analysis, industry trends, and database management
Develop dynamic tools to improve database management.
Participate in the management of the information of the database and ensure the compliance of the information found therein and propose solutions.Team Support
Validate and approve pricing agreements on a daily basis to understand the pricing cycle and support the team as needed.
Assist the team in preparing for IT changes on products, categories, customers and suppliers.
All other related tasks.




Required

Bachelor's degree in administration or related field.
Excellent command of Microsoft Office suite tools (Excel, Access, Outlook, Teams).
Good knowledge of technological tools such as MS VBA/SQL, Python, Power BI, Power Apps.
Knowledge of Cognos (an asset). • A minimum of 1-3 years of experience in the field and/or related field.
Experience in interpretation, data analysis, database management, and dashboard creation.
Programming experience (basic).




Benefits & Perks

We offer a competitive salary, plus a full set of benefits.

Benefits program allowing you to choose from options that best fit you and your dependents’ needs. Benefit options include: Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Spending Account & RRSP matching.
Employee Assistance Program, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Discounts and a career path.
Regardless of your benefits program, you will receive company paid Life Insurance, and employee paid disability.

Analyste de données (18): Les salaires annuels varient généralement de 96 557 $ à 128 743 $, en fonction des qualifications et de l'expérience.

En tant que société d'État à vocation financière, EDC propose des solutions financières innovantes et des conseils d'experts pour aider les entreprises à explorer de nouveaux marchés, à atténuer leurs risques et à se développer.

Pourquoi vous joindre à EDC?


Gamme complète d'avantages sociaux : EDC offre un régime de rémunération et d'avantages sociaux concurrentiel, une bonne conciliation travail-vie personnelle et la chance de contribuer à bâtir un Canada et un monde meilleurs grâce au commerce
Conciliation travail-vie personnelle : EDC offre un régime concurrentiel en ce qui concerne la rémunération et la conciliation travail-vie personnelle : différentes options de travail hybride, trois à quatre semaines de vacances, une période de fermeture, des vendredis d'été raccourcis et les vendredis sans réunion
Perfectionnement professionnel : Profitez de nos occasions d'apprentissage continu, notamment des programmes de formation, des ateliers et de la formation linguistique
Culture inclusive : Intégrez un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif qui lutte pour l'équité en matière d'emploi et valorise la diversité des idées, des forces et des origines pour favoriser la réussite

Aperçu de l'équipe

Le groupe Solutions numériques et technologiques (DTS - Digital & Technology Solutions), sous la direction du chef de l'information, a été créé en 2023 avec pour mission de permettre à nos clients et à nos collègues de relever les défis du monde en offrant de façon harmonieuse des expériences numériques sécurisées et fiables.

Définir, mettre en œuvre et maintenir l'état cible intégré de la technologie, le modèle de données cible ainsi que les opérations technologiques nécessaires pour soutenir la transformation des activités d'EDC à l'horizon 2030
Établir et gérer une feuille de route numérique glissante sur trois ans qui séquence les résultats technologiques requis pour atteindre l'état cible technologique et facilite son exécution dans l'ensemble des domaines de l'organisation
Suivre l'évolution des tendances de l'industrie et des technologies émergentes afin qu'EDC ait accès aux outils numériques nécessaires pour demeurer pertinente sur le marché et favoriser la croissance du commerce international canadien
Diriger et assurer la mise en œuvre intégrée des initiatives numériques, de données, d'infrastructure et de cybersécurité afin d'offrir d'excellentes expériences aux clients, aux utilisateurs et aux employés


L'équipe de l'Initiative de transformation des données supervise les initiatives de transformation visant à permettre aux secteurs d'activité d'EDC de prendre des décisions opportunes et éclairées grâce à des rapports, des analyses et des produits de données fiables.

Alors qu'EDC poursuit la modernisation de son écosystème de production de rapports, ce poste contribuera à la migration et à la modernisation des rapports Cognos existants vers Microsoft Power BI/Fabric.

Ce que vous ferez :


La personne choisie jouera un rôle clé dans l'évaluation, la rationalisation, la refonte et la reconstitution des ressources existantes de production de rapports de Cognos sur la plateforme Power BI. Elle travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les utilisateurs fonctionnels, les équipes des données, les partenaires technologiques et les responsables des rapports afin de cerner les besoins actuels en matière de production de rapports, de consigner les données et la logique commerciale, de valider les mappages de la source à la cible et de créer des rapports et des modèles sémantiques dans Power BI qui sont conformes aux normes d'EDC en matière de gouvernance, de rendement, de convivialité et de facilité de maintenance.
Analyser les rapports, les dossiers, les requêtes, les calculs, les filtres, les exigences de sécurité et les modèles d'utilisation existants dans Cognos afin de déterminer l'étendue et la complexité de la migration.
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes afin de valider les exigences en matière de production de rapports, de cerner les rapports redondants ou de faible valeur et de recommander des pistes de consolidation, de refonte ou de retrait.
Consigner l'état actuel des éléments suivants : logique et mise en page des rapports, sources de données, mappage des champs de données, dépendances et règles de fonctionnement.
Concevoir et élaborer des rapports, des tableaux de bord, des rapports paginés et des modèles sémantiques dans Power BI qui sont conformes aux normes de production de rapports d'EDC et aux besoins opérationnels.
Transformer et valider les données à l'aide du langage de requête structuré (SQL), de Power Query, de DAX et des sources de données d'entreprise approuvées tout en garantissant l'exactitude et la traçabilité de ces données depuis les anciens rapports jusqu'aux nouveaux résultats générés par Power BI.
Soutenir les essais d'acceptation par les utilisateurs, harmoniser les résultats de Cognos avec ceux de Power BI, analyser les écarts et consigner les résultats des essais.
Collaborer avec les équipes de l'ingénierie des données, de l'architecture, de la gouvernance et des plateformes afin de garantir que les rapports soient sécurisés, performants, faciles à maintenir et conformes à l'architecture de données cible d'EDC.
Préparer les mises à jour sur l'inventaire des rapports, les documents techniques, les guides d'utilisation et les documents relatifs au transfert de connaissances destinés aux équipes de soutien et aux utilisateurs fonctionnels.
Contribuer à la planification de la migration, à l'amélioration de l'arriéré de travail, à la définition des priorités, à la production de rapports d'état et au suivi des problèmes et des risques.
Soutenir le déploiement dans l'environnement de production, la validation après mise en œuvre et la transition des rapports migrés vers le soutien continu


Ce que nous cherchons:


Diplôme universitaire de premier cycle en affaires, en informatique, en systèmes d'information de gestion, en analyse de données, en finance ou dans une discipline connexe, ou combinaison équivalente d'études et d'expérience
Au moins 7 années d'expérience dans les domaines de la veille stratégique, de la production de rapports et de l'analyse de données, ainsi que dans l'élaboration de solutions de production de rapports ou d'analyse à grande échelle sur des plateformes d'analyse d'entreprise comme Cognos, Tableau ou Power BI
Expérience dans l'élaboration de rapports, de tableaux de bord, de modèles sémantiques ou de rapports paginés dans Power BI
Expérience avec Microsoft Fabric
Expérience en matière d'analyse, de rétro-ingénierie ou de migration de rapports depuis IBM Cognos Analytics vers Power BI : Report Studio, Framework Manager, dossiers Cognos, requêtes et analyses de vérification ou d'utilisation
Solides compétences dans l'utilisation du SQL et expérience dans l'utilisation de bases de données relationnelles, de dépôt de données, d'entrepôts de données ou de plateformes de données d'entreprise
Capacité avérée à recenser les exigences, à consigner la logique commerciale, à valider les résultats et à communiquer les résultats à un auditoire technique et d'équipes sectorielles
Expérience dans le soutien à la vérification des rapports, le rapprochement, la résolution des défauts et l'approbation des parties prenantes


Atouts:


Expérience de travail dans le secteur des services financiers, banquiers ou d'assurance, dans des environnements de production de rapports réglementés ou auprès de sociétés d'État
Expérience en matière de gouvernance des données, d'élaboration de documents sur les métadonnées, de traçage, de gestion de l'inventaire des rapports et de retrait contrôlé des rapports
Connaissance des méthodes de déploiement agile, d'Azure DevOps, de la gestion de l'arriéré de travail et de l'élaboration itérative de rapports
Maîtrise des deux langues officielles
Compréhension rapide des anciens rapports complexes et capacité à les transformer en produits d'analyse modernes et conviviaux
Capacité à trouver le juste équilibre entre le contexte opérationnel et les détails techniques, en veillant à ce que les rapports migrés ne soient pas simplement reproduits, mais améliorés au besoin
Capacité à communiquer clairement avec les utilisateurs des rapports, les développeurs, les architectes et les équipes des plateformes et contribuer ainsi à faire le lien entre les besoins opérationnels et la mise en œuvre technique


Admissibilité :

EDC s'engage à respecter des pratiques d'emploi équitables et la préférence sera accordée aux candidats qui sont en mesure de travailler légalement au Canada au moment de la présentation de leur candidature (citoyens canadiens ou résidents permanents). Les candidats doivent satisfaire aux exigences de sécurité du gouvernement. Pour obtenir de plus amples renseignements, veuillez consulter la section 2.1 de la Norme d'acquisition des talents, accessible sur LINK sous l'onglet Ressources, dans la section Politiques et procédures. Le poste est ouvert aux personnes qui répondent à toutes les exigences essentielles énoncées ci-dessus et dont la candidature est reçue avant la date limite.

Engagement d'EDC envers l'équité en matière d'emploi

Exportation et développement Canada (EDC) s'engage à favoriser l'équité en matière d'emploi et à constituer une main-d'œuvre diversifiée. Elle s'engage à créer un environnement sûr et inclusif qui respecte les personnes de toutes les origines, aptitudes et compétences. EDC favorise une culture d'inclusion et d'appartenance où chaque personne a des chances égales de se perfectionner, de se développer, de réussir et de réaliser son plein potentiel.

Votre candidature doit démontrer clairement que vous répondez à toutes les exigences. Nous remercions tous les candidats de l'intérêt qu'ils portent à une carrière à EDC. Toutefois, seules les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien seront contactées. Veuillez noter que les candidats qualifiés peuvent être pris en considération pour des postes similaires à ce niveau au sein d'EDC.

EDC reconnaît que le fait de divulguer la nécessité de prévoir des mesures d'adaptation peut être une question personnelle. Sachez qu'en tant qu'organisation, nous nous engageons à respecter la confidentialité et à veiller à ce que toutes les mesures d'adaptation fournies soient adaptées à vos besoins. Notre objectif est de vous garantir une expérience positive et satisfaisante tout au long du processus de recrutement. N'hésitez donc pas à nous contacter directement pour toute demande d'adaptation à l'adresse accessibility@edc.ca. Nous sommes là pour vous aider à chaque étape du processus.

Énoncé de confidentialité

En postulant à cet emploi, vous reconnaissez avoir lu et compris l'Énoncé de confidentialité d'EDC pour les candidats à l'emploi, qui décrit comment nous recueillons, utilisons, conservons et protégeons les renseignements personnels pendant le processus de recrutement, ainsi que vos droits d'accès et de rectification.

Title: Senior Customer Analytics Manager
Description:
Are you passionate about using data to drive impactful business decisions?

We’re looking for a Senior Customer Analytics Manager to be part of our Analytics team.

The Team:

Analytics is part of the Strategy & Analytics department, our internal consulting team - they’re the decision support mechanism that connects data & business insights with the rest of the organization. In essence, Analytics is a central function that exists to drive business outcomes in all corners of Jobber’s ecosystem.

The Role:

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Customer Analytics, the Senior Customer Analytics Manager will be a senior analytics partner for one or more of Jobber’s high-priority Customer Analytics domains.

This role will partner closely with business leaders and cross-functional teams to help Jobber better understand customer behaviour, business performance, growth opportunities, and the drivers of long-term customer value. Depending on business priorities, this work may span areas such as acquisition, onboarding, lifecycle engagement, product adoption, monetization, retention, expansion, customer success, or other strategic customer domains.

You will lead high-impact analytical work across the customer journey, including funnel performance, customer segmentation, conversion, engagement, product usage, retention, expansion, operational effectiveness, and long-term value.

This is an individual contributor leadership role, not a people leadership role. You will not directly manage a team, but you will be expected to lead through influence, own one or more important business domains, shape analytical roadmaps, mentor and guide analysts, manage senior stakeholder relationships, and ensure analytics work translates into better decisions.

The ideal candidate brings strong business acumen, deep analytical expertise, and excellent communication skills. They are comfortable turning ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches, building clear recommendations, and influencing decisions at multiple levels of the organization.

The Senior Customer Analytics Manager will:

Lead strategic customer analytics and insight


Act as a strategic thought partner and internal consultant to stakeholders across one or more high-priority Customer Analytics domains, helping them clarify business questions, evaluate opportunities, measure performance, and make better decisions.
Collaborate closely with teams across Jobber, including Revenue Operations, Strategy, Marketing Analytics, Product & Fintech Analytics, BI & Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and relevant go-to-market or customer-facing teams.
Lead deep-dive analyses across the customer journey, including acquisition, onboarding, engagement, product adoption, monetization, retention, expansion, customer quality, and long-term customer value.
Help define, refine, and govern the KPIs that matter most for the assigned domain or domains, including performance, efficiency, customer quality, customer outcomes, and downstream business impact.
Translate complex business questions into clear analytical plans, decision frameworks, and actionable recommendations.
Evaluate the impact of strategic initiatives, operational changes, go-to-market motions, customer programs, product or lifecycle initiatives, and other business priorities.
Help leaders understand not just what happened, but why it happened, what it means, and what Jobber should do next.


Support decision-making across assigned domains


Build a strong analytical understanding of the assigned domain or domains, including how different customer segments, behaviours, channels, products, teams, or motions contribute to business performance.
Identify opportunities to improve growth, efficiency, prioritization, customer experience, customer quality, and long-term value.
Support strategic planning, forecasting, target setting, business cases, and resource allocation decisions.
Partner with cross-functional teams and business leaders to improve reporting foundations, metric definitions, funnel or journey visibility, and decision-making workflows.
Analyze the quality and long-term value of different customer groups, helping Jobber optimize for durable growth rather than short-term volume alone.
Create reusable frameworks and decision tools that help teams evaluate trade-offs across growth, efficiency, customer outcomes, and operational complexity.


Drive experimentation, impact evaluation, and advanced analytics


Support experimentation and measurement strategies for strategic initiatives, including A/B tests, pilots, campaigns, lifecycle programs, product initiatives, operational changes, and customer-facing programs.
Apply advanced analytics techniques such as impact evaluation, scenario analysis, simulation modelling, forecasting, segmentation, and predictive analytics to inform strategic decisions.
Partner with Data Science on more complex modelling opportunities, such as customer scoring, prioritization, churn or expansion propensity, automation, AI-assisted workflows, or other predictive systems.
Bring strong judgment to ambiguous measurement problems, including cases where perfect experimentation is not possible and directional decision support is still needed.
Help stakeholders understand analytical confidence, limitations, trade-offs, and recommended next actions.


Build trusted stakeholder partnerships and executive-ready communication


Build trusted relationships with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders by understanding their goals, shaping analytical roadmaps, and proactively identifying opportunities.
Communicate insights through clear, compelling, executive-ready narratives that connect analysis to decisions and business outcomes.
Present findings, recommendations, dashboards, and decision frameworks in business reviews, leadership forums, and cross-functional meetings.
Make trade-offs visible when stakeholder demand exceeds capacity, helping teams prioritize the work that will have the greatest business impact.
Collaborate across Analytics & Insights to ensure Customer Analytics work connects cleanly with other analytics teams and pods, BI & Analytics Engineering, and Data Science.


Advance scalable analytics and AI-enabled workflows


Identify recurring or repeatable analytics work that should become automated, standardized, documented, or moved into self-serve.
Partner with BI & Analytics Engineering to improve the data foundation, semantic layer, reporting infrastructure, and self-serve capabilities that support Customer Analytics decision-making.
Use AI-assisted analytics workflows responsibly to accelerate exploration, coding, documentation, QA, and storytelling while maintaining strong ownership of output quality.
Promote high-quality analytics practices, including clear metric definitions, reproducible workflows, thoughtful QA, documentation, peer review, and data quality stewardship.
Build scalable assets, dashboards, models, and analytical frameworks that reduce manual reporting and shift analyst time toward higher-judgment work.
Ensure insights are timely, trusted, actionable, and connected to meaningful business outcomes.


Lead as a senior individual contributor, you will:


Lead one or more important Customer Analytics domains through influence, ownership, and strong judgment.
Provide mentorship, peer review, and analytical guidance to analysts working in or adjacent to those domains.
Raise the bar for analytical quality, stakeholder communication, and business impact across the Customer Analytics team.
Contribute to team-wide best practices around prioritization, documentation, QA, AI-enabled workflows, self-serve, and strategic storytelling.
Operate as a senior individual contributor who can independently own ambiguous, high-impact work while helping others grow.


To be successful, you should have:


Expert-level SQL skills, with the ability to work efficiently across complex relational data structures and validate analytical logic with confidence.
Strong experience in B2B SaaS, marketplace, fintech, revenue, growth, product, customer, or go-to-market analytics.
A deep understanding of SaaS business models and customer journey metrics, such as funnel performance, conversion, activation, engagement, retention, expansion, monetization, customer quality, and customer value.
Proficiency with BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, with a focus on clear, compelling, and actionable reporting and narratives.
Demonstrated experience with foundational and advanced analytics techniques, including performance measurement, exploratory analysis, impact evaluation, experimentation, forecasting, scenario analysis, simulation modelling, and predictive analytics.
Strong business acumen and strategic judgment, with the ability to connect analytical work to company-level growth, efficiency, and customer outcomes.
Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust, clarify ambiguous asks, influence priorities, and guide leaders toward better decisions.
A passion for storytelling through data, with the ability to distill complex analyses into simple, influential insights.
Practical fluency with AI-assisted analytics workflows, with the judgment to use AI responsibly, validate outputs, and own the quality of the final work.
Intellectual curiosity, creativity, and adaptability in solving open-ended business problems in a fast-moving environment.
Demonstrated ability to mentor analysts, lead through influence, and operate as a senior individual contributor owning one or more business domains.
Proven ability to thrive under pressure, navigate ambiguity, and bring structure to complex or competing demands.
Experience with Python, dbt, Snowflake, Salesforce or other CRM/customer systems, data modelling, and productionized analytics workflows is a strong asset.


You should also:


Be proactive and resourceful, with a bias for action. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, solving conceptual problems, corralling resources, and delivering results independently.
Communicate with clarity and confidence. You actively listen, empathize with stakeholders, and translate complex concepts into simple, actionable insights.
Care deeply about quality. You value strong analytical foundations, thoughtful QA, documentation, peer review, and reproducible work.
Be comfortable making trade-offs visible. You know how to focus on the highest-impact work while helping stakeholders understand what must be deprioritized.
Be excited about the future of analytics. You see AI, automation, and self-serve not just as productivity tools, but as opportunities to redesign how analytics teams create impact.
Lead without authority. You can influence senior stakeholders, guide peers, mentor analysts, and move important work forward without relying on formal people management authority.
Thrive in a fast-paced and evolving environment. You adapt quickly, embrace change, and stay focused even when yesterday’s playbook no longer applies.


Location:

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.

Compensation:

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $151,200, a midpoint of $177,900, and a maximum salary of $204,500, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You’ll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we’re happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!

What you can expect from Jobber:


A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.
A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.
A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.
To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.


We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.

A bit more about us:

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

Are you passionate about data & analytics and eCommerce?

If yes, we are looking for an intermediate digital analyst on a 12-month fixed term contract that has the possibility of getting extended or becoming permanent to help improve site conversion rates, loyalty and customer experience by creating dashboards, insights and experiments.

As an intermediate digital analyst, you will Identify customer pain points and recommend site optimization opportunities by doing deep dive analyses in adobe analytics along with other tools such as content square, similar web and our offline data leveraging your SQL skills.

We practice a remote first working model, leveraging in person interactions at our head office, in beautiful Vancouver, BC, for strategic, collaborative, and social purposes.

Apply now and join our amazing data & analytics team as a digital analyst.

Propose, design and analyze A/B tests in collaboration with technology teams to quantify the financial and customer experience impact of new site features and optimization initiatives.
Build, maintain and monitor data collection processes to ensure a high degree of reliability and accuracy for our stakeholders.

3+ years of web analytics experience, with a focus on delivering insights, building data products and reporting, and experimentation in an eCommerce setting.
3+ years of experience in a web analytics tool, preferably with Adobe Analytics.

Intermediate proficiency with using SQL to extract and manipulate data and working knowledge of how relational data systems work.
Prior experience in using data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau.

Remote-first work environment.
Employee discounts from day one.
Training programs to build new and transferable skills.
Various benefits programs.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers

We're a Human and High Performing AI company, meaning we use artificial intelligence to improve all of our operations. In recruitment, AI helps us streamline the process for greater efficiency. However, we've built our systems to ensure that a human always reviews AI-generated output, and we never make automated hiring decisions.

Disclaimer: We only communicate with candidates through official @clio.com email addresses.

Title: Actuarial Analyst
Description:
We’re searching for an Actuarial Analyst. Are you searching for new possibilities?

Westland Insurance Group Ltd is growing and has an exciting opportunity for an Actuarial Analyst to join our growing team. This hybrid role is based out of our Head Office in Surrey, BC.

Expected Compensation: The expected hiring range for this role is $80,000- $105,000 with a 35-hour work week. Your rate of pay will be determined based on your individual qualifications and experience, while considering internal equity.  Westland also offers a competitive annual short-term incentive program that enables employees to share in the rewards of the business and emphasizes the measures that are key to our success.

Discover What’s Possible, With Westland.

The Westland story is all about growth, and that means plenty of possibility for everyone on our team. Every day, Westland proves that building a great business means taking care of clients, communities, and each other with equal commitment. As we continue to open new doors, we're inviting amazing people like you to join us.

As an Actuarial Analyst, you'll play a key role in supporting pricing strategy and data-driven decision making across Westland's in-house insurance products. Working alongside actuaries, data engineers, and analysts, you'll help shape the future of our pricing capabilities while building expertise in actuarial analysis, predictive modelling, and insurance analytics.

Interested in learning more?

Why You'll Love Westland


An open, flexible and welcoming workplace
Plenty of opportunities to grow and learn
Autonomy to drive your own success
Be part of our inclusive culture, alongside an extraordinarily talented community of people with a wide variety of backgrounds
A total rewards program that takes care of your financial, physical, and mental health
Flexible paid Values Days to celebrate days important to you
Paid Volunteer Days for employees as part of Amplifying Communities, a program to support causes that matter most to our employees and clients


Why We’ll Love You


You love working with data and using analytical thinking to uncover trends, solve problems, and support business decisions
You have a bachelor's degree in Actuarial Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Economics, or another quantitative field and are actively pursuing an actuarial designation (CAS or SOA), with actuarial exams considered an asset
You have at least two years of experience in an actuarial, analytical, or data-focused role, with experience using SQL, Python, and/or R for analysis and modelling
You enjoy collaborating with actuaries, analysts, engineers, and business partners to translate data into meaningful insights and recommendations
You can communicate complex findings clearly and confidently to both technical and non-technical audiences
You have strong attention to detail, sound critical-thinking skills, and a commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work
Bonus: Experience with insurance pricing, predictive modelling, Power BI, Databricks, or P&C insurance


Once Here, You'll


Be a contributing member of our inclusive culture, alongside an extraordinarily talented community of people with a wide variety of backgrounds
Support actuarial pricing analyses and help monitor rate adequacy across Westland's portfolio of Personal and Commercial Lines insurance products
Partner with underwriting, operations, actuarial, and data teams to implement pricing changes and improve pricing processes
Extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources to support pricing decisions, portfolio insights, and business objectives
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and visualizations while identifying opportunities to automate recurring analysis and reporting
Contribute to the development, testing, and enhancement of predictive models that support pricing, retention, and conversion strategies
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders while continuously developing your actuarial, technical, and analytical expertise


Want to get to know each other better? Send your resume our way.

You belong here

We strive to be much more than a great place to work. Here, you join a collective of incredibly vibrant, purpose driven, and open-minded people. Every day, Westland proves that building a great business means taking care of communities, clients, and each other with equal commitment. You will be supported and respected for who you are and for the voice you add to the conversation.

At Westland, you will feel the power of community. Westland Insurance Ltd. is an inclusive organization that values diversity in its workforce. We listen, champion equity and diversity, and create safe welcoming spaces where everyone has a voice and is free to be themselves. Reporting to the Manager, PI Operational Reporting & Analysis, the Specialist, PI Financial Reporting & Analysis plays a critical role in providing timely, insightful performance reporting to support senior leaders across Personal Insurance. This role focuses heavily on the weekly presentation of current results, ensuring variances from Plan are clearly identified, investigated, and communicated to business partners.

In addition, the Specialist supports the end‑to‑end annual and quarterly Plan and forecast cycles, including the collection, aggregation, and validation of business assumptions. The analysis and insights generated by this role enable leadership to understand performance trends, identify risks and opportunities, and make effective decisions for both short‑term operations and long‑term strategic planning.

Lead the weekly results reporting cycle, including preparing and presenting performance updates to senior leaders and cross-functional partners.

Develop financial models and analytical tools to evaluate performance, scenario impacts, and business initiatives.
Prepare and peer-review monthly and quarterly business performance reporting for internal (senior leadership, Board) and external stakeholders (regulators, auditors, investors).
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reporting quality, timeliness, and governance across Personal Insurance.
Support documentation updates for internal governance activities such as business continuity management and vendor risk management.
Provide timely ad‑hoc analysis to respond to emerging questions and issues raised by business stakeholders.

University degree in Business, Accounting, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Actuarial or a related field.

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
Requisition ID: 46984

Organization

Vancouver is consistently ranked as one of the world’s most liveable and environmentally sustainable cities. Recognized among BC’s Top Employers and Canada’s Greenest Employers, the City of Vancouver is seeking colleagues who can help advance our core commitments to exceptional public service, sustainability, equity, and an outstanding quality of life for all residents.

With a strong commitment to being a City of Reconciliation, we invite you to join our dedicated team and become part of an innovative, inclusive, and engaging workplace. A career with the City of Vancouver and within the broader public service, offers meaningful work where you play a key role in ensuring equitable access to services, upholding ethical governance, and supporting the needs of citizens with integrity and dedication.

Main Purpose & Function

Business Analyst is responsible for leading and supporting a diverse portfolio of work spanning strategic initiatives, enterprise projects, operational effectiveness improvements, data-enabled transformation, and business process modernization. This role applies advanced business analysis, data analysis, data mapping, research, business process review and re-engineering, and management reporting to identify opportunities, solve complex problems, and develop practical, evidence-based recommendations. The position works across a broad range of business areas and initiatives, requiring the ability to move effectively between project-based assignments, operational problem-solving, and enterprise improvement work.

Operating with a high degree of independence, the Business Analyst is expected to scope, structure, and deliver work in areas that may be complex, cross-functional, or not fully defined. The role translates broad direction into clear workplans, analysis, options, recommendations, and implementation actions.

The work directly informs and influences leadership and executive decision-making, including the assessment of options, trade-offs, risks, operational impacts, and recommended courses of action. Assignments may involve significant organizational, service delivery, financial, operational, data, technology, or change-management implications.

Business Analysts play a key role in improving how the organization uses data, optimizes processes, delivers services, and aligns operational practices with strategic priorities. The role supports scalable, efficient, data-informed, and client-focused service delivery across the organization.

This role reports to the Director, Enterprise Data, Analytics and AI and regularly works with business unit leaders, operational managers, technical teams, data teams, subject matter experts, vendors, consultants, and external partners. The role is expected to build productive working relationships across diverse stakeholder groups and influence outcomes without always having direct authority.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities


Leads and supports projects and analytical initiatives of varying size, complexity, and organizational impact, including defining scope, developing workplans, coordinating activities, managing deliverables, identifying dependencies, tracking issues and risks, and supporting successful delivery within established timelines, constraints, and budgets.
Leads cross-functional work by aligning stakeholders, clarifying objectives, structuring ambiguous problems, and driving work forward through analysis, collaboration, and sound judgement.
Supports project governance by preparing decision materials, briefing notes, presentations, options analysis, recommendations, and implementation updates for senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
Develops recommendations that improve efficiency, effectiveness, scalability, consistency, accountability, and client service. This may include identifying systemic issues, operational gaps, duplication of effort, manual processes, data quality concerns, unclear accountabilities, or opportunities for standardization and automation.
Supports the design and implementation of improved operating models, business practices, service delivery approaches, and management reporting processes.
Applies structured business and data analysis methods to support strategic and operational decision-making. Analyze quantitative and qualitative information to identify patterns, trends, risks, issues, opportunities, and business impacts.
Uses data to support problem definition, root cause analysis, options assessment, performance measurement, benefits identification, and implementation planning.
Translates complex data and business information into clear insights that can be understood and acted on by technical, operational, and executive audiences.
Leads or supports data mapping activities to document data sources, data flows, data definitions, business rules, system relationships, ownership, dependencies, and handoffs across processes and systems.
Works with business and technical stakeholders to understand how data is created, used, transformed, stored, governed, reported, and relied upon for decision-making.
Identifies opportunities to improve data quality, consistency, usability, reporting, governance, and alignment between business processes and data systems.
Supports initiatives that improve the organization’s ability to use data as a strategic asset, including analytics, reporting, dashboarding, operational metrics, and data-informed decision-making.
Leads and supports end-to-end reviews of business processes across a variety of operational and strategic areas. Document current-state processes, identify pain points, assess root causes, and develop improved future-state processes.
Applies methods such as process mapping, value stream mapping, workflow analysis, fit/gap analysis, service design, requirements analysis, and performance measurement to develop practical and implementable recommendations.
Assesses the operational, data, technology, people, policy, governance, and change-management implications of proposed process changes.
Develops implementation considerations, transition plans, success measures, and reporting approaches to help sustain process improvements over time.
Conducts targeted and in-depth research to support complex business questions, operational reviews, data initiatives, and transformation efforts. Research may include leading practices, peer jurisdiction comparisons, service delivery models, performance indicators, standards, frameworks, emerging technologies, and organizational trends.
Provides advisory support to business areas by helping stakeholders clarify objectives, understand current-state challenges, assess alternatives, and make informed decisions.
Leads or supports the implementation of recommendations arising from projects, operational reviews, data initiatives, and process improvement work.
Coordinates with business and technical teams to support adoption of new processes, tools, data practices, reporting approaches, and operating procedures.
Identifies risks, dependencies, stakeholder impacts, training needs, communications requirements, and change-management considerations to support successful and sustainable implementation.
Synthesizes complex and sometimes ambiguous information into practical decision-ready materials, including options analysis, risk analysis, implementation considerations, and recommended courses of action.
Develops and maintains effective working relationships with stakeholders across business, operational, technical, and leadership groups.
Facilitates discussions, workshops, interviews, requirements sessions, process reviews, and decision-making conversations with diverse participants.
Other duties/responsibilities as assigned


Qualifications

Education and Experience:


A bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline such as Business, Commerce, Public Administration, Public Policy, Economics, Data Analytics, Information Management, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, and/or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
Significant progressive experience, typically 6 to 8 years or an equivalent depth of experience, in business analysis, data analysis, operational effectiveness, process improvement, management reporting, business advisory, project delivery, or related functions within a complex organization.
Experience in consulting, advisory services, public sector, technology-enabled transformation, data and analytics, or enterprise service delivery environments is considered an asset.
Training or experience in analytics, business analysis, project delivery, process improvement, data management, or quality improvement methodologies is required. Certifications or formal training such as IIBA, Lean Six Sigma, project management, change management, data analytics, or related disciplines are considered assets.


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Strong knowledge of business analysis methods, including requirements gathering, stakeholder analysis, current-state and future-state assessment, options analysis, gap analysis, and benefits identification.
Strong understanding of business process review and re-engineering methods, including current-state documentation, value stream mapping, workflow analysis, service delivery analysis, fit/gap assessment, and future-state design.
Ability to apply business analysis techniques to define complex problems, assess current and future states, identify risks, dependencies and opportunities, evaluate options, and develop practical, evidence-based recommendations.
Ability to balance strategic objectives, operational realities, data insights, stakeholder needs, risks, and implementation considerations.
Ability to analyze data, interpret results, identify trends, and communicate insights.
Ability to document data sources, flows, definitions, relationships, ownership, dependencies, and business rules across systems and processes.
Ability to identify data quality issues, reporting gaps, and opportunities to improve the use of data in decision-making.
Ability to work with data, reporting, visualization, workflow, and business analysis tools as required by the assignment
Ability to develop workplans, manage timelines, coordinate stakeholders, track risks and issues, and deliver high-quality work with limited direction.
Ability to lead cross-functional work, facilitate alignment, influence decisions, and move work forward without direct reporting authority.
Ability to build trust and credibility with senior leaders, operational teams, technical experts, and external partners.
Ability to develop and maintain strong working relationships across diverse business, technical, and leadership groups.
Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills.
Ability to synthesize complex information into clear, concise, and decision-ready products for a range of audiences, including senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
Ability to prepare compelling reports, presentations, briefing notes, dashboards, and recommendations.
Judgement and Independence
Ability to exercise sound professional judgement, discretion, and objectivity when working on sensitive, complex, or high-impact matters.
Ability to work independently, make recommendations within scope, identify when escalation is required, and provide balanced advice based on evidence and organizational context.
Ability to independently manage multiple concurrent initiatives, shifting priorities, and complex deliverables in a dynamic environment.
Ability to move between strategic initiatives, operational reviews, data work, process improvement, and implementation support.
Strong client-service orientation, with the ability to understand business needs, support problem-solving, and deliver practical outcomes.
Proficiency with office productivity and analytical tools, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and collaboration platforms.
Demonstrated interest in learning about a broad range of business areas, operational models, data practices, technologies, and emerging approaches.
Ability to quickly develop sufficient subject-matter understanding to contribute meaningfully across varied assignments.

Title: Analyst/Administrative Assistant
Description:
The salary range for this position is CAD $29.89/Hr. - CAD $39.24/Hr.

Come work as an Analyst/Administrative Assistant with Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH)!

Vancouver Coastal Health is looking for an Analyst/Administrative Assistant to join the Facility Functional Planning team. Apply today to join our team!

As an Analyst/Administrative Assistant with Vancouver Coastal Health you will


Provide analytical support to the Program team for purposes such as data analysis, statistical reporting, benchmarking activities, developing and generating queries, preparing and compiling reports and technical documents utilizing various software and tools.
Provide confidential administrative and secretarial assistance and research support to the Director and to the IWMS team.
Maintain the Manager and management team’s appointment calendars, coordinate meetings, process and prioritize information, screen, triage and act upon requests and inquiries, including confidential and sensitive information.
Work independently and interface with other Executive Directors, Managers and staff at all levels of the organization.
Effectively partner with other VCH departments and liaises on behalf of the department with external agencies to coordinate the flow of information, keeping the Director apprised of relevant issues and activities.



This work is framed within VCH’s commitments to our pillars of Indigenous Cultural Safety, Anti-Racism, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, and Planetary Health.

Education & Experience


Diploma in a related program plus three to four (3-4) years' recent, related experience in a complex health care environment with progressively more responsible secretarial and administrative positions supporting senior level management, experience in information analysis and benchmarking, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Advanced computer skills in spreadsheet, database, graphics and word processing programs is required, e.g. Microsoft Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word, and Visio.



Knowledge & Abilities


Employs expertise in the use of computer software and applications to create a variety of analytical reports, documents, and presentations, and to maintain databases.
Applies acquired skills and knowledge to efficiently and independently resolve administrative issues/ problems.
Effectively utilizes both verbal and written communication skills when providing advice or information or seeking/acquiring information.
Develops and maintains strong relationships with key internal and external partners to promote and enhance services provided with sensitivity to diversity and indigenous lens.
Practices the recognition, inclusion and support of all types and aspects of diversity at all stages of engagement, with an understanding of the issues faced by people from equity-deserving groups.
Optimizes departmental effectiveness and contributes to organizational success by applying excellent time management skills to prioritize and complete assignments and schedule activities.
Practices diligence and care when maintaining, monitoring, calculating and summarizing data, records and budget information.
Physical ability to perform the duties of the position.



As per Ministry of Health policy, all health care workers working in publicly-funded health care facilities are required to report their past receipt of certain vaccines or history of certain infections. Collecting these records will allow for offering of any missing vaccines, and for appropriate actions to be taken in the event of any future exposure to a communicable disease or during outbreaks. For all new hires and appointments to Vancouver Coastal Health, you will be asked to provide this information as part of the onboarding process.

Why Join Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH)

VCH is a world class innovator in medical care, research and teaching, delivering service to more than one million BC residents. At VCH, we embrace thinking boldly, taking smart risks, and 'going first' when we believe it will lead to the best possible outcomes for patients and their families. We invite you to join us in creating healthy lives in healthy communities by showcasing our passion for care, connection to the communities we serve and our culture of teamwork that makes VCH a great place to work.


Comprehensive health benefits package, including MSP, extended health and dental and municipal pension plan
Grow your career with employer-paid training and leadership development opportunities
Wellness supports, including counselling, critical incident and innovative wellness services are available to employees and their immediate families
Award-winning recognition programs to honour staff, medical staff and volunteers
Access to exclusive discount offers and deals for VCH staff



At Vancouver Coastal Health, our vision of healthy lives in healthy communities inspires us and our values and pillars guide us. We support equitable practices, diverse teams and inclusive environments, which are vital to creating welcoming spaces where everyone can bring their whole selves to work and feel supported. We encourage applications from equity-deserving communities, including Indigenous Peoples and members of racialized groups, people with disabilities and people of all gender identities and expressions and sexual orientation.

Vancouver Coastal Health is proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers, BC’s Top Employers, Canada’s Best Diversity Employers and Canada's Top Employers for Young People in 2026.

Only short-listed applicants will be contacted for this posting.

***Employees of VCH must apply online via the Internal Career Portal on CareerHub, you are currently viewing the External Career Portal. Refer to the https//my.vch.ca/working-here/job-postings site for instructions on how to view internal job postings and how to apply as an employee. Current VCH employees who apply to this posting using this external site will be considered as an external candidate. Seniority will not apply.***

Thank you for your interest in Vancouver Coastal Health.

Title: Data Analytics Consultant
Description:
Ready to take your career to the next level? Invest in yourself! MSP Corp is a dynamic and evolving organization.  Our team is energetic and multidisciplinary, performing at the highest levels.  We thrive on the diversity of our team and believe that any candidate could be the talent to take us to the next level. We drive technology and performance by providing powerful toolsets, business support and professional services. Our team provides complete, turn-key solutions with one goal in mind — to ensure that we can deliver 100% any day, any time. 




As we continue to grow, we are seeking a Data Analytics Consultant to join our West team. 




About the Role   




As an experienced Data Analytics Consultant this individual will work as part of our data analytics team, supporting clients with requirements gathering, prototyping, development, and support. Client scenarios range in complexity. This individual must have a good blend of people, functional, and technical skills for cross-team collaboration and support. We are looking for individuals who will interface with multiple business and technology stakeholders and teams to evaluate and improve existing processes using multiple technology platforms. 





Location: Canada


Schedule: Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week, 8:30 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. 


Work Mode: Remote













What You Will Do  





Architecting, designing, and developing end to end analytical data solutions from source raw data all the way to Power BI front end 


Providing oversight and expertise in Data Modeling and Database Design 


Working with business/project team members to understand the requirements 


Defining BI framework model, semantic layers and Metadata repositories to support reporting and administration 


Developing and managing BI end user presentation layer training and documentation. 


Technical documentation 


Supporting business development efforts (proposals and client presentations) 


Estimating effort for development and support engagements in Data Engineering and related technologies 


Status reporting 


Interacting with various client and management stake holders to get the work completed 


You would represent the company in the market and must reflect the core values of the company which include: 


Continuous improvement as a way of life 


Fair and generous relationships with our people and customers 


Certifications helpful to role: 






Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals 


Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals 


Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals 


Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals 


Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate 


Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate 


Azure Databricks Data Engineer Associate - Certifications





Microsoft Certified: SQL AI Developer Associate
































What We Are Looking For  





5+ years hands-on experience in Microsoft Data Stack incl. SQL Server, data warehousing, MS Fabric/Data Bricks


3+ years hands-on experience in Microsoft BI Stack incl. Power BI, SSAS, SSRS, SSIS 


Proficiency in the development and administration of at least one of the following areas: 


Back end data integration and architecture including dimensional data modeling, database design, data warehousing, ETL development (e.g. ADF), and performance tuning, front-end reporting and analytics platforms including OLAP cube design, tabular data modeling.


Strong Data Modeling skills for Star-Schema 


Strong Programming skills in T-SQL, Spark (PySpark, SQL, Scala, etc), DAX, Power Query 


Strong analytical thinking for translating data into informative visuals and reports 


Experience developing visual reports including custom visuals, dashboards and KPI scorecards using Power BI 


The ability to implement row level security on data and have an understanding of application security layer models in the data platforms of SQL Server, Azure, MS Fabric and Power BI 


Foundational knowledge of the following areas: Metadata Management; Master Data Management; Data Governance; Data Analytics 


Good understanding of AI fundamentals.


Certifications required: 


-Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate


-Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate


Strong written and verbal communications skills 













Why Work at MSP Corp  





Benefits package. 


Dynamic work environment. 


Corporate gym discounts. 


Wellness day. 


Opportunities for growth and training. 













Ready to make a difference? Join us and shape the future. Apply today!  




Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: At MSP Corp, we believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion are essential for fostering a healthy and innovative work environment. We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, ability, or any other characteristic, feels valued and respected. We encourage applications from individuals of diverse backgrounds and perspectives and ensure a fair and inclusive recruitment process.  




Thank you for your interest in this opportunity. We will only contact candidates whose profile closely matches the job requirements.
